qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Economics'?
qh: 'अर्थशास्त्र का जनक' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Adam Smith ko arthashastra ka janak kaha jaata hai, kyunki unhone 1776 mein 'The Wealth of Nations' likhkar aisee arthavyavastha ki neev rakhi jismein vyakti apne fayde ke liye kaam karta hai tatha sarkar ka hastyakshep kam rehta hai (laissez-faire tatha 'invisible hand' ki dhaarna). Isi karan unhe adhunik arthashastra ka pita mana jaata hai tatha unki baatein aaj bhi vyapar tatha bazaar ki samajh ka aadhaar hain. Karl Marx ne 'Das Kapital' likhkar samyavad ki baat ki, Alfred Marshall ne 1890 mein 'Principles of Economics' likhi tatha John Maynard Keynes ko samasti arthashastra ka janak kaha jaata hai, isliye ye teeno is prashn ka sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: arthashastra ka janak Adam Smith ko kaha jaata hai - unki prasiddh pustak 'The Wealth of Nations' 1776 mein chhapi thi.

qe: What kind of economy does India have?
qh: भारत में किस प्रकार की अर्थव्यवस्था है?
e: Bharat mein mishrit (mixed) arthavyavastha hai, kyunki yahan niji kshetra tatha sarkari kshetra dono saath-saath kaam karte hain; udyog, vyapar tatha banking niji haathon mein hai jabki rail, raksha tatha kai yojanayen sarkar chalati hai. Aisa isliye kiya gaya ki khule bazaar se badhti kushalta milti rahe tatha kamzor vargon ke liye sarkari sahayata bhi ban rahe; isi karan Bharat mein niti-nirmaan dono ke beech santulan dhoondhta hai. Samyavadi tatha sanyukt arthavyavastha mein utpadan ke sadhanon par rajjya ka poora niyantran hota hai, poonjivadi arthavyavastha mein sirf niji kshetra chalta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bharat ki arthavyavastha mishrit hai - ismein niji tatha sarkari dono kshetra ek saath kaam karte hain.

qe: In which type of economy are the 'Means of Production' owned by the state?
qh: किस प्रकार की अर्थव्यवस्था में 'उत्पादन के साधनों' पर राज्य का स्वामित्व होता है?
e: Samajvadi (socialist) arthavyavastha mein utpadan ke sadhanon par rajya ka svamitva hota hai, isliye karkhane, khade, banking tatha vyapar par sarkar ka niyantran rehta hai tatha labh ke bajaye samajik kalyan mukhya lakshya hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki samyavad samanta chahta hai, isliye wo muft bazaar par bharosa nahi karta tatha samast janata ke liye samaan rojgar-guarantee dene ki koshish karta hai, jaise purane Soviet Union mein tha. Poonjivadi arthavyavastha mein saadhan niji haathon mein hote hain tatha mishrit arthavyavastha mein dono ka mel hota hai, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: jis arthavyavastha mein utpadan ke sadhanon par rajya ka svamitva ho, ushe samajvadi arthavyavastha kehte hain.

qe: What does 'GDP' stand for?
qh: 'GDP' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: GDP ka poora roop Gross Domestic Product hota hai, yani ek varsh mein desh ki bhugolik seema ke andar bane tatha beche gaye sabhi final vastuon tatha sevaon ka kul bazaar moolya. Ise isliye desh ki aarthik 'sehat ka paimana' kaha jaata hai ki ismein ek saal ke andar paida hui kul aay tatha utpadan ek hi ank mein dikh jaata hai; GDP badhne ka matlab hota hai ki vyapar, udyog tatha sevaen phail rahi hain. Gross Daily Product, Gross Developed Product tatha Global Domestic Product jaise vikalp sirf shabdon ka khel hain tatha asli naam nahi hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: GDP ka matlab Gross Domestic Product hai - yahi desh ki seema ke andar ek saal ke utpadan ka kul moolya batata hai.

qe: Which organization in India estimates the 'National Income'?
qh: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय आय' का अनुमान कौन सा संगठन लगाता है?
e: Bharat mein rashtriya aay ka anumaan National Statistical Office (NSO) lagata hai, jo Statistics tatha Programme Implementation Mantralaya (MOSPI) ke andar kaam karta hai; pehle ye kaam CSO tatha NSSO karte the jo ab milkar NSO ban gaye hain. Yahi sanstha GDP, GDP vriddhi dar, mulya soochak tatha rozgar ke aankde nikaalti hai, isliye sarkar ki badlav badalne wali nitiyan inhi aankdon par tay hoti hain. NITI Aayog keval niti salah dene wala think tank hai, Vitta Mantralaya budget tatha kar se juda kaam dekhta hai tatha RBI mudra tatha banking sambhaalta hai, isliye wo teeno sahi nahi. Exam point: rashtriya aay ke anumaan ka kaam NSO (pehle CSO-NSSO) karta hai jo MOSPI ke antargat aata hai.

qe: What is 'Microeconomics' also known as?
qh: 'व्यष्टि अर्थशास्त्र' (Microeconomics) को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Vyashthi arthashastra (microeconomics) ko mulya siddhant (Price Theory) bhi kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein ek vyakti, ek parivar, ek firm ya ek bazaar ke star par ki jaane wali kharid tatha utpadan ka adhyayan hota hai tatha mulya kaise tay hota hai, yahi mukhya prashn hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye chhoti ikaiyon ke nirnay dekhta hai, isliye ishe 'Price Theory' naam mila; iske ulat samasti arthashastra poore desh ki aay tatha rozgar dekhta hai. Growth Theory vikas tatha Income Theory aay se judi dhaarnaen hain tatha 'None of these' ka koi mahatva nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: vyashthi arthashastra ko Price Theory (mulya siddhant) kaha jaata hai - yahi vyaktigat ikaiyon ke vyavhar ka adhyayan karta hai.

qe: What is the difference between 'GNP' and 'GDP'?
qh: 'GNP' और 'GDP' के बीच क्या अंतर है?
e: GNP tatha GDP ke beech ka asli antar Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA) ka hota hai; GNP = GDP + NFIA. Iska matlab yahi hai ki GDP desh ki seema ke andar bane maal tatha sevaon ka moolya batata hai, jabki GNP usmein desh ke nagrikon ki videshon se kamai ko jodta hai tatha videshi nivasiyon ki yahan ki kamai hata deta hai. Isliye jis desh ke log videsh mein zyada kamaate hain, wahan GNP GDP se bada nikalti hai. Indirect taxes, subsidies tatha depreciation GDP tatha GNP ke beech ka antar nahi batate balki GNP se NNP nikalne ya market price tatha factor cost ke antar se juda hisaab hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: GDP aur GNP ka antar Net Factor Income from Abroad (NFIA) hota hai - GNP mein videshon se kamai bhi jodi jaati hai.

qe: Which sector includes 'Agriculture, Forestry, and Fishing'?
qh: 'कृषि, वानिकी और मत्स्य पालन' किस क्षेत्र में शामिल हैं?
e: Krishi, vaniki tatha matsyapalan primary sector mein aate hain, kyunki in kaam mein seedha prakruti se padaarth nikaala ya ugaya jaata hai tatha zameen, paani tatha jungle uske aadhaar hote hain. Isi karan is kshetra ko 'kacche maal ka kshetra' bhi kehte hain, kyunki yahan kachcha anaaj, lakdi, machhli tatha khanij nikalte hain jo aage udyogon ko milte hain; azaadi ke samay isi kshetra se desh ki sabse zyada aay aati thi. Secondary sector vinnirman tatha tertiary sector sevaon se juda hai tatha quaternary sector gyan tatha sodh ke kaam se juda hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: krishi, vaniki tatha matsyapalan primary (prathamik) kshetra mein shamil hote hain - yahi prakruti se seedha utpadan ka kshetra hai.

qe: What is 'Real GDP' calculated at?
qh: 'वास्तविक GDP' की गणना किस पर की जाती है?
e: Vaastavik (real) GDP ki ganna adhar varsh (base year) ki sthir keematon par hoti hai, isliye ismein mehngai ka asar nikal diya jaata hai tatha do alag-alag saalon ke utpadan ki sahi tulna ho paati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ek hi maal ki keemat saal-dar-saal badalti rehti hai, isliye current keematon wala nominal GDP badha hua dikhta hai jabki asli paidavar nahi bada; asli badhotri maapne ke liye base year ki keemat hi chuni jaati hai. Current prices wale vikalp nominal GDP banate hain tatha international prices ka GDP ke saath seedha rishta nahi hota, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: vaastavik GDP adhar varsh ki sthir keematon par nikala jaata hai - isi karan ismein mehngai ka prabhav nahi rehta.

qe: Who wrote the book 'Principles of Economics'?
qh: 'प्रिंसिपल्स ऑफ इकोनॉमिक्स' पुस्तक किसने लिखी थी?
e: 'Principles of Economics' (1890) ko Alfred Marshall ne likhi thi, tatha isi pustak se maang tatha aapurti ke curve, simant upyogita tatha elasticity jaisi aadhunik avdharnaen jaani-pehchani hain. Isi karan unhe 'naishthik tatha prashikshit' arthashastriyon ka margdarshak kaha jaata hai tatha unki shaili ganit ko arthashastra mein jodne wali thi. David Ricardo vyapar ke tulnatmak laabh tatha kirae ke siddhant ke liye jaane jaate hain, Adam Smith ne 'The Wealth of Nations' likhi tatha Karl Marx ne 'Das Kapital', isliye ye teeno vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 'Principles of Economics' Alfred Marshall ki pustak hai - ismein maang-aapurti tatha simant upyogita ke siddhant diye gaye.

qe: What is 'Per Capita Income'?
qh: 'प्रति व्यक्ति आय' क्या है?
e: Prati vyakti aay nikalne ka tarika yahi hai ki rashtriya aay ko desh ki kul janasankhya se baant diya jaaye; isse pata chalta hai ki Au ek nagrik ke hisse mein kitni aay aati hai. Isi karan ye desh ke jeevan-star ki tulna karne ka saral paimana maana jaata hai, par ye batata nahi ki aay kis-kis ke paas hai - isliye aay ki asamanta jaanne ke liye Gini gunank tatha Lorenz curve bhi dekhe jaate hain. Kul GDP ko kshetrafal se baantna ya shudh aay mein se kar ghataana aay ya bhoomi ka koi sahi paimana nahi banate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: prati vyakti aay = rashtriya aay / kul janasankhya - yahi aay ka Au paimana batati hai.

qe: Economic growth is usually coupled with:
qh: आर्थिक विकास आमतौर पर किसके साथ जुड़ा होता है?
e: Aarthik vikas aam taur par madhyam (moderate) mudrasphiti se juda mana jaata hai, kyunki jab logon ki aay badhti hai tatha maang badhti hai to keematon mein thoda-sa badhav hone lagta hai tatha nivesh tatha utpadan ko badhne ka protsahan milta hai. Isliye kai aarthikshastri 4 se 6 pratishat ki madhyam mudrasphiti ko badhti arthavyavastha ka lakshan maante hain, jabki bahut zyada mehngai aam aadmi ki kharid-saamarthya khatam kar deti hai. Thaharav (stagnation) ka matlab hai koi vriddhi nahi tatha apasphiti (deflation) ka matlab keematon ka girna, isliye wo dono is prashn ke sahi jod nahi; Hyperinflation to bahut hi kharab surat hai. Exam point: aarthik vikas ke saath madhyam mudrasphiti ka sambandh mana jaata hai - ye badhti maang tatha vriddhi ka sanket hoti hai.

qe: Which sector is also known as the 'Industrial Sector'?
qh: किस क्षेत्र को 'औद्योगिक क्षेत्र' के रूप में भी जाना जाता है?
e: Secondary kshetra ko hi audyogik kshetra kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein kachche maal ko karkhane mein badalkar tayyar maal banaya jaata hai tatha nirman, bijli, gas tatha jal-aapurti jaise kaam aate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki primary kshetra se mila anaaj, kachcha loha ya cotton yahan kapda, machine tatha steel banata hai, isliye yahi utpadan ke 'doosre padaav' ka kshetra hai jo desh ki udyogik taraqqi dikhata hai. Service (seva) tatha tertiary achhe hi hain par wo teesre padaav ke kshetra hain tatha primary pehla padaav hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: secondary kshetra hi audyogik kshetra kehlata hai - yahi kachche maal ko karkhane mein badalkar tayyar maal deta hai.

qe: The concept of 'Five Year Plans' in India was borrowed from which country?
qh: भारत में 'पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं' की अवधारणा किस देश से ली गई थी?
e: Bharat mein panchvarshiya yojanayen Soviet Union (USSR) se li gayi thi, jahan pandrah saal ke liye Gosplan ke naam se kendrit yojanayen banti thi tatha utpadan ke lakshya sarkar tay karti thi. Isi karan 1950 mein Planning Commission bana tatha 1951 se pehli panchvarshiya yojana shuru hui, jismein kheti, udyog tatha bijli jaise lakshya tay kiye gaye; aaj ye vyavastha NITI Aayog ke roop mein badal chuki hai. USA tatha UK muft bazaar wali tatha France niyojan mein alag shaili wali arthavyavastha hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Bharat ne panchvarshiya yojanayen Soviet Union (USSR) se li thi - isi tarah Gosplan par aadharit yojana ka model apnaya gaya.

qe: What happens to 'National Income' when 'Depreciation' is subtracted from 'GNP'?
qh: जब 'GNP' में से 'मूल्यह्रास' (Depreciation) घटाया जाता है, तो क्या प्राप्त होता है?
e: GNP mein se mulyahras (depreciation) ghataane par NNP (Net National Product) milta hai; isliye NNP = GNP - depreciation. Iski vajah yahi hai ki har saal machine, karkhane tatha sadak jaisi poori capital thodi ghis jaati hai, isliye us ghisavat ka hisaab ghataakar jo bacha ho wo hi asli shudh (net) utpadan hota hai. Isi karan NNP ko adhik sahi taur par 'shudh rashtriya utpadan' kehte hain tatha ise hi kai jagah rashtriya aay ke roop mein istemal kiya jaata hai. GDP to GNP se pehle ka padaav hai tatha Personal Income vyaktiyon ki prapt karne yogya aay batati hai, isliye wo dono sahi nahi. Exam point: GNP mein se mulyahras ghataane par NNP milta hai - yahi shudh rashtriya utpadan kehlata hai.

qe: What is a 'Closed Economy'?
qh: 'बंद अर्थव्यवस्था' (Closed Economy) क्या है?
e: Band (closed) arthavyavastha wo hoti hai jo bahari duniya ke saath na aayat (import) karti hai na niryat (export); yani uske vyapar ki sabhi kadiyan desh ke andar hi chalti hain. Aisi arthavyavastha keval kitabon mein dikhai deti hai, kyunki aaj ke daur mein har desh ko kisi-na-kisi maal tatha takniki gyan ke liye doosre desh par nirbhar rehna padta hai; isliye poori duniya mein khuli arthavyavastha hi chalti hai. Keval niryat wala ya keval aayat wala vikalp aise desh ke liye nahi hota, tatha free trade bhi ek sharti nahi balki aarthik shaastriyon ka sujhav hai, isliye wo teeno sahi nahi. Exam point: band arthavyavastha wahi hai jismein na aayat na niryat ho - sabhi len-den desh ke andar hi hote hain.

qe: Which economist gave the 'Liquidity Preference Theory'?
qh: किस अर्थशास्त्री ने 'तरलता अधिमान सिद्धांत' दिया था?
e: Tarlta adhiman siddhant (liquidity preference theory) J.M. Keynes ne diya tha, jismein bataya gaya ki log apni aay ka ek hissa naqad rupaye ke roop mein rakhna zyada pasand karte hain tatha usi 'tarlta prem' se byaj ki dar tay hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki paisa saurakshit tatha turant kharch karne yogya hota hai, isliye log ushe bank ya bond mein lagane ke bajaye haath mein rakhna chahte hain; isi dhaarna ne aarthik niti ke liye mudra ki bhoomika ko kendra mein la diya. Alfred Marshall tatha Adam Smith ne poore arthashastra ki neev rakhi, Ricardo ne vyapar ka tulnatmak laabh siddhant diya, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tarlta adhiman siddhant ke janmadata J.M. Keynes hain - yahi byaj dar tatha mudra ki maang ke rishte ki vyakhya karta hai.

qe: What is a 'Capitalist Economy's' main objective?
qh: 'पूंजीवादी अर्थव्यवस्था' का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Poonjivadi arthavyavastha ka mukhya uddeshya labh (profit motive) hota hai, kyunki yahan karkhane tatha vyapar niji haathon mein hote hain tatha wo kam se kam lagat mein zyada se zyada bechkar munafa kamane ki koshish karte hain. Isi karan yahan upbhokta ki pasand tatha muft bazaar ki keemat hi utpadan tay karti hai tatha sarkar ka kaam sirf kanun tatha suraksha tak seemit rehta hai; yahi jeevit poonjivadi arthavyavastha ki pehchaan hai. Samajik kalyan tatha samaan baantwara samajvadi ya mishrit arthavyavastha ke lakshya hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: poonjivadi arthavyavastha ka mukhya lakshya labh kamana hota hai - isi karan ise 'labh-pradhan' vyavastha kaha jaata hai.

qe: Which base year is currently used for India's GDP calculation?
qh: भारत की GDP गणना के लिए वर्तमान में किस आधार वर्ष का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bharat mein GDP ki ganna ab 2011-12 ke adhar varsh par hoti hai; is badlav ko 2015 mein lagu kiya gaya tha tatha pehle 2004-05 adhar varsh chalta tha. Adhar varsh badalne ka karan yahi hota hai ki desh ki utpadan sanrachna tatha khapat ka pattern samay ke saath badalta hai, isliye naye udyog tatha sevaon (jaise mobile tatha IT) ko sahi jagah dene ke liye naya adhar varsh chunna padta hai; isse anuman zyada sahi tatha antarrashtriya tulna yogya banta hai. 2020-21 ka adhar varsh chunna abhi ek sujhav hai tatha 2015-16 keval ek aankda hai, isliye dono is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: aaj Bharat GDP ki ganna 2011-12 ke adhar varsh par karta hai - ise 2015 mein purane 2004-05 ke badle lagu kiya gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of NITI Aayog?
qh: NITI आयोग का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: NITI Aayog ka poora roop National Institution for Transforming India hai; ye 1 January 2015 ko Planning Commission ki jagah bana tatha iska kaam nirdeshak yojanayen thopna nahi balki rajyon tatha kendriya mantralayon ko niti salah dena, vikas ko tez karna tatha saahyog ko badhana hai. Isi karan ismein mukhya karyakari adhikari, mukhya mantriyon ki up-samiti tatha kai vishleshak hote hain, isliye ye ek sah-yog tatha salah wala think tank hai. Baaki vikalp sirf jaali naam hain, jismein NITI ko institute ya technology sanstha bataya gaya hai, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: NITI Aayog ka poora naam National Institution for Transforming India hai - yahi 2015 mein Planning Commission ki jagah aaya.

qe: Who is the 'Ex-officio Chairman' of NITI Aayog?
qh: NITI आयोग का 'पदेन अध्यक्ष' कौन होता है?
e: NITI Aayog ka paden adhyaksh Bharat ka Pradhan Mantri hota hai, isliye sabhi mahatvapurna niti salahon ki manzoori ke liye PM ka paden adhyaksh hona zaroori maana gaya; iske alawa ek upadhyaksh hota hai jo khabe anubhavi arthashastri ya nitikar ko chuna jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yojana tatha vikas ki salahon ko tatha rajyon ke saath sahyog ko seedha sarkar ke sabse upar tak pahunchana tha, isliye PM ki adhyakshta wali vyavastha bani. Rastrapti tatha Uparashtrapati rashtriya mahatva ke anya kaam dekhte hain tatha Vitta Mantri sirf ek sadasya hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: NITI Aayog ka paden adhyaksh Pradhan Mantri hota hai - yahi sangathan ki sabse upar ki kursi hai.

qe: What is 'Human Development Index' (HDI) based on?
qh: 'मानव विकास सूचकांक' (HDI) किस पर आधारित है?
o: Health, Education, and Standard of Living
e: Manav vikas soochak (HDI) teen cheezon par aadharit hota hai - swasthya (janm par jeevan pratyasha), shiksha (schooli shiksha ke saal) tatha jeevan-star (prati vyakti kul rashtriya aay). Ise isliye GDP ka akela ank kaafi nahi maana jaata, kyunki aay badhne par bhi log bimar ya anpadh reh sakte hain; isi soch ke saath UNDP har saal ye soochak nikaalti hai. Ise Mahbub ul Haq tatha Amartya Sen ne san 1990 mein banaaya tha; keval GDP, saukarya shakti ya janasankhya-vriddhi is soochak ke aadhaar nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: HDI swasthya, shiksha tatha jeevan-star par aadharit hota hai - ise Mahbub ul Haq tatha Amartya Sen ne banaaya tha.

qe: The 'Laissez-faire' policy is a feature of which economy?
qh: 'लेसेज-फेयर' (हस्तक्षेप न करना) नीति किस अर्थव्यवस्था की विशेषता है?
e: Laissez-faire (hastakshep na karna) niti poonjivadi arthavyavastha ki khaas pehchaan hai, iska matlab yahi hai ki aarthik kaam-kaj mein sarkar ka dabav kam se kam ho; keemat, utpadan tatha vyapar ko bazaar khud tay kare. Iska karan yahi hai ki Adam Smith jaisi vichaar-dhara maanti thi ki har vyakti apne fayde ke liye kaam karta hai aur isi tarah poore samaaj ka bhala ho jaata hai, isliye sarkar ko sirf kanun tatha suraksha tak seemit rehna chahiye. Samajvadi arthavyavastha mein sarkar hi sab kuchh chalati hai tatha mishrit arthavyavastha mein dono ka mel hota hai, isliye wo dono vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: laissez-faire niti poonjivadi arthavyavastha ki pehchaan hai - ismein sarkar ka hastakshep sabse kam hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Primary Sector' contribution to India's 'Employment'?
qh: भारत के 'रोजगार' में 'प्राथमिक क्षेत्र' का योगदान क्या है?
e: Bharat ke rojgar mein primary kshetra ka yogdan sabse zyada (lagbhag 45 se 50 pratishat) hai, kyunki abhi bhi desh ki badi aabadi kheti, pashupalan tatha matsyapalan se judi hui hai; isi karan har saal kheti par aabadi ka bahut bada bojh rehta hai. Iska ULTA pehlu ye hai ki aay tatha utpadan mein primary kshetra ka hissa bahut kam hai, isliye yahan prati vyakti aay tatha paidavar kam nikalti hai tatha chhipi bekarri (disguised unemployment) paayi jaati hai. Secondary tatha tertiary kshetra rojgar mein kam hain tatha zero koi kshetra nahi hota, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rojgar mein sabse bada hissa primary kshetra ka hota hai - yahi kheti par nirbhar badi aabadi ka nateeja hai.

qe: What are 'Giffen Goods'?
qh: 'गिफिन वस्तुएं' (Giffen Goods) क्या हैं?
o: Inferior goods with positive price-demand relation
e: Giffen vastuen aisi ghatiya (inferior) vastuen hoti hain jinki keemat badhne par unki maang kam hone ke bajaye badh jaati hai, yani moolya-maang sambandh dhank (positive) ban jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki garib parivar roti, mota anaaj tatha saddi cheezon par nirbhar rehte hain, isliye jab unki keemat badh jaati hai to wo mahange maal (doodh tatha daal) chhodkar usi ke ghatiya vikalp par zyada kharch karte hain; moolya-maang ka ye ulta rishta hi Giffin vastu ki pehchaan hai. Luxury tatha normal vastuen maang ke niyam ka paalan karti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Giffen vastuen aisi ghatiya vastuen hain jinki keemat badhne par maang badh jaati hai - yahi maang ke niyam ka apvaad hai.

qe: What is 'Inflation'?
qh: 'मुद्रास्फीति' (Inflation) क्या है?
o: Persistent rise in general price level
e: Mudrasphiti (inflation) ka matlab hai kul keemat star mein lagatar tatha saarvabhaumik badhotri; yani ek-aadhi cheez ke mahange hone se nahi balki sabhi cheezon ka Au moolya badhne se hoti hai tatha isse rupaye ki kharid-shakti ghat jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki jab maang ke mukable vastuen kam ho jaati hain ya paisa zyada chhap jaata hai, to keematen chadhne lagti hain; isliye mehngai ka asar khaas taur par fix aay pane wale logon tatha pension-bhaugiyon par sabse zyada padta hai. Utpadan badhna ya keematon ka girna mudrasphiti nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi; keematon ka girna to apasphiti (deflation) kehlata hai. Exam point: mudrasphiti kul keemat star ki lagatar vriddhi hai - isi karan rupaye ki kharid-shakti ghat jaati hai.

qe: What is 'National Income at Factor Cost'?
qh: 'साधन लागत' (Factor Cost) पर राष्ट्रीय आय क्या है?
e: Sadhank lagat (factor cost) par rashtriya aay nikalne ke liye NNP (market price) mein se aantarik (indirect) kar ghataye jaate hain tatha sahayatae (subsidies) judi jaati hain; isliye formula banta hai NNP - indirect taxes + subsidies. Iska karan yahi hai ki utpadan ke vaastavik sadhane - zameen, shram, poonji tatha udyam - jo kamai paate hain, wo kar tatha sahayata se prabhavit nahi hoti; isliye sadhank lagat wali aay asli kamai dikhati hai. Keval GNP mein kar jodna ya GDP mein sahayata jodna galat hisaab denge tatha 'None of these' ka koi tulna nahi hoti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: sadhank lagat par rashtriya aay = NNP - indirect taxes + subsidies - isi ank par vikas tatha kamai ka asli chitra dikhta hai.

qe: Which curve shows the relation between 'Tax Rates' and 'Tax Revenue'?
qh: कौन सा वक्र 'कर दरों' और 'कर राजस्व' के बीच संबंध दिखाता है?
e: Laffer curve kar ki dar (tax rate) tatha kar rajasv ke beech ka sambandh dikhata hai, tatha yahi batata hai ki ek had ke baad kar ki dar badhane par log kar bachane ke raste dhondhne lagte hain tatha rajasv ulta kam ho jaata hai. Isi kaaran sarkar kabhi-kabhi kar daren ghataakar bhi rajasv badha deti hai, kyunki kam dar par log imaandaari se zyada kar dete hain. Lorenz curve tatha Kuznets curve aay ki asamanta dikhate hain tatha Phillips curve mehngai tatha bekarri ka rishta dikhata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: kar ki dar tatha kar rajasv ke sambandh ko Laffer curve dikhata hai - ek had ke baad dar badhane par rajasv kam ho jaata hai.

qe: Which curve represents 'Income Inequality'?
qh: कौन सा वक्र 'आय की असमानता' को दर्शाता है?
e: Lorenz curve aay ki asamanta dikhata hai, kyunki ismein janasankhya ke pratishat ko aay ke pratishat ke saath ek graph par darshaya jaata hai; agar aay bilkul barabar hoti to ye curve seedhi rekha ban jaati, tatha jitna ye nekad (bow) banta hai utni asamanta zyada maani jaati hai. Isi curve se Gini gunank (coefficient) nikaala jaata hai jo ek ank mein asamanta batata hai; isliye kisi desh ka shoshan tatha garibi vishleshan karne ke liye yahi paimana kaam aata hai. Engel's Curve khapat ke pattern se juda hai tatha Laffer curve kar rajasv se, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aay ki asamanta dikhane wala curve Lorenz curve hai - isse hi Gini gunank nikaala jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Green GDP'?
qh: 'ग्रीन GDP' क्या है?
e: Green GDP wo samayojit (adjusted) GDP hota hai jismein aarthik vriddhi ke saath-saath paryavaran ki kshati tatha prakritik sansadhanon ki ghisavat bhi ghata di jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki koi udyog jungle kaat kar ya nadiyan pradushit karke jitni aay banaata hai, uske badle samaaj par padne wali bharpai bahut bhaari hoti hai; isliye satat vikas ki taraf badhne ke liye yahi sahi paimana maana jaata hai. Krishi ya jungle wala GDP isse alag baat hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi; keval GDP ka aankda paryavaran ki kshati nahi dikhata. Exam point: Green GDP paryavaran ki kshati ko dhyan mein rakhkar nikaala gaya GDP hota hai - yahi satat vikas ka sahi paimana mana jaata hai.

qe: Which sector is 'Real Estate' part of?
qh: 'रियल एस्टेट' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है?
e: Riyal estate ke kaam tatha uski sevaen tertiary (seva) kshetra mein aati hain, kyunki yahan makan tatha plot ke kharid-farokht, kiraye-dari tatha property ki dekh-rekh jaise kaam hote hain tatha koi naya maal nahi banata. Isi karan bijli tatha nirman (secondary) se ise alag rakha jaata hai, kyunki utpadan wahan hota hai tatha seva tatha vyapar yahan; aaj is kshetra ka hissa GDP mein tezi se badh raha hai. None of these, secondary tatha primary wale vikalp galat hain, kyunki inmein se koi bhi real estate ki seva ke roop ko sahi nahi batata. Exam point: riyal estate tertiary kshetra ka hissa hai - yahi seva tatha kharid-farokht se juda kshetra hai.

qe: What does 'Engel's Law' state?
qh: 'एंजेल का नियम' (Engel's Law) क्या कहता है?
o: Food spending ratio falls as income rises
e: Engel ka niyam batata hai ki ghar ki aay badhne par bhojan par kharch hone wali aay ka pratishat ghat jaata hai; yani aay badhne par log bhojan par notanki ke taur par kam nisbat kharch karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki bhojan ek aavashyak vastu hai jiski bhookh ki had hoti hai, isliye aay badhne par bachayi hui raqam kapde, shiksha, mandan tatha manoranjan par kharch hoti hai; yahi niyam garibi tatha jeevan-star samajhne ka saral tarika hai. Aabadi-vriddhi ya kar se kharch badhne ki dhaarnaen is niyam se juda nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Engel ka niyam kehta hai ki aay badhne par bhojan par lagne wala pratishat ghat jaata hai - yahi khapat ke pattern ka niyam hai.

qe: The first attempt to calculate National Income in India was made by:
qh: भारत में राष्ट्रीय आय की गणना करने का पहला प्रयास किसके द्वारा किया गया था?
e: Bharat mein rashtriya aay ka anumaan lagane ka pehla prayas Dadabhai Naoroji ne kiya tha, jinhone 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' mein angrezon ki loot tatha drain theory ke saath desh ki aay ka aankda pesh kiya. Isi kaam ne angrezon ki aarthik nitiyon par sawaal khade kiye tatha svekkrit svatantrata ki soch ko aarthik aadhaar diya. V.K.R.V. Rao ne 1931-32 mein pehla vaigyanik anumaan nikaala tatha M.G. Ranade ne aarthik itihas par likha, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rashtriya aay ke pehle anumaan ka shray Dadabhai Naoroji ko jaata hai - unhone apni pustak 'Poverty and Un-British Rule in India' mein ye aankde diye.

qe: What is 'Macroeconomics' the study of?
qh: 'समष्टि अर्थशास्त्र' (Macroeconomics) किसका अध्ययन है?
e: Samasti arthashastra (macroeconomics) poore arthavyavastha ka adhyayan karta hai, tatha ismein rashtriya aay, kul maang, mudrasphiti, bekarri, videshi vyapar tatha aarthik vriddhi jaise samuh (aggregate) vishay aate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki 1930 ki mahamandi ke baad ye samajh aayi ki ek firm ka munafa tatha poore desh ki aay ek hi tarah nahi chalti, isliye alag drishti ki zaroorat padi; Keynes ki 'The General Theory' isi soch ka natija hai. Firm ka utpadan tatha upbhokta ka vyavhar vyashthi arthashastra ke vishay hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: samasti arthashastra poore arthavyavastha (samuh star) ka adhyayan karta hai - yahi rashtriya aay tatha mehngai jaise vishayon ko dekhta hai.

qe: Which sector is 'Electricity, Gas, and Water Supply' part of?
qh: 'बिजली, गैस और जल आपूर्ति' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा हैं?
e: Bijli, gas tatha jal-aapurti ko secondary (audyogik) kshetra ka hissa maana jaata hai, kyunki ye seva dete hue bhi utpadan tatha sanrachna ka aadhaar hote hain tatha kshetra vargikaran mein nirman ke saath inhein joda jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki bina bijli tatha paani ke koi karkhana nahi chal sakta, isliye inhein utpadan ki tiyaari ka hissa mana jaata hai; isi karan NSO ke aankdon mein ye madan bhinn roop se dikhte hain. Tertiary kshetra mein bank, vyapar tatha parivahan aate hain tatha primary mein khanan tatha kheti, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bijli, gas tatha jal-aapurti secondary kshetra mein aate hain - yahi utpadan tatha udyog ki buniyadi sevaen hain.

qe: What is 'PPP' in economics?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'PPP' क्या है?
e: PPP ka poora roop Purchasing Power Parity hai; yahi vidhi ek jaise vastu-samuha (basket of goods) ki keemat alag-alag deshon mein jodkar unki aay tatha kharid-shakti ki sahi tulna karti hai. Ise isliye zaroori maana jaata hai ki dollar mein badalne par garib desh ki aay kam dikhti hai, jabki wahan ek hi rupaye ki kharid-shakti zyada hoti hai; isi karan Bharat ki kul aay (GDP PPP) duniya mein teesre sthan par dikhti hai. Public Private Partnership, Personal Production Power tatha 'None of these' is avdharna ke sahi khulase nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: PPP ka matlab Purchasing Power Parity hai - yahi deshon ki aay tatha kharid-shakti ki sahi tulna ki vidhi hai.

qe: In India, the 'Tertiary Sector' provides ______ to the other sectors.
qh: भारत में 'तृतीयक क्षेत्र' अन्य क्षेत्रों को ______ प्रदान करता है।
e: Tertiary kshetra primary tatha secondary kshetra ko samarthan-sevaen (support services) deta hai, jaise parivahan, godown, banking, bima, vyapar tatha sanchar; inke bina kheti ka anaaj mandi tak tatha karkhane ka maal dukan tak nahi pahunch sakta. Iska karan yahi hai ki utpadan ke baad uski dhulai, bhandaran tatha bechne-jaisi kadiyan utpadak se alag vyakti chalate hain, isliye yahi kshetra teesra 'sevayi' padaav kaha jaata hai tatha aaj GDP mein iska hissa sabse bada hai. Kachcha maal primary kshetra se tatha machine secondary kshetra se aate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: tertiary kshetra baaki kshetron ko support services deta hai - yahi banking, parivahan tatha vyapar jaisi sevaon ka kshetra hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Policy' related to?
qh: 'राजकोषीय नीति' (Fiscal Policy) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Rajkoshiya niti (fiscal policy) sarkar ki aay (kar tatha anya rajasv) tatha kharch se judi hoti hai, isliye ise Vitta Mantralaya banata hai tatha budget usi ka mukhya saadhan hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki is niti ki madad se sarkar maang badhati ya ghatati hai; jaisa mandi mein kharch badhaakar rozgar paida karna ya mehngai ke samay kar badhaakar kharch ghataana. Mudra ki aapurti tatha byaj ki dar wali niti kendriya bank tatha share bazaar par chalan-kaushal alag vishay hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rajkoshiya niti sarkar ki aay tatha kharch se juri hoti hai - ise Vitta Mantralaya budget ke zariye chalata hai.

qe: What is 'Monetary Policy' related to?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति' (Monetary Policy) किससे संबंधित है?
o: Control of money supply and interest rates
e: Mudra niti (monetary policy) mudra ki aapurti tatha byaj ki dar (interest rate) ko niyantrit karne se judi hoti hai, isliye ise Bharat mein RBI ki mudra niti samiti (MPC) banati tatha lagu karti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mehngai badhne par RBI byaj ki dar badhaakar karz mehanga kar deta hai tatha maang ghatati hai, jabki mandi mein dar ghataakar karz sasta karke nivesh tatha rozgar badhata hai. Kar tatha sarkari kharch rajkoshiya niti ke hisse hain, isliye 'Taxation' tatha 'Government spending' wale vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: maundrik niti mudra ki aapurti tatha byaj ki dar se judi hoti hai - ise kendriya bank (Bharat mein RBI) chalata hai.

qe: What is a 'Command Economy'?
qh: 'कमांड इकोनॉमी' क्या है?
e: Kaamand (command) arthavyavastha wo hoti hai jismein utpadan tatha vitran ka poora nirnay sarkar karti hai; kya banana hai, kitna banana hai aur kis ko milna hai, ye sab yojana ke zariye tay hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise desh mein bazaar tatha vyakti ki pasand ki bhoomika kam hoti hai tatha sarkar apne lakshya tay karti hai, isliye purane Soviet Union tatha purane Communist China isi vyavastha ka udaharan the. Muft bazaar (market driven) tatha dharm-aadharit vikalp iske gun nahi batate, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: kaamand arthavyavastha vahi hoti hai jismein sab kuchh sarkar ki yojana tatha niyantran se tay hota hai - ise niyojit ya samajvadi vyavastha bhi kehte hain.

qe: Which sector is called 'Sunrise Sector'?
qh: किस क्षेत्र को 'सनराइज सेक्टर' कहा जाता है?
o: Emerging industries with high growth potential
e: Ubharte utpadan (sunrise) kshetra unhe kaha jaata hai jahan naye tatha tezi se badhne wale udyog hote hain tatha jinka bhavishya ujjwal mana jaata hai; jaise suchna praudyogiki (IT), telecom tatha harness shaaya urja. Ise sunrise kehte hue isliye kaha jaata hai ki jaise suraj ugta hai waise hi ye kshetra rojgar tatha aay ke naye avsar paida karta hai; isi karan sarkar inhein vishesh sahayata tatha chhoot deti hai. Krishi tatha purane vastra udyog paramparik kshetra hain, isliye wo sunrise sector nahi; 'None of these' ka koi mahatva nahi. Exam point: sunrise sector un naye udyogon ko kehte hain jinmein vriddhi ki bahut sambhavna hoti hai - jaise IT, telecom tatha green energy.

qe: What is the 'GDP Deflator'?
qh: GDP डिफ्लेटर क्या है?
e: GDP deflator mehngai (inflation) ka sabse vistrit paimana hota hai; ise nikalne ke liye nominal GDP ko real GDP se baant kar 100 se guna kiya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki thok (wholesale) keemat soochak ya upbhokta keemat soochak keval chuni hui vastuen dekhte hain, jabki deflator poore GDP mein shamil har maal tatha seva ki keemat badlav pakadta hai; isliye ise 'GDP ka mulya samsodhak' kehte hain. Budget tool tatha production tool wale naam iske kaam nahi batate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: GDP deflator mehngai napne wala soochak hai - yahi nominal GDP tatha real GDP ka anupat batata hai.

qe: What are 'Veblen Goods'?
qh: 'वेबलेन वस्तुएं' (Veblen Goods) क्या हैं?
o: Luxury goods whose demand increases with price
e: Veblen vastuen aisi luxury vastuen hoti hain jinki keemat badhne par maang kam nahi hoti balki badh jaati hai; iska karan unhe 'status symbol' maana jaana hai. Iska udaharan heera, mehangi ghadi tatha luxury car hai, jo log doosron ko dikhane ke liye kharidte hain, isliye sasta hone par unki izzat hi kam ho jaati hai; yahi karan 'dikhawa kharapat (conspicuous consumption)' kaha jaata hai. Sasti tatha aavashyak vastuen maang ke saamaanya niyam ka paalan karti hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Veblen vastuen aisi luxury vastuen hain jinki maang keemat badhne ke saath badh jaati hai - yahi dikhawa kharapat wali vastuen hain.

qe: Which part of economy deals with 'Mining'?
qh: अर्थव्यवस्था का कौन सा हिस्सा 'खनन' (Mining) से संबंधित है?
e: Khanan (mining) primary kshetra se juda hai, kyunki ismein dharti ke andar se koyla, loha, bauxite tatha sookshm tel-padarthon jaise kachche khanij seedha nikaale jaate hain tatha koi nirmaan nahi hota. Isi karan khanan ko krishi ke saath hi 'prakriti se nikalne wale kaam' mein rakha jaata hai; usi khanij ko pighlakar dhaatu banana secondary kshetra ka kaam hai. Secondary tatha tertiary kshetra mein khanij ka jal-prakshaman tatha vyapar aate hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: khanan primary kshetra ka hissa hai - yahi prakruti se kachche khanij nikaalne wala kaam hai.

qe: What is 'Balance of Trade'?
qh: 'व्यापार संतुलन' (Balance of Trade) क्या है?
o: Difference between exports and imports of goods
e: Vyapar santulan (balance of trade) kisi desh ke kul niryat tatha kul aayat ke antar ko kehte hain; ismein keval dikhne wale vastuon (visible goods) ka len-den gina jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki vyapar santulan batata hai ki desh ka vastu-vyapar adhishth (surplus) mein hai ya ghate (deficit) mein; agar niryat zyada hui to adhishth tatha aayat zyada hui to ghata hota hai. Sevaon tatha nivesh ki aay-shakti ko jod kar jo bada hisaab banta hai, ushe chalu khata (current account) kehte hain; isliye Export+Import jaisa jod ya total tax wale vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: vyapar santulan vastuon ke niryat tatha aayat ka antar hota hai - ismein keval dikhne wale vyapar ka hisaab hota hai.

qe: Who gave the concept of 'Vicious Circle of Poverty'?
qh: 'गरीबी के दुष्चक्र' की अवधारणा किसने दी थी?
e: Garibi ke dushchakra (vicious circle of poverty) ki avdharna Ragnar Nurkse ne di thi; yahi batati hai ki garib desh garibi se isliye nahi nikal paate kyunki unki aay kam hoti hai, isse bachat kam hoti hai, bachat kam se nivesh kam hota hai, nivesh kam se paidavar kam rehta hai tatha aay phir kam rah jaati hai - yani chakra ghoomta rehta hai. Isi karan garib deshon ke liye bahari nivesh tatha takniki sahayata ki baat ki gayi, taaki chakra toota ja sake. Adam Smith tatha Keynes ne alag vishayon par likha tatha 'None of these' vikalp ka koi aadhaar nahi, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: garibi ke dushchakra ki avdharna Ragnar Nurkse ne di - yahi kam bachat tatha kam nivesh se garibi bane rehne ki baat batati hai.

qe: What is 'Disguised Unemployment'?
qh: 'प्रच्छन्न बेरोजगारी' (Disguised Unemployment) क्या है?
e: Prachchhann (disguised) bekarri ka matlab hai zarurat se zyada logon ka kaam par laga hona; yani sabhi vyakti dikhte hain ki kaam kar rahe hain, par unmein se kuchh bina oonche paidavar ke ho jaate hain. Ise isliye 'chhipi' bekarri kehte hain ki kaam karne wale ki ginti kam kar dene par bhi utpadan utna hi bana rehta hai; iska sabse aam udaharan Bharat ki kheti hai jahan chhote khet par poora parivar laga rehta hai. Seasonal work tatha bilkul kaam na hona alag parkar ki bekarri hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: prachchhann bekarri mein zarurat se zyada log kaam par lagte hain - yahi surat Bharat ki kheti mein sabse zyada dikhti hai.

qe: Which bank is known as the 'Banker's Bank' in India?
qh: भारत में किस बैंक को 'बैंकों का बैंक' कहा जाता है?
e: RBI ko 'bankon ka bank' kaha jaata hai, kyunki yahi desh ke sabhi commercial bankon ko license deta hai, unki dekh-rekh karta hai tatha zarurat padne par unhe karz bhi deta hai; isi karan aam bank jab paise ki kami mein ho to RBI ke paas jaate hain. Iske alawa RBI mudra chapata hai, videshi mudra ka bhandar rakhta hai tatha mulk ki banking vyavastha ko sthir rakhta hai, isliye ise 'bankers ki bank' tatha 'lender of last resort' bhi kehte hain. NABARD krishkarz ke liye, PNB tatha SBI aam grahakon ke liye kaam karne wale commercial bank hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ko bankon ka bank kaha jaata hai - yahi desh ke sabhi bankon ko niyantrit tatha sahayata deta hai.

qe: In which year was the 'Reserve Bank of India' (RBI) established?
qh: 'भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक' (RBI) की स्थापना किस वर्ष हुई थी?
e: RBI ki sthapna 1 April 1935 ko RBI Act 1934 ke tehat hui thi, tatha shuruaat mein iska paisai (capital) niji hisson mein tha; 1 January 1949 ko iska rashtriyakaran kar diya gaya. RBI ka kaam mudra ki aapurti ko niyantrit karna, mehngai rokna, videshi mudra ka bhandar sambhalna tatha banking vyavastha ko mazboot rakhna hai. 1949 tatha 1951 bhi mahatvapurna varsh hain (1949 rashtriyakaran tatha 1951 pehli panchvarshiya yojana) tatha 1947 azaadi ka varsh hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ki sthapna 1 April 1935 ko hui thi - rashtriyakaran 1949 mein hua.

qe: What is 'Repo Rate'?
qh: 'रेपो रेट' (Repo Rate) क्या है?
o: Rate at which RBI lends to commercial banks
Rate at which banks lend to public
e: Repo rate wo dar hoti hai jis par RBI commercial bankon ko short-term karz deta hai, aur iske badle bank apni sarkari securities tatha bonds RBI ke paas girvi (repo) rakh dete hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki jab RBI repo rate badhata hai to bankon ke liye karz mehanga ho jaata hai tatha wo aam logon ko mahange byaj par loan dete hain, isse maang ghat jaati hai tatha mehngai par lagam lagti hai; ulta karne par mandi mein maang badhti hai. Long-term loans wali bank rate alag hoti hai tatha aam janta ko bankon wali dar lending rate kehlati hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: repo rate wo dar hai jis par RBI bankon ko alpakalik karz deta hai - yahi mudra niti ka sabse charchit hathiyaar hai.

qe: What is 'Reverse Repo Rate'?
qh: 'रिवर्स रेपो रेट' क्या है?
e: Reverse repo rate wo dar hoti hai jis par bank apna adhik paisa RBI ke paas jama karte hain; yani ise RBI bankon se karz lene ki dar kaha ja sakta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mehngai zyada hone par RBI reverse repo rate badhata hai jisse bankon ko paisa RBI ke paas rakhna faydemand lagta hai tatha bazaar mein taralta (liquidity) kam ho jaati hai; yahi tareeka bazaar se paisa sokhne ka hai. Housing loan ki dar aam bank tay karte hain tatha 'None of these' ka koi aadhaar nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: reverse repo rate par RBI bankon se paisa lene ke tarah taralta sokhta hai - bankon ke paas kam paisa reh jaane se mehngai par lagam lagti hai.

qe: What does 'CRR' stand for in banking terms?
qh: बैंकिंग शब्दावली में 'CRR' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: CRR ka poora roop Cash Reserve Ratio hota hai; yahi kul jama (deposits) ka wo pratishat hai jo bankon ko RBI ke paas nagi (cash) roop mein rakhna padta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki is paise par bank koi byaj nahi kama sakti, isliye CRR badhane par bankon ke paas karz dene ke liye kam paisa bachta hai; isi karan mehngai ke samay RBI CRR badhata hai tatha maandgi mein ghataata hai. Baaki vikalp sirf jaali vistar (expansions) hain tatha CRR ke sahi matlab nahi batate, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: CRR ka matlab Cash Reserve Ratio hai - yahi jama ka wo hissa hai jo bankon ko RBI ke paas nagi rakhna hota hai.

qe: What is 'SLR' (Statutory Liquidity Ratio)?
qh: 'SLR' (साविधिक तरलता अनुपात) क्या है?
o: Percentage of deposits banks must keep with themselves
e: SLR (Statutory Liquidity Ratio) kul jama ka wo pratishat hai jo bankon ko apne paas hi rakhaaav bhugtan (safe assets) - jaise sona, nagi tatha sarkari securities - ke roop mein rakhna padta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki SLR CRR se alag hai kyunki ye raqam bank RBI ke paas nahi balki apne paas rakhti hai, taaki grahak ke maangne par paisa diya ja sake tatha loan dene ki seema bhi bani rahe. Bankon ka RBI ke paas rakhna CRR kehlata hai tatha loan rate tatha 'None of these' ka is pariprekshya mein koi tulna nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: SLR jama ka wo pratishat hai jo bank apne paas taral rakhiti (liquid) roop mein rakhte hain - yahi CRR se alag hota hai.

qe: When was the 'Reserve Bank of India' nationalized?
qh: 'भारतीय रिजर्व बैंक' का राष्ट्रीयकरण कब किया गया था?
e: RBI ka rashtriyakaran 1 January 1949 ko kiya gaya, yani azaadi ke theek do saal baad; iske pehle RBI ke hisse niji logo tatha bankon ke paas the. Iska karan yahi tha ki naye svatantra desh ko mudra tatha banking par poora niyantran chahiye tha, taaki kheti tatha udyog ke liye saste karz ka prabandh ho sake tatha aam janta ka vishwas bana rahe. 1935 RBI ki sthapna ka varsh, 1955 SBI ke punargathan ka varsh tatha 1969 pehle chhah bada bank rashtriyakaran ka varsh hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ka rashtriyakaran 1 January 1949 ko hua - iske baad mudra niti par sarkar ka poora niyantran ho gaya.

qe: Which organization issues 'One Rupee' notes in India?
qh: भारत में 'एक रुपये' के नोट कौन जारी करता है?
e: Bharat mein ek rupaye ke note tatha sabhi sikkhe Vitta Mantralaya (Bharat Sarkar) jari karta hai, jabki do rupaye tatha usse upar ke sabhi note RBI jari karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki chhote sikkhon tatha ek rupaye ke note ka kaam dainik chhote len-den mein zyada hota hai, isliye unhe sarkar apne garbh mein rakhti hai tatha unki chapai ki poori zimmedari sarkar ki hai. RBI, SBI tatha Rastrapti note jari nahi karte; Rastrapti keval apni maanya ka swaroop karte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: ek rupaye ka note tatha sabhi sikkhe Vitta Mantralaya jari karta hai - baaki note RBI jari karta hai.

qe: Whose signature is on the 'One Rupee' note?
qh: 'एक रुपये' के नोट पर किसके हस्ताक्षर होते हैं?
e: Ek rupaye ke note par Vitta Sachiv (Finance Secretary) ke hastakshar hote hain, jabki baaki sabhi note par RBI ke Governor ke hastakshar hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ek rupaye ka note sarkar ki or se jari hota hai, isliye us par anya noton ki tarah RBI ke Governor ke bajaye sarkar ke sabse bade vitti adhikari ka hastakshar hota hai. Vitta Mantri tatha Pradhan Mantri tatha RBI Governor ke hastakshar baaki samay ke note se juda alag vyavastha hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ek rupaye ke note par Vitta Sachiv ke hastakshar hote hain - baaki note par RBI Governor ke.

qe: What is 'Bank Rate'?
qh: 'बैंक दर' (Bank Rate) क्या है?
o: Rate for long term loans by RBI to banks
e: Bank rate wo dar hoti hai jis par RBI bankon ko deerghakalik (long-term) karz deta hai tatha unke bill of exchange ko punhah (rediscount) karta hai; isliye yahi bankon ke liye deergh samay ka sahayak dar hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki bank rate badhne par bankon ke liye paisa mehanga hota hai tatha wo grahakon ko mahange loan dete hain, isse mehngai kam hoti hai; repo rate keval short-term ke liye hoti hai. Deposit rate grahakon ko di jane wali dar hai tatha short-term loans wala vikalp repo rate ko darshata hai, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: bank rate RBI dwara bankon ko diye jane wale deerghakalik karz ki dar hoti hai - yahi repo rate se alag lambi avadhi ki dar hai.

qe: What is 'Open Market Operations' (OMO)?
qh: 'ओपन मार्केट ऑपरेशंस' (OMO) क्या है?
o: Buying and selling of govt securities by RBI
e: Open Market Operations (OMO) ka matlab hai RBI dwara sarkari securities (bonds) ka khula bazaar mein kharidna tatha bechna; yahi mudra ki aapurti ko niyantrit karne ka tarika hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki jab RBI bonds kharidta hai to bankon ke haath mein paisa aa jaata hai tatha bazaar mein taralta badh jaati hai, jabki bonds bechne par paisa RBI ke paas chala jaata hai tatha taralta ghat jaati hai; isliye OMO se mehngai tatha maandgi dono sambhaali jaati hain. Naye bank kholna tatha share bazaar ki trading OMO se alag kaam hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: OMO ka matlab RBI dwara sarkari prathibhutiyon ka kharid-farokht hai - isi se mudra ki aapurti tatha taralta niyantrit hoti hai.

qe: How many banks were nationalized in the first phase in 1969?
qh: 1969 में पहले चरण में कितने बैंकों का राष्ट्रीयकरण किया गया था?
e: 1969 mein pehle charan mein 14 pramukh commercial bankon ka rashtriyakaran kiya gaya tha; iske baad 1980 mein 6 anya bankon ka rashtriyakaran hua tatha is tarah kul 20 bank sarkari ho gaye. Rashtriyakaran ka karan yahi tha ki tab bade bankon ka niyantran kuchh industrial ghar yon ke haath mein tha tatha kheti tatha gaon mein banking seva nahi pahunch rahi thi; rashtriyakaran ke baad bankon ki shakhaon ka vistar gaon-gaon tak hua. 20 tatha 6 vikalp doosre charan ya kul ginti se juda hai tatha 8 koi sahi aankda nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: 1969 mein pehle charan mein 14 bankon ka rashtriyakaran hua tha - 1980 mein 6 anya bankon ka bhi hua.

qe: What is 'Fiat Money'?
qh: 'फिएट मनी' (Fiat Money) क्या है?
e: Fiat money wo mudra hoti hai jise sarkar ke aadesh tatha kanun ne manayta di hoti hai; yaani uske peeche sona ya chaandi ka bhandar nahi hota balki sarkar ke bharose par usaki keemat manti hai tatha wo kanuni nivedan (legal tender) hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aaj ka rupaya tatha dollar isi tarah ki mudra hai, kyunki jis vyakti ko diya jaata hai ushe us par bharosa hota hai ki wo usse maal kharid sakega; isi bharose se poora vyapar chalta hai. Sone se backed mudra tatha plastic money alag avdharnaen hain tatha 'None of these' ka koi aadhaar nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: fiat money sarkar ke aadesh par chalti hai - iske peeche sona nahi hota balki sarkar ki manayta hoti hai.

qe: What is 'M1' money supply also called?
qh: 'M1' मुद्रा आपूर्ति को और क्या कहा जाता है?
e: M1 mudra aapurti ko 'sankuchit mudra' (narrow money) kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein janata ke paas maujood mudra, bankon mein maang jama (demand deposits) tatha RBI ke paas anya jama shamil hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye sabhi rup rojmarra ke len-den mein turant istemal ho sakte hain, isliye M1 sabse adhik taralta (liquidity) wala paimana maana jaata hai. Credit money, broad money tatha 'None of these' wale vikalp kisi doosre star (M3 tatha M4) ko darshate hain ya asambhav hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: M1 ko sankuchit (narrow) mudra kaha jaata hai - yahi sabse zyada taralta wali mudra aapurti hoti hai.

qe: Which of the following is called 'Broad Money'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से किसे 'व्यापक मुद्रा' (Broad Money) कहा जाता है?
e: Broad money (vyapak mudra) M3 ko kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein M1 ke saath-saath bankon ke paas samay jama (time deposits) bhi joda jaata hai. Isi karan ye aapurti ka sabse zyada istemal hone wala paimana hai tatha mehngai tatha maang ka vishleshan karne ke liye RBI isi aankde ko dekhta hai; M1 se bada hone ke karan yahi 'vyapak' kehlata hai. M1 sankuchit mudra hai, M2 mein post office bachat jodi jaati hai tatha M4 mein post office ki jama bhi shamil hoti hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: M3 ko vyapak mudra kaha jaata hai - yahi sankuchit mudra M1 tatha samay jama ko milakar banta hai.

qe: What is the total number of members in the 'Monetary Policy Committee' (MPC)?
qh: 'मौद्रिक नीति समिति' (MPC) में कुल कितने सदस्य होते हैं?
e: Mudra niti samiti (MPC) mein kul 6 sadasya hote hain, jinmein 3 sadasya RBI se hote hain (Governor, Deputy Governor tatha ek RBI adhikari) tatha 3 sadasya Bharat Sarkar nomit karti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki byaj ki dar tay karne ke nirnay mein kendriya bank ki visheshgyata tatha sarkar ki drishti dono shamil rahein, isliye barabar sadasyon wala dhaancha banaya gaya; nirnay bahumat (majority) se hote hain. 10, 3 tatha 5 wale ank kisi sahi ginti ko nahi darshate, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: MPC mein kul 6 sadasya hote hain - 3 RBI ke tatha 3 sarkar nomit.

qe: What is 'Deflation'?
qh: 'अपस्फीति' (Deflation) क्या है?
o: Persistent fall in general price level
e: Apasphiti (deflation) ka matlab hai kul keemat star ka lagatar girna; iske karan rupaye ki kharid-shakti badh jaati hai par log kharch talte hain kyunki unhe lagta hai keematen aur girenge. Isi karan yeh mudrasphiti se ulta hai tatha isse utpadan, munafa tatha rojgar ghata kar mandi (recession) aa sakti hai; isliye kendriya bank aise samay mein byaj ki darein ghata kar logon ko karz lene ke liye protsahit karta hai. Aay ka badhna ya keematon ka chadhna mudrasphiti se juda hai tatha usse alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: apasphiti kul keemat star ka lagatar girtav hai - ismein paise ki value badhti hai par mandi ka khatra ban jaata hai.

qe: Which index is used to measure 'Retail Inflation' in India?
qh: भारत में 'खुदरा मुद्रास्फीति' मापने के लिए किस सूचकांक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: Bharat mein khudra (retail) mudrasphiti maapne ke liye CPI (Combined) ka istemal hota hai, kyunki yahi aam upabhokta ke rozmarra kharidne wali vastuen tatha sevaon ki keemat badlav dikhata hai. Isi karan mehngai ke aankde aam taur par CPI par hi bataye jaate hain tatha RBI apni mudra niti mein isi ko lakshya (target) maanta hai; WPI thok star par bade vyapar ke keemat se juda hai. Sensex share bazaar ka soochak hai tatha GDP deflator poore GDP ka mulya samsodhak hai, isliye wo vikalp khudra mehngai ke sahi paimane nahi hain. Exam point: khudra mudrasphiti ke liye CPI (Combined) ka istemal hota hai - yahi upabhokta ke drishtikon se keemat badlav dikhata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chairman' of the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)?
qh: मौद्रिक नीति समिति (MPC) का 'अध्यक्ष' कौन होता है?
e: Mudra niti samiti ka adhyaksh RBI ka Governor hota hai, isliye wo paden (ex-officio) adhyaksh hote hain; unke paas nirnay mein vishesh matadhikar (casting vote) bhi hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mudra tatha banking par sabse gehri samajh RBI ke paas hoti hai tatha Governor hi poore banking tatha taralta ke prathmindar hote hain, isliye adhyakshta unhi ko di gayi. Vitta Sachiv tatha Vitta Mantri rajkoshiya niti se tatha NITI Aayog ka mukhya adhikari niti salah se juda hote hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: MPC ka adhyaksh RBI Governor hota hai - yahi paden roop se samiti ki adhyakshta karte hain.

qe: What is 'Hyperinflation'?
qh: 'हाइपरइन्फ्लेशन' (Hyperinflation) क्या है?
o: Extremely rapid and out of control inflation
e: Hyperinflation wo halat hai jismein keematen behad tezi se tatha niyantran se bahar ho kar badhti hain; ise aam taur par aankda tay kiya jaata hai ki keematen ek mahine mein 50 pratishat se zyada badh jaayein. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise samay mein mudra ki keemat din-din par girti hai, logon ka vishwas uth jaata hai tatha wo paisa rakhne ke bajaye turant maal kharid lete hain, isse mehngai aur badh jaati hai. Keematon ka dheema badhna tatha keematon ka girna is se alag surat hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hyperinflation behad tez tatha niyantran se bahar mehngai hoti hai - ismein keematen mahine mein 50 pratishat se zyada badh sakti hain.

qe: Which organization calculates the 'WPI' (Wholesale Price Index) in India?
qh: भारत में 'WPI' (थोक मूल्य सूचकांक) की गणना कौन करता है?
e: Thok mulya soochak (WPI) ki ganna tatha prakashan Office of the Economic Adviser karta hai, jo DPIIT tatha Vanijya tatha Udyog Mantralaya ke antargat aata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki thok mulya ka aankda udyog tatha vyapar ke bade len-den se juda hota hai, isliye ise vanijya sambandhi sanstha nikaalti hai; aaj isi ke saath WPI ke aankde har mahine jaari hote hain. NSO CPI ki ganna karta hai tatha RBI tatha Vitta Mantralaya mudra tatha budget se juda kaam dekhte hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: WPI ki ganna Office of Economic Adviser (DPIIT) karta hai - yahi Vanijya tatha Udyog Mantralaya ke antargat aata hai.

qe: What happens to the 'Money Supply' if RBI 'Increases' the Repo Rate?
qh: यदि RBI रेपो रेट 'बढ़ाता' है, तो 'मुद्रा आपूर्ति' का क्या होता है?
e: Repo rate mein badhotri ka asar yahi hota hai ki bankon ke liye RBI se udhaar lena mehanga pad jaata hai; isliye bank khud ghata karz lete hain tatha grahakon ko bhi mahange byaj par loan dete hain. Isi karan bazaar mein paisa aane ki raftar ghat jaati hai tatha mudra aapurti kam ho jaati hai; yahi tareeka mehngai par lagam lagane ke liye istemal hota hai. Maang tatha nivesh kam hone se utpadan bhi sambhalta hai tatha keematen tatha mudra aapurti dono ghat jate hain. Same ya badhne wale vikalp galat thehrte hain, kyunki repo badhne ka asar mudra aapurti ghatne ke roop mein hi dikhta hai. Exam point: repo rate badhne par mudra aapurti kam ho jaati hai - karz mehanga hone se bazaar mein paisa ghat jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Hard Money'?
qh: 'हार्ड मनी' (Hard Money) क्या है?
o: Currency that is globally stable and trusted
e: Hard money wo mudra hoti hai antarrashtriya bazaar mein sthir tatha vishwasniya maani jaati hai tatha jise desh tatha vyapari bina hichakichah ke sweekar karte hain; dolar, euro tatha yen iske udaharan hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki aisi mudra ke peeche mazboot arthavyavastha tatha sthirtata hoti hai, isliye ye videshi vyapar tatha bhandar (reserve) rakhne ke liye pasand ki jaati hai. Sirf sikkhon ko hard money kehna ya mushkil se kamane wali kamai ko is naam se bulana aarthik shabdkosh ke anusaar galat hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: hard money wo mudra hoti hai jo duniya bhar mein sthir tatha vishwasniya ho - jaise dolar tatha euro.

qe: What is the 'Cheap Money Policy'?
qh: 'चीप मनी पॉलिसी' (सस्ती मुद्रा नीति) क्या है?
e: Cheap money policy wo niti hai jismein kendriya bank byaj ki dar ghata deta hai taaki bankon ke liye tatha aam logon ke liye karz sasta ban jaaye; isse nivesh tatha khapat badhti hai tatha rozgar ke avsar paida hote hain. Ise isliye istemal kiya jaata hai ki mandi ke samay maang kam ho jaati hai, isliye ghata karz naye karkhane tatha ghar ke nirmaan ko bahaara dilata hai; yahi maujuda daur mein 'sasta paisa' ki dhaarna hai. Uchch kar niti tatha nakli (jali) mudra wale vikalp is niti se alag baat karte hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: cheap money policy mein byaj ki darein ghatai jaati hain - isi se karz sasta hokar nivesh tatha khapat badhti hai.

qe: What is 'Devaluation' of currency?
qh: मुद्रा का 'अवमूल्यन' (Devaluation) क्या है?
o: Deliberate reduction in value of currency by govt
e: Avmulyan (devaluation) ka matlab hai sarkar dwara apni mudra ki keemat jaanbujhkar ghata kar fix ki gayi dar (fixed exchange rate) mein kami karna; ise aam taur par niryat badhane tatha aayat ghatane ke liye kiya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mudra sasti hone par videshi kharidaron ko saman sasta padta hai, isliye niryat badhti hai tatha desh ko videshi mudra prapt hoti hai. Keematon ka badhna ya mudra ke moolya mein swayam se hone wali girawat is kriya se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: avmulyan sarkar dwara jaanbujhkar ki gayi mudra ki keemat ki kami hoti hai - yahi niryat badhane ke liye kiya jaata hai.

qe: The 'Imperial Bank of India' was later renamed as:
qh: 'इंपीरियल बैंक ऑफ इंडिया' का नाम बदलकर बाद में क्या कर दिया गया?
e: Imperial Bank of India ka naam badalkar 1955 mein State Bank of India (SBI) rakha gaya; yahi Imperial Bank 1921 mein teen bade bankon - Bank of Bengal, Bank of Bombay tatha Bank of Madras - ko milakar bana tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki azaadi ke baad gaon tatha kheti tak banking pahunchane ke liye 1955 mein SBI ko banaaya gaya, jise RBI ke adhinasth bhi rakha gaya; isi ke baad SBI ki sahayak banken bhi khuli. PNB tatha Bank of India usi daur ke anya bank hain tatha RBI alag sanstha hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: Imperial Bank of India ka naam badalkar 1955 mein State Bank of India (SBI) rakha gaya - yahi gaon-kheti tak banking pahunchane ke liye kiya gaya.

qe: What is 'Legal Tender'?
qh: 'लीगल टेंडर' (वैध मुद्रा) क्या है?
o: Money that cannot be refused by law for debt payment
e: Legal tender wo mudra hoti hai jise kanuni roop se karz ke bhugtan ke liye thukraya nahi ja sakta; yani agar koi vyakti rupaye ke note zariye karz chukana chahta hai to praptakarta use manne ke liye badhya hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkar ki manayta se hi mudra ko vyavahar mein bal milta hai, isliye ise 'kanooni nivedan' kehte hain; aaj jari note tatha sikkhe isi shreni mein aate hain. Cheque tatha credit card kanooni taur par turant sweekrit karne ke liye badhya nahi hote, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: legal tender wo mudra hai jise karz chukane ke liye thukraya nahi ja sakta - note tatha sikkhe isi shreni mein aate hain.

qe: Which sector is 'Banking' part of?
qh: 'बैंकिंग' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है?
e: Banking kshetra tertiary (seva) kshetra ka hissa hai, kyunki yahan jama lena, karz dena, bhugtan karna tatha bache lene dena jaise seva ka kaam hote hain; koi vastu banti nahi. Iska karan yahi hai ki bank jaan-pahchan tatha vishwas ke aadhaar par paisa tatha sevaon ka pratiyer (transfer) karta hai, isliye yahi arthavyavastha ki sabse aavashyak seva ka kshetra hai. Primary kheti-khanan se tatha secondary karkhane se juda hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: banking tertiary kshetra mein aata hai - yahi arthavyavastha ko di jaane wali seva hai.

qe: What is 'Bad Debt' in banking called?
qh: बैंकिंग में 'बैड डेट' (खराब ऋण) को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Banking mein wo karz 'bad debt' tatha NPA (Non-Performing Asset) kehlata hai jiska mool tatha byaj 90 din se zyada samay tak wapas nahi aata; yani woh asset hona band ho jaata hai jis se aay aa rahi ho. Iska karan yahi hai ki aisa karz bank ke munaafe tatha uski nivesh-shakti dono ko kha jaata hai, isliye RBI alag-alag kategarion (sub-standard, doubtful tatha loss asset) mein NPA ki nigrani karta hai. Liabilities tatha assets bank ke lekhajokhe ke anya madan hote hain, isliye wo vikalp is prashn ke sahi jod nahi hain. Exam point: kharab karz ko NPA (gaer-nishpadit sampatti) kaha jaata hai - yahi 90 din se adhik samay tak vasool na hone wala karz hota hai.

qe: What is the 'Time Limit' for a loan to be classified as NPA?
qh: किसी ऋण को NPA के रूप में वर्गीकृत करने की 'समय सीमा' क्या है?
e: Kisi karz ko NPA ke roop mein vargikrit karne ki samay seema 90 din hoti hai; yani yadi karz ka bhugtan lagaatar 90 din tak nahi aata to bank ushe NPA ke roop mein likh leta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki 90 din ki seema se pata chalta hai ki grahak bhugtan karne mein asamarth hai, isliye bank us karz par aay ki ganna band kar deta hai tatha vasooli ki karvai shuru karta hai. 30 tatha 60 din ke aankde khaate mein kaam nahi aate tatha 180 din ki avadhi bohat lambi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: karz ko NPA maan'ne ke liye 90 din ki samay seema hoti hai - iske baad mool tatha byaj ka bhugtan bakaya rehta hai.

qe: What is 'Call Money'?
qh: 'कॉल मनी' (Call Money) क्या है?
e: Call money wo dhan hai jo bank ek din ya bahut kam samay ke liye doosre bankon se uthaate hain; yahi inter-bank alpakalik len-den ki mukhya kadi hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki kisi bank ke paas kisi din nagi (cash) ki kami ho jaati hai tatha doosre bank ke paas adhik rah jaata hai, isliye dar aankde-par-aankde badalti rehti hai tatha RBI is vayaparik dar-par bhi najar rakhta hai. Credit card ki seema ya ek varsh ka karz is dhan-roop se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi; 'None of these' ka koi aadhaar nahi. Exam point: call money bankon ke beech ek din ke liye udhaar liya jaane wala dhan hota hai - yahi inter-bank alpakalik len-den hai.

qe: Where is the 'Headquarters' of RBI located?
qh: RBI का 'मुख्यालय' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: RBI ka mukhyalay Mumbai mein sthit hai, jabki shuruaat mein 1935 mein ye Kolkata mein tha; 1937 mein ise Mumbai shift kiya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki Mumbai Bharat ka sabse bada vitti tatha vyaparik kendra tha, isliye banking tatha mudra ke nirnay wahan se chalana zyada upyukt maana gaya; aaj bhi RBI ki kendriya karyalay wahi hai. Kolkata, Delhi tatha Chennai mein RBI ke karyalay hain par mukhyalay nahi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ka mukhyalay Mumbai mein hai - shuru mein Kolkata se 1937 mein yahan shift kiya gaya tha.

qe: What is 'Plastic Money'?
qh: 'प्लास्टिक मनी' क्या है?
e: Plastic money se tatparya credit tatha debit card se hai, kyunki inka istemal bank ke khaate se bhugtan karne ke liye kiya jaata hai tatha ye nakad ya cheque ke badle aadhunik bazaar mein rozmarra ke bhugtan ka sadhan ban gaye hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki card ek 'plastik' ki patti hota hai jis par dhantiyan (magnetic chip) lagi hoti hain, isliye bina paisa liye-khare hue bhi len-den poora ho jaata hai; ab mobile-wallet bhi isi shreni mein joda jaata hai. Plastik se bani mudra tatha khilone ka paisa is shabda se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: plastic money credit tatha debit card ko kaha jaata hai - isi se bina nakad bhugtan hota hai.

qe: What is a 'Demand Draft' (DD)?
qh: 'डिमांड ड्राफ्ट' (DD) क्या है?
o: A negotiable instrument issued by a bank
e: Demand Draft ek aisa negotiable instrument hai jo bank apne grahak ke aadesh par jari karta hai; ismein rakam pehle hi bank ke paas jama hoti hai, isliye ye cheque ki tarah bounce nahi ho sakta. Iska karan yahi hai ki fund ki upasthiti pehle hi sunishchit kar li jaati hai, isliye BHU (bhaari bhugtan) tatha bhugtan-vishwas ke liye DD ko zyada bharosemand maana jaata hai; isi karan pracchayan tatha bhugtan mein iska istemal hota hai. Nakad ya vyaktigat cheque wale vikalp DD ki asli pehchaan nahi hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: DD bank dwara jari kiya jaane wala aisa instrument hai jo bounce nahi hota - kyunki rakam pehle hi jama kara di jaati hai.

qe: What is an 'Inflationary Gap'?
qh: 'मुद्रास्फीति अंतराल' क्या है?
e: Madrasphiti antral (inflationary gap) ka matlab hai poorn rojgar sthan par kul maang ka kul aapurti se adhik ho jaana; yani desh ki utpadan kshamata se zyada kharidne ki shakti bazaar mein maujood ho jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki maang tatha aapurti ka antar bane rehne par keematen upar chadhne lagti hain, isliye yahi antral mehngai ka karan banta hai; Keynes ne is avdharna se yahi bataya ki khapat badhane par keematen kaise bhaagti hain. Budget ka antral ya kam maang is se alag baat hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: madrasphiti antral poorn rojgar par maang ki adhikta hai - isse moolya star upar chadh jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Gresham's Law'?
qh: 'ग्रेशम का नियम' (Gresham's Law) क्या है?
e: Gresham ka niyam kehta hai ki 'ghatiya mudra achhi mudra ko bazaar se bahar kar deti hai'; yani jab ek hi samay mein achhi tatha ghatiya mudra sath-sath chalein to log achhi mudra ko sambhal (hoard) kar rakhte hain tatha ghatiya mudra se len-den karte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki achhi mudra bikharne ki bajaye bachat ke roop mein ghar mein rakh li jaati hai, isliye bazaar mein keval ghatiya mudra hi dikhai deti hai; yahi niyam mudra ki ghatiya tatha adhik moolya wali avasthaon mein dikhta hai. Uchch kar tatha 'achhi mudra ghatiya ko bhagaati hai' wale vikalp niyam ke ulta hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: Gresham ka niyam kehta hai ki ghatiya mudra achhi mudra ko chalan se bahar kar deti hai - achhi mudra log jama kar lete hain.

qe: Which sector's inflation is measured by 'WPI'?
qh: 'WPI' द्वारा किस क्षेत्र की मुद्रास्फीति मापी जाती है?
e: WPI dwara keval vastuon (goods) ki thok mudrasphiti maapi jaati hai, kyunki ismein khanij, kheti-upja tatha banaye gaye maal ki keemat shamil hoti hai tatha sevaon ki keemat ismein nahi aati. Iska karan yahi hai ki thok bazaar mein vyapari bade roop mein maal kharidte-beichte hain, isliye yahi soochak utpadak tatha vyapari ke keemat-par-padne wale dabav dikhata hai. Sevayen tatha khudra bazaar ki keemat CPI mein shamil hoti hain, isliye 'service' tatha 'agriculture only' wale vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: WPI dwara keval vastuon ki thok mehngai maapi jaati hai - ismein sevaen shamil nahi hoti, wo CPI dekhta hai.

qe: What is 'Marginal Standing Facility' (MSF)?
qh: 'सीमांत स्थायी सुविधा' (MSF) क्या है?
o: RBI lending to banks for 14 days
Overnight lending by RBI to banks
e: MSF (Marginal Standing Facility) ek aisi suvidha hai jismein bank apni sankat ke samay RBI se raat-bhar ke liye (overnight) karz le sakte hain; ye repo rate se thodi upar ki dar par di jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ise 'sabse akhir vikalp' (last resort) ke roop mein rakha gaya hai, taaki bank ke paas nagi ki turant kami ho to wo sanstha ke bharose doob na jaaye; iske liye bank apni SLR wali sarkari prathibhutiyan bhi girvi rakh sakte hain. Kheti ka karz tatha 14 din wala karz is suvidha se alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: MSF ke tehat bank RBI se raat-bhar ke liye karz le sakte hain - yahi repo rate se upar wali aapatti dar hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of IFSC?
qh: IFSC का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: IFSC ka poora roop Indian Financial System Code hai; ye 11 akshar-ank wala kod hota hai jo bank ke har shakha ki alag pehchan batata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki online NEFT, RTGS tatha IMPS ke bheje gaye paise ko sahi shakha tak pahunchana hota hai, isliye har shakha ko ek vishisht kod diya jaata hai; ismein jankari ka pehla hissa bank tatha baad ka hissa shakha batata hai. Baaki vikalp jaali vistar hain tatha IFSC ke sahi akshar nahi hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: IFSC ka matlab Indian Financial System Code hai - yahi bank ki shakha ki pehchan karne wala kod hai.

qe: What is 'Dematerialization' (Demat) in banking/trading?
qh: बैंकिंग/ट्रेडिंग में 'डिमैटरियलाइजेशन' (Demat) क्या है?
o: Converting physical shares into electronic form
e: Demat (dematerialization) ka matlab hai share tatha anya prathibhutiyon ke kagaz Wale praman-patra ko hataakar unhe elektronik (daigital) roop mein badal dena; iske liye depository (NSDL tatha CDSL) ke saath khaata khola jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki elektronik roop mein share turant kharide-beche ja sakte hain tatha chori tatha nakli certificate ka khatra ghat jaata hai, isliye aaj share bazaar mein trading ke liye demat khaata anivarya hai. Kagaz Wale note tatha khaata band karna is se alag kaam hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: dematerialization ka matlab kagaz Wale share ko elektronik roop mein badalna hai - share bazaar mein trading ke liye yahi anivarya hai.

qe: Who was the 'First Governor' of RBI?
qh: RBI के 'पहले गवर्नर' कौन थे?
e: RBI ke pehle Governor Sir Osborne Smith the, jinhone 1935 se 1937 tak kaam kiya; yahi sanstha ki shuruaati neev tatha banking vyavastha ko sthapit karne mein lage rahe. Iska karan yahi hai ki tab RBI naya-naya bana tha tatha videshi anubhav wale adhikari ko sanstha ka pehla pramukh banaya gaya; unke baad anya Governor aate rahe. C.D. Deshmukh pehle Bharatiya Governor the, Urjit Patel tatha Manmohan Singh baad ke Governor the, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ke pehle Governor Sir Osborne Smith the - unhone 1935 se 1937 tak sanstha ki adhyakshta ki.

qe: Who was the 'First Indian Governor' of RBI?
qh: RBI के 'पहले भारतीय गवर्नर' कौन थे?
e: RBI ke pehle Bharatiya Governor C.D. Deshmukh the, jo 1943 mein is pad par aaye tatha 1949 tak rahe; azaadi ke baad unhone mudra tatha banking ko nayi disha di. Iska karan yahi hai ki tab rashtriya bhavnaon (sentiment) bhi badal raha tha tatha bharatiya adhikari ko pramukh banane se sanstha ka lokatantrik chehra ubhara. Osborne Smith pehle videshi Governor the, Raghuram Rajan tatha Shaktikanta Das aaj ke daur ke Governor hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: RBI ke pehle Bharatiya Governor C.D. Deshmukh the - jo 1943 mein is pad par aaye.

qe: What is a 'White Label ATM'?
qh: 'व्हाइट लेबल ATM' क्या है?
e: White label ATM wo ATM hote hain jo bank ke bajaye kisi anya (non-bank) sanstha dwara lagaye tatha chalaye jaate hain; jaise Tata IndiCash jaise white-label ATM. Iska karan yahi hai ki chhote kasbon tatha door ke gaon mein bank ATM lagane ke liye nivesh nahi karte, isliye sarkar ne gair-bank sansthaon ko bhi ATM lagane ki chhoot di, taaki paisa nikalna-paana aasaan ho. SBI dwara lagaya gaya ATM tatha nishulk ATM wale vikalp is shabda ki asli paribhasha se alag hain. Exam point: white label ATM gair-bank sanstha dwara lagaye tatha chalaye jaate hain - yahi door ke ilaqon mein banking suvidha badhate hain.

qe: Which organization regulates 'Capital Markets' in India?
qh: भारत में 'पूंजी बाजार' (Capital Market) को कौन नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Bharat mein poonji bazaar (capital market) ko SEBI niyantrit karta hai; yahi share bazaar, mutual fund, tatha brokeron ki nigrani karta hai tatha niveshkar ke hiton ki raksha karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki 1988 mein SEBI ki sthapna hui tatha 1992 mein ushe kanun dwara bade adhikar mile, jiske baad ghotalon tatha gadbadiyon par lagam lagai ja sake. IRDAI bima kshetra dekhta hai, RBI bank tatha mudra par najar rakhta hai tatha Vitta Mantralaya budget banata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: poonji bazaar ko SEBI niyantrit karta hai - yahi share bazaar tatha niveshkar ki raksha ka kaam dekhta hai.

qe: What is 'Credit Rationing'?
qh: 'क्रेडिट राशनिंग' क्या है?
o: Restricting the amount of loans to certain sectors
e: Credit rationing ka matlab hai kendriya bank dwara karz ki matara par seema lagana ya tay kar dena ki kis kshetra ko kitna karz milega; yahi maundrik niti ka gunatmak (qualitative) hathiyaar maana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki isse sirf kisano, chhote udyogon tatha kamzor vargon ko zarurat ke hisaab se karz mil sake, jabki diye gaye kshetra mein paisa ka bahav rok diya jaaye. Aniyantrit karz dene tatha adhik mudra chhapne wale vikalp isse alag hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: credit rationing mein karz ki matara tay ki jaati hai - yahi maundrik niti ka gunatmak upay hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of MICR in cheques?
qh: चेक में MICR का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: MICR ka poora roop Magnetic Ink Character Recognition hota hai; chek ke niche jo 9 ank ki kaali-rekha code dikhti hai, wo isi magnetik syahi se chhapi hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye chhapabank shakha ka kod, desh ka kod tatha chek number ko machine ki madad se padh leti hai, isliye chek ki praptikaran (clearing) bahut tez tatha sahi tarike se hoti hai. Baaki vikalp MICR ke akshar nahi batate, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: MICR ka matlab Magnetic Ink Character Recognition hai - yahi chek par lagne wale magnetik syahi wale kod ki vidhi hai.

qe: Which organization insures bank deposits in India?
qh: भारत में बैंक जमा का बीमा कौन सी संस्था करती है?
e: Bharat mein bank jama ka bima DICGC (Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation) karta hai; ye 1961 mein bana tatha RBI ka hi ek anushangik (subsidiary) sanstha hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yadi koi bank doob jaaye to chhoti bachati rakhne wale logon ko suraksha mil sake, isliye har jama ke 5 lakh rupaye tak ka bima milta hai. RBI khud bankon ka regulator hai, LIC jeevan bima karta hai tatha SEBI share bazaar dekhta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bank jama ka bima DICGC karta hai - yahi ab 5 lakh rupaye tak ki jama ko suraksha deta hai.

qe: What is the 'Fiscal Year' in India?
qh: भारत में 'वित्तीय वर्ष' क्या है?
e: Bharat ka vitti varsh 1 April se 31 March tak chalta hai, yani April-March ka chakra; isi avadhi mein sarkar ka budget tatha lekha-jokha hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki vasuli tatha kharch ka chakra kharif tatha rabi faslon ke hisaab se banaya gaya, taaki kar tatha kharch ki yojana asli kamai ke samay se mel khaaye; isi karan aaj bhi yahi avadhi chalti hai. January-December tatha July-June ke vikalp anya deshon ki parampara se juda hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: Bharat ka vitti varsh 1 April se 31 March tak hota hai - sarkar ka poora lekha-jokha isi avadhi mein hota hai.

qe: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the 'Annual Financial Statement' (Budget)?
qh: भारतीय संविधान का कौन सा अनुच्छेद 'वार्षिक वित्तीय विवरण' (बजट) से संबंधित है?
e: Sanvidhan ka Article 112 varshik vitti vivran se juda hai; ismein sarkar ek varsh ke anumanit aay tatha vyay ka poora hisaab rakhti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sanvidhan mein 'budget' shabd ka ullekh nahi hai, isliye ushe 'Annual Financial Statement' naam diya gaya; yahi lakshya hajar mein rakhkar sansad mein rakha tatha manzoor karaya jaata hai. Article 110 money bill se, Article 280 vitta aayog se tatha Article 360 vitti aapatti se juda hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: varshik vitti vivran (budget) Article 112 se juda hai - sanvidhan mein ise 'Annual Financial Statement' kaha gaya hai.

qe: What is 'Fiscal Deficit'?
qh: 'राजकोषीय घाटा' (Fiscal Deficit) क्या है?
e: Rajkoshiya ghata (fiscal deficit) nikalne ka tarika yahi hai ki sarkar ke kul vyay mein se kul praptiyon (udhaar ko chhodkar) ko ghata diya jaaye; yahi sarkar ki kul udhaar lene ki zarurat batata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki vyay prapti se zyada hone par ee antar udhaar se bhara jaata hai, isliye isi ghate se sarkar ki karz anivarya tatha rajkoshiya sayyam ka andaza milta hai; ye GDP ke pratishat mein bhi bataya jaata hai. Aayat- niryat ka antar vyapar santulan hai tatha aay-vyay ka antar kuchh aur batata hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rajkoshiya ghata = kul vyay - kul praptiyan (udhaar chhodkar) - yahi sarkar ki udhaar zarurat dikhata hai.

qe: What is 'Revenue Deficit'?
qh: 'राजस्व घाटा' (Revenue Deficit) क्या है?
e: Rajsv ghata (revenue deficit) tab hota hai jab sarkar ka rojmarra ka vyay uski rojmarra ki aay (kar tatha gair-kar rajasv) se zyada ho jaaye; yani rajv vyay mein se rajv praptiyan ghata kar ye nikalta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ise pate wale vyay se bharna padta hai tatha yahi sarkar ki niyamit aay tatha kharch ke antar ka asli chitra dikhata hai; isliye aarthik sujhav is ghate ko ghatane ki salah dete hain. Kul karz ya kar tatha sahayata ka jod is ghate ki sahi paribhasha nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: rajv ghata = rajv vyay - rajv praptiyan - yahi sarkar ke niyamit kharch tatha aay ka antar batata hai.

qe: Which of the following is a 'Direct Tax'?
qh: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा एक 'प्रत्यक्ष कर' है?
e: Pratyaksh kar wo hota hai jiska bhugtan seedha sarkar ko kiya jaata hai tatha jiska bojh kisi anya par nahi daala jaa sakta; aaykar tatha nigam kar isi shreni mein aate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein kar denewala tatha bhugtan karnewala ek hi vyakti hota hai, isliye iska asar seedha aay par padta hai; isi karan ye vivek tatha samanta ke liye ahem paimana banta hai. GST, service tax tatha excise duty apratyaksh kar hain, kyunki ve maal tatha sevaon ke daam mein shamil ho jaate hain tatha unka bojh grahak par padta hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: aaykar ek pratyaksh kar hai - ise seedha sarkar ko diya jaata hai tatha iska bojh aage nahi bheja ja sakta.

qe: When was 'GST' (Goods and Services Tax) implemented in India?
qh: भारत में 'GST' (वस्तु एवं सेवा कर) कब लागू किया गया था?
e: GST ko 1 July 2017 se poore desh mein lagu kiya gaya tha, tatha ise ek hi desh ek kar tatha ek bazaar ki soch par banaya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki iske pehle kai aalag-alag apratyaksh kar tatha rajyon ke seema-shulk (octroi) chalte the, isliye maal ek rajyon se doosre rajyon jaane par baar-baar kar lagta tha; GST ne unhe ek kar mein badal diya. 2017 ke baaki mahine tatha 15 August laagu hone ki koi sahi tarikh nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: GST 1 July 2017 ko lagu kiya gaya - yahi 'ek desh ek kar ek bazaar' ki soch par aadhaar hai.

qe: Which Constitutional Amendment Act paved the way for GST?
qh: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम ने GST के लिए रास्ता साफ किया?
e: GST ke liye rasta 101st Sanvidhan Sanshodhan Adhiniyam, 2016 ne saaf kiya, jiske dwara rajya tatha kendra dono ko ek saath GST lagane ka adhikar diya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki isse pehle kar lagane ka adhikar tatha vibhajan keval rajya ya kendra ke paas tha, isliye sanshodhan ke bina samanvit kar sambhav nahi tha; isi sanshodhan se GST Council jaisi sanstha bhi bani. 122nd, 100th tatha 'None of these' wale vikalp kisi anya vishay se juda hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: GST ke liye 101st Sanvidhan Sanshodhan Adhiniyam, 2016 rasta saaf karta hai - usi se kendra tatha rajya dono ko kar lagane ka adhikar mila.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of GSTN?
qh: GSTN का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: GSTN ka poora roop Goods and Services Tax Network hai; yahi GST ke registration, bhugtan tatha riyams (returns) ki poori online vyavastha chalata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ek digital network ke bina poore desh ke kar-datataon tatha vyapariyon ka lekha jokha sambhalna asambhav hota, isliye ise sarkar tatha niji kshetra ke saajhe (joint) sahyog se banaaya gaya. Baaki vikalp GSTN ke akshar nahi hain, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: GSTN ka matlab Goods and Services Tax Network hai - yahi GST ki online vyavastha chalata hai.

qe: Who is the 'Chairman' of the GST Council?
qh: GST परिषद का 'अध्यक्ष' कौन होता है?
e: GST Council ka adhyaksh kendra ka Vitta Mantri hota hai, jabki rajya ke vitta mantri tatha kendra ke rajya-mantri sadasya hote hain; nirnay 3/4 bahumat se hote hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki GST mein kendra tatha rajya dono ke kar shamil hote hain, isliye dono ki salah ke liye sammelan (council) banaya gaya; kendra ka vote wazan tatha rajya ka milakar faisla hota hai. RBI Governor tatha NITI Aayog ke CEO is sammelan ke sadan nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: GST Council ka adhyaksh kendra ka Vitta Mantri hota hai - isi council ke nirnay se GST ki daren tay hoti hain.

qe: What is 'Proportional Tax'?
qh: 'आनुपातिक कर' क्या है?
o: Tax rate remains constant for all income levels
