e: Anupatik (proportional) kar wo hota hai jismein sab logon ki aay ka ek hi pratishat kar ke roop mein liya jaata hai; yani 10 pratishat ki dar sabhi par ek jaisi lagti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein kar ki dar nahi badalti, isliye amir tatha garib dono apni aay ka barabar hissa dete hain; ise 'samantar kar' bhi kehte hain. Aay badhne par dar badhne wala vikalp pragatishil kar hai tatha dar ghatne wala pratigami kar, isliye wo dono sahi nahi hain. Exam point: anupatik kar mein dar sabhi aay staron ke liye saman rehti hai - sabhi apni aay ka ek hi pratishat dete hain.

qe: What is 'Progressive Tax'?
qh: 'प्रगतिशील कर' (Progressive Tax) क्या है?
o: Tax rate increases as income increases
e: Pragatishil (progressive) kar wo hota hai jismein aay badhne ke saath kar ki dar bhi badhti jaati hai; isliye amir logon par kar ka bojh thoda adhik hota hai. Bharat ka aaykar isi soch par chalta hai, jismein aay ke slab badhne par dar 5 se 30 pratishat tak pahunch jaati hai; yahi kar samanta laane ka sabse aam tareeka hai. Nirdharit (fixed) tatha aay badhne par dar ghatne wale vikalp anya prakar ke kar hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: pragatishil kar mein aay badhne par dar badhti hai - isi karan ise samanta badhane wala kar kaha jaata hai.

qe: Which 'Five Year Plan' (FYP) focused on 'Garibi Hatao' (Poverty Alleviation)?
qh: किस 'पंचवर्षीय योजना' में 'गरीबी हटाओ' का नारा दिया गया था?
e: Garibi hatao ka nara panchvi panchvarshiya yojana (1974-78) mein diya gaya tha; is yojana ka mukhya dhyan garibi unmulan, rojgar tatha aur nyay par tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki us daur mein bhookh, mehngai tatha bekarri ne sarkar ko garibi hatane ke liye khaas karyakram shuru karne par majboor kiya, isliye 'garibi hatao' is yojana ki pehchan ban gaya. Teesri, chaturth tatha chhathi yojanaon ka focus kheti, udyog tatha nivesh ke anya pehlu the, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: garibi hatao ka nara panchvi panchvarshiya yojana mein diya gaya tha - yahi garibi unmulan ko mukhya lakshya banane wali yojana thi.

qe: Who is known as the 'Father of Indian Planning'?
qh: 'भारतीय नियोजन के जनक' के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
e: Bharatiya niyojan ke janak M. Visvesvaraya ko maana jaata hai, kyunki unhone 1934 mein 'Planned Economy for India' naam ki pustak likhkar desh mein niyojan ki soch ka beej boya. Iska karan yahi hai ki azaadi se pehle hi unhone kheti, udyog tatha taknik ko jodkar vikas ka khaka tayar kiya, isliye niyojan ki parampara unse hi maani jaati hai. Dadabhai Naoroji rashtriya aay ke pehle anumaan se, Jawaharlal Nehru azaadi ke baad ki niyojan niti se tatha Mahalanobis doosri yojana ke model se juda hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: bharatiya niyojan ke janak M. Visvesvaraya hain - unhone 1934 mein 'Planned Economy for India' likhi thi.

qe: Which model was the 'First Five Year Plan' based on?
qh: 'पहली पंचवर्षीय योजना' किस मॉडल पर आधारित थी?
e: Pehli panchvarshiya yojana (1951-56) Harrod-Domar model par aadharit thi; is model kehta hai ki vikas ke liye bachat tatha nivesh ki dar badhani hogi tatha capital-output ratio ke hisaab se lakshya tay hote hain. Isi karan pehli yojana ka mukhya dhyan kheti, sinchai tatha bijli gharon par tha, taaki anaaj ki kami door ho tatha vikas ki neev pad sake; is yojana mein kaafi safalta mili. Mahalanobis tatha Solow model vikas ke anya aadhaar hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: pehli panchvarshiya yojana Harrod-Domar model par aadharit thi - iska dhyan kheti tatha sinchai par tha.

qe: Which plan was based on the 'Mahalanobis Model'?
qh: कौन सी योजना 'महालनोबिस मॉडल' पर आधारित थी?
e: Mahalanobis model doosri panchvarshiya yojana (1956-61) ka aadhaar tha; is model mein bhaari udyog (steel, machine tatha bijli) ko sabse zyada nivesh diya gaya, taaki desh ki udyogik neev mazboot ho sake. Iska karan yahi hai ki Prashant Chandra Mahalanobis ki soch thi ki bhaari punji (capital) wale udyog khade karne se aage chal kar anya udyog bhi badhenge; isi yojana se Bhilai tatha Rourkela jaise steel plant khade hue. Pehli, teesri tatha panchvi yojanaon ka aadhaar anya model the, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: doosri panchvarshiya yojana Mahalanobis model par aadharit thi - ismein bhaari udyog tatha tez audyogikaran par zor diya gaya.

qe: When was the 'Planning Commission' of India dissolved?
qh: भारत के 'योजना आयोग' को कब समाप्त किया गया था?
e: Yojana Aayog ko 2014 mein samapt kar diya gaya; 1 January 2015 ko uski jagah NITI Aayog aa gayi. Iska karan yahi hai ki 2014 mein sarkar ne yah tay kiya ki Upar se niche thope jane wale yojanabaddh rukbe ki jagah sahyog tatha salahon wala dhaancha kaam kare, isliye purani sanstha ko samapt kar nayi sanstha banaayi gayi. 2010, 2012 tatha 2015 ke vikalp sanstha ke astitva tatha badlav ki asli tarikh se mel nahi khaate, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: Yojana Aayog 2014 mein samapt kiya gaya - 1 January 2015 ko uski jagah NITI Aayog aa gayi.

qe: Which body used to approve the Five Year Plans in India?
qh: भारत में पंचवर्षीय योजनाओं को कौन सी संस्था मंजूरी देती थी?
e: Panchvarshiya yojanaon ko manzoori National Development Council (NDC) deti thi; yahi sanstha 1952 mein bani tatha ismein Pradhan Mantri, sabhi mukhya mantri tatha kendriya mantri shamil hote the. Iska karan yahi hai ki yojanayen kendra tatha rajya dono ki saajhi honi chahiye thi, isliye rajyaon ki sahmati ke liye NDC ka platform bana; iski manzoori ke baad hi yojana aage badhti thi. Vitta Mantralaya tatha Parliament ka bhi apna kaam hai par yojana ki antim manzoori NDC deti thi, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: panchvarshiya yojanaon ko manzoori National Development Council (NDC) deti thi - yahi kendra tatha rajyaon ka sajha platform tha.

qe: What was the period of the 'Plan Holiday' in India?
qh: भारत में 'योजना अवकाश' (Plan Holiday) की अवधि क्या थी?
e: Yojana avkash (plan holiday) ki avadhi 1966 se 1969 thi; is dauran panchvarshiya yojana band rahi tatha uski jagah teen varshik yojanayen chalayi gayin. Iska karan yahi hai ki 1965 tatha 1971 ke yuddh, sookha tatha mehngai se desh ki arthavyavastha bahut kamzor ho gayi thi, isliye sarkar ne lambi avadhi ka kharch ka khaka banane ke bajaye saal-dar-saal yojana chalayi. 1961-64 tatha 1990-92 ki avadhiyan anya yojana-kal se juda hain, isliye inhe galat chunav maana jaana chahiye. Exam point: yojana avkash 1966-69 ki avadhi mein tha - yuddh, sookha tatha mehngai ke karan panchvarshiya yojana band rahi.

qe: What was the 'Rolling Plan' period in India?
qh: 'रोलिंग प्लान' (Rolling Plan) की अवधि क्या थी?
e: Rolling plan ki avadhi 1978-80 thi; ise Janata Sarkar ne panchvi yojana samapt karne ke baad shuru kiya tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki rolling plan mein har saal yojana ka punah-samiksha hoti hai tatha naye saal ka lakshya jod diya jaata hai, isliye ye lambi badalti hui paristhitiyon ke liye lachakdar maani gayi. 1990-92 tatha 1980-85 ke vikalp doosri avadhiyon se juda hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: rolling plan 1978-80 mein lagu thi - yahi har saal samiksha wali lachakdar yojana thi jise Janata Sarkar ne shuru kiya.

qe: Which was the 'Last' Five Year Plan in India?
qh: भारत में 'अंतिम' पंचवर्षीय योजना कौन सी थी?
e: Sabse antim panchvarshiya yojana barahvin yojana (2012-2017) thi; iske baad 1 April 2017 se NITI Aayog ne 15 saal ka vision tatha 3 saal ka action plan wala naya tareeka apnaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki pandrahvin yojana ki jagah lambi avadhi ke lakshya tay kiye gaye tatha pandrah varshiya, sapt-varshiya tatha teen-varshiya khake banaye jaane lage. Dasvin tatha gyarahvin yojanayen barahvin se pehle ki avadhiyan hain tatha terahvin aisi koi yojana nahi bani, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: barahvin panchvarshiya yojana (2012-2017) antim thi - iske baad NITI Aayog ke aadhar par naya dhaancha chal raha hai.

qe: What is a 'Regressive Tax'?
qh: 'प्रतिगामी कर' (Regressive Tax) क्या है?
o: Tax rate decreases as income increases
e: Pratigami (regressive) kar wo hota hai jismein aay badhne par kar ki dar badhti nahi balki vyavaharik roop se kam pad jaati hai; isse kam aay walon par bojh zyada padta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aisi dar (jaise keval apratyaksh kar) sabhi se barabar li jaati hai, isliye garib ki aay ka bada hissa kar mein chala jaata hai tatha amir ko kam asar padta hai; samanta ke liye ise theek nahi maana jaata. Saman kar wala tatha aay badhne par kar badhne wala vikalp anya prakar ke kar hain, isliye wo sahi nahi. Exam point: pratigami kar mein aay badhne par kar ki dar kam ho jaati hai - isse kam aay walon par bojh zyada padta hai.

qe: Which sector does a 'Steel Plant' belong to?
qh: 'स्टील प्लांट' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है?
e: Steel plant secondary kshetra ka hissa hai, kyunki ismein khanan se nikle kachche loha tatha koyle ko bhatti tatha karkhane mein badalkar tayyar steel banaya jaata hai. Isi karan steel ko desh ki audyogik taaqat ka aadhaar kaha jaata hai tatha isse machine, pipe tatha nirmita saman bante hain. Khanan tatha kheti wala pehla kshetra alag hai tatha vyapar-parivahan wala teesra kshetra bhi alag hai. Exam point: steel plant secondary kshetra mein aata hai - yahi kachche maal ko tayyar maal mein badalne wala nirman kshetra hai.

qe: What is an 'Ad valorem Tax'?
qh: 'एड वैलोरम टैक्स' (Ad valorem Tax) क्या है?
o: Tax based on the value of a good
e: Ad valorem kar wo hota hai jo maal ke moolya (value) ke pratishat ke roop mein lagaya jaata hai; ise 'moolya-anusar kar' bhi kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki mehange maal par zyada tatha saste maal par kam kar lagta hai, isliye yahi aaj ke daur ka sabse aam tareeka hai - jaise GST 18 pratishat. Area ya volume ke aadhaar par lagne wala kar isse alag hota hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: ad valorem kar maal ke moolya ke pratishat ke roop mein lagaya jaata hai - GST isi prakar ka kar hai.

qe: What is the deductible from GDP to get NNP (after adding NFIA)?
qh: NNP प्राप्त करने के लिए GDP में से क्या 'घटाया' जाता है (NFIA जोड़ने के बाद)?
e: NNP nikalne ke liye GDP mein NFIA jodne ke baad mulyahras (depreciation) ghataana padta hai; yani NNP = GDP + NFIA - depreciation, tatha GDP + NFIA = GNP hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki machine tatha sanrachna har saal ghis jaati hai, isliye us ghisavat ka andaaza ghataye bina shudh utpadan nahi nikalta. Udhaar, sahayata tatha kar is ganna ke madan nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: GDP mein NFIA jodne ke baad mulyahras ghata kar NNP nikalta hai - yahi shudh rashtriya utpadan hai.

qe: In an economy, 'Capital Formation' depends primarily on:
qh: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में 'पूंजी निर्माण' किस पर निर्भर करता है?
e: Kisi bhi arthavyavastha mein poonji nirman mukhya roop se kul bachat par nirbhar karta hai, kyunki jitni bachat hogi utna hi paisa bankon, share bazaar tatha anya madhyam se karz lekar nayi machine, factory tatha sanrachna par lagaya ja sakta hai. Isi karan jis desh ki bachat ki dar kam hoti hai, wahan nivesh tatha poonji nirman bhi kam rehta hai tatha vikas dheema hota hai; yahi garibi ke dushchakra ki bhi jad hoti hai. Kul utpadan tatha kul aay isse alag madan hain, kyunki wo pehle kamane tatha kharch karne ka chitra dete hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: poonji nirman kul bachat par nirbhar karta hai - bachat hi nivesh tatha nayi poonji ka srot hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Cess' in Indian taxation?
qh: भारतीय कराधान में 'सेस' (Cess) क्या है?
o: Tax on tax for a specific purpose
e: Cess wo kar hota hai jo mukhya kar ke upar ek vishesh uddeshya ke liye lagaya jaata hai tatha usse ikattha hui raqam usi kaam mein kharch hoti hai; isi karan ise 'kar par kar' kaha jaata hai. Iska udaharan shiksha upkar tatha swachh bharat upkar hai, jinse shiksha tatha saaf-safai ke karyakram chalte hain; upkar ka rajasv rajyaon ke saath baantna zaroori nahi hota. Aayatkar ya munaafe par lagne wala kar isse alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi. Exam point: cess ek vishesh uddeshya ke liye lagne wala kar hota hai - yahi mukhya kar ke upar lagta hai tatha usi kaam mein kharch hota hai.

qe: What is a 'Surcharge' in tax terms?
qh: कर के संदर्भ में 'सरचार्ज' (Surcharge) क्या है?
e: Sarcharge (surcharge) wo atirikt shulk hota hai jo mukhya kar (jaise aaykar) ke bhugtan ke baad usi kar ki rakam par laga diya jaata hai; yani yah 'kar par kar' hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkar adhik aay wale vargon tatha vishesh kamon ke liye atirikt rajasv jutana chahti hai, isliye 50 lakh se adhik aay par 10 pratishat ke hisaab se sarcharge lagta hai tatha iski ganna alag se hoti hai. Chhoot (discount) ya kam aay wale vikalp sarcharge ki paribhasha se mel nahi khaate, isliye wo galat vikalp hain.. Exam point: sarcharge mukhya kar ki rakam par laga atirikt shulk hota hai - yahi adhik aay wale vargon se liya jaata hai.

qe: Which type of budget is presented when 'Receipts > Expenditure'?
qh: 'प्राप्तियां > व्यय' होने पर किस प्रकार का बजट पेश किया जाता है?
e: Jab sarkar ki kul praptiyan uske kul vyay se adhik ho jaati hain to aisa budget adhishth (surplus) budget kehlata hai; ise 'adhishth bajat' bhi kehte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkar apni kamai se adhik vasool leti hai tatha kharch kam karti hai, isliye bachayi hui raqam karz chukane ya bhavishya ke liye bachai jaati hai; isi karan adhishth budget ko aarthik sthirtata ka sanket maana jaata hai. Ghatate wala budget tatha santulit budget is se alag surat hain, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: praptiyan vyay se adhik hone par adhishth (surplus) budget aata hai - ismein sarkar kamai se kam kharch karti hai.

qe: What is 'Zero Based Budgeting' (ZBB)?
qh: 'शून्य आधारित बजट' (ZBB) क्या है?
o: Every expense must be justified from scratch
e: Shunya aadharit budget (ZBB) mein har naye varsh ke har vyay ko 'shunya se' sahi thahrana padta hai; yani purane varsh ka kharch aage badhane ke bajaye uski upyogita tatha zarurat dobara jaanchi jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki purani aadaten chalti rehne se bekaar ke kharche badhte rehte hain, isliye poori punah-samiksha se sarkar ki bachat badhti hai tatha kharch zyada sujhaavpurn hota hai; isi soch ka prayog kai deshon ne 1980 ke daur mein kiya. Shunya kar ya garibon ka budget wale vikalp is avdharna se juda nahi hai, isliye ye teen baaki chunav galat thehrte hain.. Exam point: ZBB mein har kharch ko shunya se hi sahi thahrana padta hai - isse bekaar ke vyay par lagam lagti hai.

qe: Which state was the 'First' to ratify the GST Bill in India?
qh: भारत में GST लागू करने वाला 'पहला' राज्य कौन सा था?
e: GST vidheyak ka anumodan karne wala sabse pehla rajya Assam tha, jisne 12 August 2016 ko apni vidhan sabha mein ise manzoori di; iske baad anya rajyon ne ise sweekar kiya. Iska karan yahi hai ki GST ko laagu karne ke liye aadhe se adhik rajyon ki manzoori zaroori thi, isliye Assam ne pehla qadam uthakar is prakriya ki shuruat ki; isi ke baad 1 July 2017 se poore desh mein GST lagu hua. Telangana, Bihar tatha Maharashtra ke vikalp anya rajyon hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: GST vidheyak ka anumodan karne wala pehla rajya Assam tha - isi ke baad baaki rajyon ne ise sweekar kiya.

qe: On whom does the final incidence of an 'Indirect Tax' fall?
qh: 'अप्रत्यक्ष कर' का बोझ किस पर पड़ता है?
e: Apratyaksh kar ka bojh antim upabhokta par padta hai; dukaan-daar ya nirmata kar to sarkar ko jama karta hai, par uski rakam maal tatha seva ke dam mein jod di jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye kar kharide gaye maal ki keemat ka hissa ban jaata hai, isliye jo vyakti antim kharid karta hai wahi ushe chukata hai; vyapari keval bicholiya hota hai tatha sarkar ko rakam pahuncha deta hai. Nirmata tatha dukaandaar par ye bojh keval bahi-khate mein dikhta hai, isliye un dono vikalpon ko sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: apratyaksh kar ka bojh antim upabhokta par padta hai - vyapari keval sarkar tak rakam pahunchaata hai.

qe: Which body recommends the 'Distribution of Taxes' between Center and States?
qh: केंद्र और राज्यों के बीच 'करों के वितरण' की सिफारिश कौन सा निकाय करता है?
e: Kendra tatha rajyon ke beech kar rajasv ke baantware ki sifarish Vitta Aayog karta hai; yahi Article 280 ke tehat gathit ek sanvaidhanik sanstha hai tatha iska gathan Pradhan Mantri karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi aayog tay karta hai ki kendra ke kitne kar rajyon ke saath baanten jaayein tatha kis rajya ko kitna hissa mile; isliye iski sifarish poore desh mein rajkoshiya samvahan (federal balance) banaye rakhne ke liye zaroori hai. RBI, GST Council tatha NITI Aayog ke anya kaam hain, isliye unhe kar baantwade ki sanstha nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: kar rajasv ke baantwade ki sifarish Vitta Aayog karta hai - yahi Article 280 wali sanvaidhanik sanstha hai.

qe: What was the 'Primary Objective' of the 12th Five Year Plan?
qh: 12वीं पंचवर्षीय योजना का 'मुख्य उद्देश्य' क्या था?
o: Faster, Sustainable and More Inclusive Growth
e: Barahvin panchvarshiya yojana (2012-2017) ka mukhya uddeshya tez, satat tatha adhik samaveshi vikas (faster, sustainable and more inclusive growth) tha; iska lakshya 8 pratishat ki vriddhi dar hasil karna tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki us daur mein ye samajh aa gayi thi ki vriksh (growth) ke saath paryavaran tatha garib vargon ki bhagidari bhi zaroori hai, isliye samaveshi tatha satat shabdon par bhi zor diya gaya. Atmanirbharata tatha udyogik kraanti pehle ke yojana-kal ke lakshya the, isliye unhe barahvin yojana ka mukhya uddeshya nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: barahvin panchvarshiya yojana ka uddeshya tez, satat tatha samaveshi vikas tha - iska lakshya 8 pratishat vriddhi dar tha.

qe: What is 'Deficit Financing'?
qh: 'घाटे की वित्त व्यवस्था' (Deficit Financing) क्या है?
o: Printing more money or borrowing to cover budget gap
e: Ghate ki vitta vyavastha (deficit financing) ka matlab hai sarkar ka apne vyay ko kar rajasv se zyada chalana, jiske liye wo udhaar leti hai ya nayi mudra chhapwati hai; isse budget ka antar poora kiya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki vikas ke kaam tatha janta-kalyan ki yojanaon par kharch karne ke liye aay kam pad jaati hai, isliye sarkar aise sadhan apnati hai; par bahut adhik ghate ki vyavastha se mehngai badh sakti hai. Kar ghataana ya kharch kam karna isse ulta kaam hai, isliye unhe ghate ki vyavastha nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: ghate ki vitta vyavastha mein sarkar udhaar ya mudra chhapakar vyay ka antar poori karti hai - yahi mehngai badhne ka bhi karan ban sakti hai.

qe: Which sector is 'Tourism' part of?
qh: 'पर्यटन' किस क्षेत्र का हिस्सा है?
e: Paryatan tertiary (seva) kshetra ka hissa hai, kyunki ismein hotel, parivahan, guide, ticket tatha suraksha jaisi sevaen bikti hain tatha koi vastu tayyar nahi hoti. Iske alawa is kshetra se videshi mudra desh mein aati hai, isliye ise 'gair-dikhne wala niryat' bhi kehte hain; yahi karan ise rajya tatha desh ke vikas ka ahem sadhan maana jaata hai. Secondary tatha primary kshetra mein nirmit tatha prakruti se seedha nikaale jaane wale saadhan aate hain, isliye unhe paryatan ka sahi kshetra nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: paryatan tertiary kshetra mein aata hai - yahi sevaen bikne wala kshetra hai tatha videshi mudra laata hai.

qe: What is 'Black Money'?
qh: 'काला धन' (Black Money) क्या है?
o: Income on which tax has not been paid
e: Kala dhan (black money) wo aay tatha sampatti hai jis par kar nahi chukaya gaya ho tatha jise sarkar se chhipa kar rakha gaya ho; iska koi hisaab-kitaab bahi-khaaton mein nahi hota. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise dhan se sarkar ko rajasv ka nuksan hota hai tatha aarthik asamanta badhti hai, isliye sarkar ispar kar lagane tatha ishe bahar laane ke liye aakasmik notbandi, aay ghoshna yojana tatha benami sampatti kanoon jaise kadam uthaati hai. Purani noten tatha videshi mudra sadaiv kala dhan nahi hoti, isliye unhe is shabda ka sahi arth nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: kala dhan wo aay hai jiska kar nahi chukaya gaya tatha jo sarkar se chhipi hui hai - yahi arthavyavastha ke liye hanikarak hoti hai.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of MGNREGA?
qh: MGNREGA का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
o: Modern Gandhi National Rural Employment General Act
Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
e: MGNREGA ka poora naam Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act hai; ye 2005 mein banaya gaya tatha iske tehat gaon ke parivaron ko kam se kam 100 din ki majduri wala rojgar ki guarantee di jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki khane ke badle kaam wali yojana ko vikasit karke ise 'adhikar' ke roop mein badla gaya, isliye yadi kaam na mile to bhatta milta hai; iske tehat ek-tihai naukri auraton ke liye aarakshit rehti hai. Baaki vikalp naam ke jaali vistar hain tatha yojana ka poora naam nahi batate, isliye ye teen baaki chunav galat thehrte hain.. Exam point: MGNREGA ka poora naam Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act hai - ismein 100 din ke rojgar ki guarantee milti hai.

qe: When was the 'Digital India' program launched?
qh: 'डिजिटल इंडिया' कार्यक्रम कब शुरू किया गया था?
e: Digital India karyakram 1 July 2015 ko shuru kiya gaya tha; iska lakshya Bharat ko daigital roop se sashakt samaj tatha gyan-arthavyavastha banana tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkari sevaen, banking tatha suchna har gaon tak pahunchane ke liye internet tatha mobile ka sahara zaroori tha, isliye is karyakram ke tehat bharat net project, daigital saaksharta tatha e-governance jaise kaam shuru hue. 2014, 2016 tatha 2017 ke vikalp karyakram ke vaastavik shuru hone ki tarikh se mel nahi khaate, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: Digital India karyakram 1 July 2015 ko shuru hua - yahi sarkari sevaon ko daigital roop se aam janta tak pahunchane ka abhiyan hai.

qe: What is 'Minimum Support Price' (MSP) related to?
qh: 'न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य' (MSP) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Nyunatam samarthan moolya (MSP) krishi se juda hai; yahi wo ghatiya dar hai jispar sarkar kisanon se unki faslon ki kharid karti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki mandi mein bhau girne par kisan ko bahut ghate par bechna padta hai, isliye MSP unhe suraksha deta hai; iski sifarish CACP karta hai tatha gehun-chawal ki kharid FCI karti hai. Banking ya udyog wale vikalp MSP ke star tatha kshetra se juda nahi hain, isliye unka mel is prashn se nahi khaata.. Exam point: MSP krishi se juda hai - yahi kisanon ko bahau niche girne se bachaane ke liye sarkar dwara tay kiya jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'Pigovian Tax'?
qh: 'पिगोवियन टैक्स' (Pigovian Tax) क्या है?
o: Tax on activities that create negative externalities (e.g. pollution)
e: Pigovian kar wo kar hai jo un kaam-kajon par lagaya jaata hai jinse samaaj ko bahari (negative) nuksan pahuncta hai; jaise karkhane ke dhuen tatha karbon utsarg (emission) par lagne wala paryavaran kar. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise kaam ki lagat ve kaam karne wale tatha samaaj ke beech baant deta hai, isliye pradushan karne wale ko us nuksan ki keemat chukani padti hai; isi vichaar-dhara ko 'pradushan karne wala chukaye' kehte hain. Khaane ya sampatti par lagne wale kar is soch par aadharit nahi hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.. Exam point: Pigovian kar un kaam-kajon par lagta hai jinse samaaj ko nuksan hota hai - jaise pradushan par lagne wala kar.

qe: The 'Green Revolution' in India was primarily successful in which crop?
qh: भारत में 'हरित क्रांति' मुख्य रूप से किस फसल में सफल रही?
e: Harit kraanti Bharat mein mukhya roop se gehun ki fasal mein sabse safal rahi; 1960 ke dashak mein Norman Borlaug ki sanrachna se tayar unnat beej (HYV) tatha khad-paani ke prayog se Punjab, Haryana tatha Uttar Pradesh mein gehun ka paidavar bahut badh gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki gehun ki unnat kismein sarraha, khushk rahenewali tatha adhik paidavar wale gun the, isliye yahi fasal sabse jaldi aage badhi; iske baad chawal mein bhi safalta mili. Dalen tatha kapaas is kraanti ka mukhya kendra nahi the, isliye inhe sahi chunav nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: harit kraanti sabse zyada gehun ki fasal mein safal rahi - ismein unnat beej tatha khad ke istemal se paidavar badha.

qe: What is 'External Debt'?
qh: 'बाहरी ऋण' क्या है?
e: Bahari karz (external debt) wo karz hota hai jo desh videshi ritiyon (lenders) jaise IMF, Vishva Bank tatha anya deshon se leta hai; iski chukauti videshi mudra mein hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise karz lene par desh ko videshi mudra kamani padti hai tatha byaj ka bojh bahari mudra mein nikal jaata hai, isliye ise bahari karz kaha jaata hai. Nagrikon ya RBI se liya gaya karz antarik (internal) karz kehlata hai, isliye unhe bahari karz nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: bahari karz videshi ritiyon se liya jaata hai - iski chukauti videshi mudra mein hoti hai tatha isse desh ki bahari nirbharta badhti hai.

qe: What is 'Disinvestment'?
qh: 'विनिवेश' (Disinvestment) क्या है?
o: Govt selling its shares in public sector companies
e: Vinivesh (disinvestment) ka matlab hai sarkar dwara apne public sector upkramon mein se apne hisse bechna; isse sarkar ko paisa milta hai tatha upkram mein niji bhagidari badhti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkar apni rajkoshiya zarurat ke liye tatha upkram ki kushalta badhane ke liye aise hisse bechti hai, taaki nivesh samajik kshetra tatha sanrachna par kharch ho sake; iska udaharan Air India tatha anya PSU ke hisse hain. Company ko band karna ya nivesh badhana vinivesh se alag baat hai, isliye wo galat vikalp hain.. Exam point: vinivesh mein sarkar PSU ke apne hisse bech deti hai - isse rajkoshiya bojh kam hota hai tatha kushalta badhti hai.

qe: Which is the 'Oldest Stock Exchange' in Asia?
qh: एशिया का 'सबसे पुराना स्टॉक एक्सचेंज' कौन सा है?
e: Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) Asia ka sabse purana stock exchange hai, jo 1875 mein Mumbai ke ek bade bargad (banyan) ke ped ke neeche shuru hua tha; ise 'BSE' tatha 'Dalal Street' ke naam se bhi jaana jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki vyapar tatha udyog ke badhte daur mein logo ko share kharidne-bechne ke liye ek kamya platform ki zarurat padi, isliye yahi pehla organized market bana. NSE 1992 ke baad sthaapit doosra bada exchange hai tatha Tokyo tatha Shanghai aise vikalp videshi hain, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: Asia ka sabse purana stock exchange BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) hai - yahi 1875 mein shuru hua tha.

qe: What is the 'Market Index' of the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE)?
qh: बॉम्बे स्टॉक एक्सचेंज (BSE) का 'मार्केट इंडेक्स' क्या है?
e: Bombay Stock Exchange ka market index Sensex kehlata hai; ismein 30 badi tatha vitti roop se mazboot kamnian shamil hoti hain tatha iska aadhaar-varsh 1978-79 hai jiska moolya 100 maana gaya tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye index in kamnion ke share dam ke badlav se bazaar ke samanya rukh (trend) ka andaza deta hai, isliye niveshkar aur media roz isi aankde ko dekhte hain. Nifty NSE ka index hai tatha NASDAQ tatha Dow Jones videshi index hain, isliye unhe BSE ka index nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: BSE ka market index Sensex hai - yahi 30 badi kamnion ke share dam par nigrani karta hai.

qe: What is the 'Market Index' of the National Stock Exchange (NSE)?
qh: नेशनल स्टॉक एक्सचेंज (NSE) का 'मार्केट इंडेक्स' क्या है?
e: National Stock Exchange ka market index Nifty 50 kehlata hai, jise 1995 se top 50 kamnion ke aadhaar par nikaala jaata hai tatha uska shuruaati moolya 1000 tay kiya gaya tha. Iska karan yahi hai ki NSE ne 1992 ke ghotale ke baad electronik tatha paardarshi (transparent) trading shuru ki, isliye Nifty aaj vishv ke niveshkaron ke liye Bharat ke bazaar ka mukhya paimana ban gaya. Sensex BSE ka index hai tatha bullion sone-chandi ke bazaar se juda hai, isliye unhe NSE ka index nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: NSE ka market index Nifty 50 hai - yahi top 50 kamnion ke prakshan (performance) par nigrani karta hai.

qe: What is a 'Bull Market'?
qh: 'बुल मार्केट' (Bull Market) क्या है?
e: Bull market wo bazaar ki halat hai jismein share dam lagatar badhte hain tatha niveshkaron mein aashavadi (optimism) bani rehti hai; isi waqt nivesh tatha nayi lijting (listing) dono badhti hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki munafe ki ummeed par kharidari badhti hai, isliye bazaar upar ki or bhagta hai; ise 'bull' naam isliye mila kyunki bail seeng se upar ki or uchhalta hai. Dam girne ya sthir rehne wale vikalp is halat ke ulta hain, isliye unka mel is prashn se nahi khaata.. Exam point: bull market mein share dam badhte hain - yahi aashavadi bazaar ki pehchan hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Bear Market'?
qh: 'बियर मार्केट' (Bear Market) क्या है?
e: Bear market wo halat hai jismein share dam lagatar girte hain tatha niveshkaron mein nirasha (pessimism) tatha bechne ka dabav badh jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki bazaar ke girne par log ghabarakar apne share bech dete hain, isse girne ka silsila aur tez ho jaata hai; ise 'bear' naam isliye mila kyunki bhaalu apne panje neeche ki or maarta hai. Badhte ya sthir rehne wale vikalp is halat se alag hain, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain.. Exam point: bear market mein share dam girte hain - yahi nirashavadi bazaar ki pehchan hoti hai.

qe: Where are the 'Headquarters' of the World Bank located?
qh: विश्व बैंक का 'मुख्यालय' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Vishva Bank ka mukhyalay Washington D.C. (America) mein sthit hai; iski sthapna 1944 mein Bretton Woods sammelan mein IMF ke saath hui thi. Iska karan yahi hai ki yuddh ke baad tabah ho chuke deshon ke punarnirman tatha vikas ke liye bade punji ki zarurat thi, isliye yahi sanstha bani tatha yahi aaj garibi hatane tatha vikas pariyojnaon mein karz deti hai. New York, Paris tatha Geneva mein anya sansthan hain, isliye unhe Vishva Bank ka mukhyalay nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: Vishva Bank ka mukhyalay Washington D.C. mein hai - iski sthapna 1944 mein IMF ke saath hui thi.

qe: Which organization publishes the 'World Economic Outlook' report?
qh: 'वर्ल्ड इकोनॉमिक आउटलुक' रिपोर्ट कौन सी संस्था प्रकाशित करती है?
e: Vishva Aarthik Paripekshya (World Economic Outlook) report IMF prakaashit karta hai; yahi har saal do baar duniya bhar ki vriddhi dar, mehngai tatha vyapar ke anuman pesh karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki IMF duniya ki aarthik sthirtata par nigrani rakhta hai tatha deshon ko aarthik salah deta hai, isliye iski report niveshkar tatha sarkaron ke liye margdarshak maani jaati hai. Vishva Bank, WTO tatha UNCTAD ki bhi apni-apni report hoti hai, isliye is report ke asli prakaashak yahi sansthaen nahi hain. Exam point: World Economic Outlook report IMF prakaashit karta hai - yahi vishv ki aarthik sthiti ka vishleshan deti hai.

qe: Which organization is also known as the 'Lender of Last Resort' for countries?
qh: देशों के लिए 'अंतिम ऋणदाता' के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
e: IMF ko deshon ke liye 'antim sahayak bank' (lender of last resort) kaha jaata hai, kyunki jab kisi desh par bhugtan santulan ka sankat aa jaata hai tatha uske paas videshi mudra khatam ho jaati hai, tab yahi sanstha karz dekar ushe sambhalti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki IMF ki sthapna hi aise sankat (emergencies) ke liye hui thi, isliye wo deshon ko short-term karz tatha niti salah deti hai; Vishva Bank lambi avadhi ke vikas ka karz deti hai. NDB tatha ADB kshetriya bank hain tatha Vishva Bank ka kaam alag hai, isliye unhe antim sahayak bank nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: deshon ke liye antim sahayak bank (lender of last resort) IMF ko kaha jaata hai - yahi bhugtan santulan ke sankat mein sahayata deti hai.

qe: Where is the 'Headquarters' of the World Trade Organization (WTO)?
qh: विश्व व्यापार संगठन (WTO) का 'मुख्यालय' कहाँ है?
e: Vishva Vyapar Sangathan (WTO) ka mukhyalay Geneva (Switzerland) mein hai; iski sthapna 1 January 1995 ko hui tatha isne GATT ka sthan liya. Iska karan yahi hai ki deshon ke beech vyapar ke niyam tay karne tatha vivad niptane ke liye ek sthir vaishvik sanstha ki zarurat thi, isliye Uruguay round ke samjhauton ke baad WTO bana tatha aaj 164 sadasya desh iske sadasya hain. Vienna, Brussels tatha Rome mein anya antarrashtriya sansthan hain, isliye unhe WTO ka mukhyalay nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: WTO ka mukhyalay Geneva mein hai - yahi 1995 mein GATT ki jagah aaya tatha antarrashtriya vyapar ke niyam chalata hai.

qe: What is 'SDR' (Special Drawing Rights) often called?
qh: 'SDR' को अक्सर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: SDR (Special Drawing Right) ko laukik taur par 'paper gold' kaha jaata hai, kyunki yah IMF dwara banaya gaya ek antarrashtriya aarakhit asset (reserve asset) hota hai jise sone ki tarah deshon ke reserve tatha bhugtan ke liye istemal kiya ja sakta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ise kisi ek desh ki mudra ka naam nahi diya gaya balki ushe kai badi mudraon ki tokri par aadharit kiya gaya, isliye yahi antarrashtriya bhugtan mein bharosa banata hai. Gold coin tatha soft loan wale vikalp SDR ke asli swaroop ko nahi batate, isliye ye teen baaki chunav galat thehrte hain.. Exam point: SDR ko 'paper gold' kaha jaata hai - yahi IMF ki banai hui antarrashtriya aarakhit asset hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Blue Chip' company?
qh: 'ब्लू चिप' कंपनी क्या है?
o: A large, well-established, and financially sound company
e: Blue chip kamni wo hoti hai jo badi, purani tatha vitti roop se majboot ho; aisi kamni ka munafa tatha dividand saal-dar-saal bharosemand rehta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki niveshkar aise share mein kam jokhim (risk) maan kar nivesh karte hain, isliye ye bazaar ke girne par bhi tulnatmak roop se sambhali rehti hai; Sensex tatha Nifty ki adhiktar kamnian isi shreni ki hoti hain. Ghate mein chalne wali kamni ya naya startup is shreni mein nahi aata, isliye unhe blue chip nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: blue chip kamni badi, purani tatha vitti roop se majboot hoti hai - iska munafa tatha dividand sthir rehta hai.

qe: Which organization provides 'Soft Loans' (low interest) to poor countries?
qh: गरीब देशों को 'सॉफ्ट लोन' (कम ब्याज) कौन प्रदान करता है?
e: Gharib deshon ko soft loan (kam byaj wala karz) International Development Association (IDA) deti hai; ise Vishva Bank samuh ki 'soft loan window' kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise deshon ki chukauti kshamata kam hoti hai, isliye unhe bahut lambi avadhi tatha bahut kam ya shunya byaj par karz diya jaata hai, taaki vikas ke kaam ruk na jaayein. IBRD, IFC tatha MIGA vishva bank samuh ke anya ang hain jo alag tarah ka kaam karte hain, isliye unhe soft loan ka pramukh srot nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: gharib deshon ko soft loan IDA deti hai - yahi Vishva Bank samuh ki 'soft loan window' kehlati hai.

qe: What is 'Foreign Direct Investment' (FDI)?
qh: 'प्रत्यक्ष विदेशी निवेश' (FDI) क्या है?
o: Investment in business interests in another country
e: Pratyaksh videshi nivesh (FDI) ka matlab hai ek desh ki kamni dwara doosre desh mein vyapar tatha udyog mein nivesh karna, jismein uski lambi avadhi ki bhagidari tatha prabandhan mein hissa hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki FDI ke saath taknik, prabandhan ka gyan tatha sthir punji aati hai, isliye ise desh ke vikas ke liye upyogi maana jaata hai; keval share kharidkar turant bech dena (FPI) isse alag hota hai. Sona kharidna vyapar tatha stock ka short-term kharidna is shreni mein nahi aate, isliye unhe FDI nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: FDI ka matlab doosre desh ke vyapar mein lambi avadhi ka nivesh hota hai - ismein prabandhan tatha taknik bhi aati hai.

qe: Which organization publishes the 'Global Competitiveness Report'?
qh: 'ग्लोबल कॉम्पिटिटिवनेस रिपोर्ट' कौन प्रकाशित करता है?
e: Global Competitiveness Report World Economic Forum (WEF) prakaashit karta hai; yahi har saal davos (Switzerland) mein apna prasiddh sammelan bhi karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye report deshon ki takniki tayyari, sanrachna, baazar ki kushalta tatha sansthaon ki gunvatta jaisi kasautiyon par unki pratispardha maapti hai, isliye sarkar tatha niveshkar ise gambhirta se dekhte hain. Vishva Bank, WTO tatha IMF ki bhi apni report hoti hai, isliye is report ka prakaashak unhe nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Global Competitiveness Report WEF prakaashit karta hai - yahi davos sammelan tatha pratispardha ke aankde ke liye jaana jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'Unicorn' in the startup world?
qh: स्टार्टअप की दुनिया में 'यूनिकॉर्न' (Unicorn) क्या है?
o: Privately owned startup with valuation over $1 billion
e: Startup ki duniya mein 'unicorn' aisi niji (private) kamni ko kehte hain jiska moolyankan 1 billion dolar (yani 1000 million dolar) se adhik ho; ise 'billion dolar club' bhi kaha jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise startup ne kam samay mein hi bade nivesh tatha vriddhi ka dam dikhaya hota hai, isliye ye unicorn ki upadhi se jaane jaate hain; Bharat duniya mein aise startups ke liye teesre-tisre sthane par aata hai. Ghate mein chalne wali kamni ya keval 100 karmchariyon wali kamni is shreni mein nahi aati, isliye unhe unicorn nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: unicorn wo niji startup hota hai jiska moolyankan 1 billion dolar se adhik ho - yahi bade nivesh ka paimana hai.

qe: Which currency is NOT part of the 'SDR Basket' of IMF?
qh: कौन सी मुद्रा IMF की 'SDR बास्केट' का हिस्सा नहीं है?
e: IMF ki SDR basket mein bhartiya rupaya shaamil nahi hai; is basket mein aaj US dolar, euro, cheeni renminbi, japani yen tatha british pound shamil hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki SDR basket mein wo mudraen shamil ki jaati hain jinhe antarrashtriya vyapar tatha bhugtan mein khulkar istemal kiya jaata hai, isliye jis mudra ka videshi istemal kam hota hai wo ismein nahi aati. Cheeni renminbi, American dolar tatha Japani yen basket ke vaastavik udaaharan hain, isliye unhe galat nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: IMF ki SDR basket mein Indian Rupee shamil nahi hai - ismein dolar, euro, renminbi, yen tatha pound shamil hain.

qe: What is 'Balance of Payments' (BoP) equilibrium?
qh: 'भुगतान संतुलन' (BoP) का संतुलन क्या है?
e: Bhugtan santulan (BoP) ka santulan is arth mein hota hai ki desh ke videshi len-den ki praptiyan tatha bhugtan (receipts = payments) dono ek hi hisaab mein likhe jaate hain; yahi ek desh tatha baaki duniya ke beech sabhi aarthik len-den ka vyavasthit hisaab-kitaab hota hai. Iski zarurat isliye hoti hai ki koi bhi desh lambe samay tak apne videshi kharch se adhik kamai nahi kar sakta, isliye aakhir mein hisaab barabar karna hi padta hai; ghata hone par karz ya reserve se pura hota hai. Keval aayat-niryat ya kul karz ka shunya hona BoP ka santulan nahi hai, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: BoP ka santulan praptiyan tatha bhugtan barabar hone se hota hai - yahi desh ke sabhi videshi len-den ka lekha hai.

qe: What is 'Capital Account' in BoP?
qh: BoP में 'पूंजी खाता' (Capital Account) क्या है?
o: Transactions in assets like FDI and loans
e: BoP mein poonji khata (capital account) wo hissa hai jismein sampatti, karz tatha nivesh se jude len-den aate hain; jaise FDI, FPI, bahari karz, banking punji tatha reserve mein badlav. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye khata desh mein aane-wale tatha jaane-wale nivesh ko dikhata hai, jabki chalu khate mein maal tatha sevaon ka vyapar tatha aay ka len-den aata hai; dono milkar poora BoP banate hain. Vastuon ya sevaon ka vyapar chalu khate ke vishay hain, isliye unhe poonji khate ka hissa nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: poonji khata FDI tatha karz jaise sampatti wale len-den ka lekha hai - yahi chalu khate se alag hota hai.

qe: What is 'Current Account Deficit' (CAD)?
qh: 'चालू खाता घाटा' (CAD) क्या है?
o: Import > Export of goods and services
e: Chalu khata ghata (CAD) tab hota hai jab desh ke aayat (import) niryat (export) se zyada ho jaayein, yani bahari duniya se kharide gaye maal tatha sevaon ka moolya bechne se adhik ho. Iska karan yahi hai ki is antar ko poora karne ke liye desh ko videshi nivesh ya karz lena padta hai, isliye bahut adhik CAD videshi mudra ke bhandar par dabav tatha mudra ki keemat par asar daal deta hai. Keval niryat adhik hona ya sarkari kharch badhna is ghate ki paribhasha nahi hai, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: CAD tab hota hai jab aayat niryat se zyada ho - yahi desh ke vyapar ke ghatate ka paimana hai.

qe: Which body is known as the 'Watchdog' of International Trade?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के 'वॉचडॉग' (Watchdog) के रूप में किसे जाना जाता है?
e: WTO ko antarrashtriya vyapar ka watch-dog (watchdog) kaha jaata hai, kyunki yahi deshon ke beech vyapar ke niyam tay karta hai tatha kisi desh dwara niyam todne par shikayat par vivad ka niptara karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki iske bina bade desh chhote deshon par apni sharten thop sakte the tatha shulk-bar-bar se vyapar ruk jaata, isliye yahi sanstha vyapar ko khula tatha bharosemand rakhne ka kaam karti hai. UN ek rajnitik tatha samajik sangathan hai tatha IMF mudra tatha bhugtan dekhta hai, isliye unhe vyapar ka prahari nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: antarrashtriya vyapar ka watch-dog WTO hai - yahi vyapar ke niyam chalata tatha vivad niptata hai.

qe: What is 'Primary Market'?
qh: 'प्राथमिक बाजार' (Primary Market) क्या है?
o: Where new securities are issued for the first time
e: Prambhik baazar (primary market) wo hota hai jahan kamni pehli baar apne naye share tatha anya prathibhutiyan janta ko bechti hai; IPO isi baazar ke madhyam hota hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahan se kamni ko nayi punji milti hai, jo wo badhaav tatha naye pariyojnaon mein lagati hai; yahi baazar kamni tatha niveshkar ke beech pehla pul hota hai. Purane share ke kharid-beche wala baazar 'secondary market' kehlata hai tatha krishi mandi is se alag hai, isliye unhe primary market nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: primary market wahan hota hai jahan nayi prathibhutiyan pehli baar jari hoti hain - IPO isi ka udaharan hai.

qe: What is the full form of 'IPO'?
qh: 'IPO' का पूर्ण रूप क्या है?
e: IPO ka poora roop Initial Public Offering hai; yani jab koi kamni pehli baar apne share janta ke liye jari karti hai tatha stock exchange mein lijt (list) hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise jari hone se kamni ko bade paimane par punji milti hai, jise wo apne vistar tatha karz chukane mein lagati hai; iske baad kamni ke share roz baazar mein kharide-beche jaate hain. Baaki vikalp IPO ke akshar nahi hain tatha is kriya ka sahi arth nahi batate, isliye inhe sahi chunav nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: IPO ka matlab Initial Public Offering hai - yahi kamni ke pehli baar share jari karne ki prakriya hai.

qe: What is 'Insider Trading' in stock market?
qh: शेयर बाजार में 'इनसाइडर ट्रेडिंग' क्या है?
o: Trading based on non-public confidential information
e: Insider trading ka matlab hai kamni ke andar ke aise vyakti dwara share kharidna-bechna jise kamni ki gopniya tatha janta ke liye ajnapit (undisclosed) jankari pehle mil gayi ho. Iska karan yahi hai ki is jankari ke aadhaar par wo aam niveshkaron se pehle labh utha leta hai, isse baazar ka bharosa toot jaata hai; isliye yahi kaam avaidh hai tatha SEBI ise sakhti se rokta hai. Karyalay samay mein trading, online trading ya ve share kharidna jayaz hai, isliye unhe insider trading nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: insider trading gopniya jankari ke aadhaar par share kharidne-beche ko kehte hain - yahi avaidh hai tatha SEBI ise rokta hai.

qe: What is 'Venture Capital'?
qh: 'वेंचर कैपिटल' (Venture Capital) क्या है?
o: Capital provided to startups with high growth potential
e: Venture capital wo punji hoti hai jo naye tatha adhik vriddhi ki sambhavna wale startups mein nivesh ke roop mein lagai jaati hai; niveshkar paise ke badle us startup mein hissa (equity) tatha ansh lete hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki aise startup ke paas taknik tatha vichaar hote hain par punji nahi, isliye wo risk uthane wale niveshkaron se paisa jutate hain; safal hone par inhe bade munafe ka ansh milta hai. Ghar ke karz, vyaktigat bachat wale vikalp venture capital ki paribhasha nahi hain, isliye wo galat vikalp hain.. Exam point: venture capital un startups ko di jaati hai jahan vriddhi ki bade sambhavna ho - niveshkar usmein hissa lete hain.

qe: What is 'Net Exports'?
qh: 'शुद्ध निर्यात' (Net Exports) क्या है?
e: Shudh niryat (net exports) nikalne ka formula yahi hai - kul niryat mein se kul aayat ghata di jaayein (Exports - Imports). Iska karan yahi hai ki ye aankda batata hai ki desh ka vyapar adhishth mein hai ya ghate mein, tatha GDP ki kharch-vidhi wali ganna mein yahi ek mukhya ghatak hota hai; adhishth niryat GDP ko badhata hai. Niryat tatha aayat ka jod ya tatal kar lena is se alag rashi deta hai, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: shudh niryat = niryat - aayat - yahi GDP ki kharch vidhi ka ek ghatak hota hai.

qe: What is 'Merchant Banking'?
qh: 'मर्चेंट बैंकिंग' क्या है?
o: Banking services for corporations like underwriting
e: Merchant banking wo banking seva hai jo kamnion tatha bade vyapari gharon ko di jaati hai; ismein share jari karne mein sahayata (underwriting), punji jutatne ki salah, vily-milan tatha pariyojna ki salah shamil hoti hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki kamni ko share baazar se punji jutane ke liye khaas takniki salah chahiye hoti hai, isliye wo merchant banker ki madad leti hai; yahi retail banking se alag hai jo aam logon ki jama-karz dekhti hai. Aam janta ke liye retail banking tatha gaon ki banking is shreni mein nahi aate, isliye unhe merchant banking nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: merchant banking kamnion ko di jaane wali banking seva hai - ismein underwriting tatha punji jutatne ki salah shamil hoti hai.

qe: What is 'FII' (Foreign Institutional Investor)?
qh: 'FII' क्या है?
o: Investment by foreign entities in Indian stock market
e: FII ka matlab Foreign Institutional Investment hai; iska matlab hai videshi sansthaon dwara bhartiya stock market tatha anya prathibhutiyon mein nivesh karna. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye nivesh alpakalik roop se aata tatha jaata hai, isliye ise 'hot money' kaha jaata hai; jab videshi bazaar mein sandeh badhta hai to ye turant nikal jaata hai tatha rupee tatha share baazar par dabav padta hai. Videshi vyakti ya sarkari sanstha dwara kisi desh mein kiye gaye nivesh ko sirf FII nahi kaha jaata, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: FII videshi sansthaon ka bhartiya baazar mein nivesh hai - ishe 'hot money' bhi kehte hain.

qe: Which stock exchange in USA is known for 'Technology' stocks?
qh: यूएसए का कौन सा स्टॉक एक्सचेंज 'टेक्नोलॉजी' शेयरों के लिए जाना जाता है?
e: NASDAQ America ka wo stock exchange hai jise takniki (technology) kamnion ke liye jaana jaata hai; Apple, Google, Microsoft tatha Amazon jaise tech giants isi baazar mein lijt (listed) hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi exchange naye takniki startups tatha software kamnion ko khulkar punji jutane ka mauka deta hai, isliye ise duniya ka pehla daigital exchange bhi kaha jaata hai. NYSE America ka purana tatha vistaar wala exchange hai tatha LSE London ka hai, isliye unhe technology kamnion ka khaas baazar nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: NASDAQ technology kamnion ke liye jaana jaata hai - yahi Apple tatha Google jaise tech giants ka baazar hai.

qe: What is 'Market Capitalization'?
qh: 'मार्केट कैपिटलाइजेशन' क्या है?
o: Total value of company's shares (Price x Number)
e: Market capitalization kamni ki kul keemat batati hai, jise share ka baazar bhau tatha kul share ki sankhya ko guna karke nikalte hain (Price x Number of shares). Iska karan yahi hai ki isse pata chalta hai ki stock market ki nigah mein kamni kitni badi hai, isliye Nifty tatha Sensex mein kamnion ka chayan unki market cap ke aadhaar par hota hai. Kamni ka kul munafa ya chukaya gaya kar is aankde se alag baatein hain, isliye unhe market capitalization nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: market capitalization = share ka bhau x share ki sankhya - yahi baazar mein kamni ka aakaar batata hai.

qe: Which organization is called the 'Lender to the Government' in India?
qh: भारत में 'सरकार का ऋणदाता' किसे कहा जाता है?
e: Bharat mein sarkar ka bank (lender to the government) RBI ko kaha jaata hai, kyunki yahi kendra tatha rajya sarkaron ke karz tatha banking ki vyavastha sambhalta hai; sarkar ke khate RBI ke paas hi chalte hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki sarkar bahut bada karz leti hai tatha ushe bharosemand sanstha se karz chahiye, isliye RBI tatha bank sarkari prathibhutiyan kharidkar tatha short-term rakam dekar uski zarurat poori karte hain. SBI, NABARD tatha anya vikalp aam janta tatha krishi se jude bank hain, isliye unhe sarkar ka bank nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: sarkar ka bank RBI hota hai - yahi kendra tatha rajya sarkaron ke khate tatha karz sambhalta hai.

qe: What is 'Depreciation' of currency in a 'Floating Exchange Rate' system?
qh: 'फ्लोटिंग विनिमय दर' प्रणाली में मुद्रा का 'डेप्रिसिएशन' क्या है?
o: Market driven fall in currency value
e: Floating vinimay dar wali vyavastha mein mudra ka 'depreciation' uske moolya mein bazaar ki maang tatha aapurti ke karan hone wali girawat ko kehte hain; ise sarkar thopni nahi hai, bazaar khud tay karta hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki jab kisi desh ka aayat niryat se zyada badh jaata hai ya mudra ki maang kam hoti hai to uski keemat girne lagti hai; aise hi halke padne se niryat sasta tatha aayat mahanga ho jaata hai tatha antar khud sambhalta hai. Moolya badhna tatha sarkar dwara jaanbujhkar moolya ghataana (avmulyan) is se alag hain, isliye unhe depreciation nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: floating system mein depreciation mudra ke moolya mein bazaar ki waja se hone wali girawat hai - yahi sarkar ke faisle ke bina hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Nominal GDP'?
qh: 'नाममात्र जीडीपी' (Nominal GDP) क्या है?
e: Namamatr (nominal) GDP wo GDP hota hai jise current bazaar keematon par nikaala jaata hai; ismein mehngai ka samayojan nahi kiya jaata. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye ek hi samay mein maap leta hai ki logon ne kitna kharida tatha kitna utpadan hua, par keematon ke badhne se ye aankda khud badh jaata hai chahe asli paidavar na bade; isliye asli tulna ke liye vaastavik GDP dekha jaata hai. Adhar varsh ki keematon wala vikalp vaastavik GDP batata hai tatha anya vikalp khud GDP ki paribhasha se alag hain, isliye wo galat vikalp hain.. Exam point: nominal GDP current keematon par nikaala jaata hai - ismein mehngai ka samayojan nahi hota, wo real GDP mein hota hai.

qe: Which organization in India is responsible for recommending the 'MSP' (Minimum Support Price)?
qh: भारत में 'MSP' (न्यूनतम समर्थन मूल्य) निर्धारित करने के लिए कौन सी संस्था जिम्मेदार है?
e: Nyunatam samarthan moolya (MSP) ki sifarish karne ki zimmedari Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) ki hoti hai, jo krishi mantralaya ke adhinasth ek salahkaar nikay hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi aayog faslon ki lagat, paidavar tatha yatra ki halat dekhkar sarkar ko sifarish bhejta hai, jiske aadhaar par cabinet MSP ki manzoori deti hai; gahum tatha chawal ki kharid FCI karti hai. NABARD krishi rit, NITI Aayog niti salah tatha FCI kharid ka kaam dekhte hain, isliye unhe MSP ki sifarish ki sanstha nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: MSP ki sifarish CACP karta hai - yahi lagat tatha keematon ko dekhkar sarkar ko sujhaav deta hai.

qe: What is 'White Goods' in the context of Indian economy?
qh: भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के संदर्भ में 'व्हाइट गुड्स' (White Goods) क्या हैं?
o: Household appliances like AC and Fridges
e: White goods se tatparya ghar mein istemal hone wale bade tikaau upkaran (durable appliances) se hai; jaise fridge, AC, washing machine, microwave tatha TV. Iska karan yahi hai ki ye upkaran lambe samay tak chalta hai tatha inka nirmaan steel, plastic tatha electronics wala bada udyog maangta hai, isliye sarkar ne PLI (Production Linked Incentive) yojana se inke nirmaan ko badhava diya hai. Doodh tatha cheeni jaise padarth khapat tatha krishi se jude hain, isliye unhe white goods nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: white goods mein fridge tatha AC jaise ghar ke tikaau upkaran aate hain - yahi PLI yojana se juda mahatvapurna kshetra hai.

qe: In which city is the 'Magadh Stock Exchange' located?
qh: 'बिहार स्टॉक एक्सचेंज' किस शहर में स्थित है?
e: Bihar ka prasiddh kshetriya stock exchange Magadh Stock Exchange ke naam se jaana jaata tha, jiska mukhyalay Patna mein sthit tha; Bihar ki rajdhani hone ke karan Patna hi vitti tatha vyaparik kendra raha. Iska karan yahi hai ki 1990 ke dashak mein kshetriya stock exchange kshetriya udyogon ko punji jutane ke liye khole gaye the, isliye Patna mein yahi bazaar bana; aaj kshetriya exchanges band ho chuke hain tatha vyapar BSE-NSE par hota hai. Muzaffarpur, Gaya tatha Bhagalpur Bihar ke anya shehr hain par yahi exchange kin vitti kendron mein nahi the, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: Bihar ka kshetriya stock exchange (Magadh Stock Exchange) Patna mein tha - yahi Bihar ki rajdhani tatha vitti kendra hai.

qe: What is 'Personal Income'?
qh: 'व्यक्तिगत आय' (Personal Income) क्या है?
o: National Income - Undistributed profits - Corporate tax + Transfer payments
e: Vyaktigat aay (personal income) wo aay hai jo vyaktiyon ke haath mein asal mein aati hai; ise nikalne ke liye rashtriya aay mein se na baantne wale munafe tatha nigam kar ghata diye jaate hain tatha antarit bhugtan jod diye jaate hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki corporate munafa tatha kar poora rashtriya aay ka hissa hote hain par vyaktiyon ke haath mein nahi aate, jabki pension tatha bhatta vyaktiyon ko milta hai chahe wo kisi utpadan se na aaya ho; isi tarah vyaktigat aay sarkar ke bhugtan ke baad asli prapt aay dikhati hai. Keval vet (salary) ya GDP jaisa jod is aay ki sahi paribhasha nahi hai, isliye unka mel is prashn se nahi khaata.. Exam point: vyaktigat aay = rashtriya aay - undistributed profits - corporate tax + transfer payments - yahi vyaktiyon ko milne wali asli aay hai.

qe: The symbol of 'Indian Rupee' (₹) was designed by:
qh: 'भारतीय रुपया' का प्रतीक (₹) किसने डिजाइन किया था?
e: Bhartiya rupaye ka prateek (symbol) Udaya Kumar Dharmalingam ne design kiya tha; wo IIT Bombay ke design ke vidyarthi the tatha unka design 2010 mein sarkar dwara sweekar kiya gaya. Iska karan yahi hai ki desh ko apni mudra ke liye ek alag tatha pehchan banane wala chinh chahiye tha, isliye khuli pratispardha ke baad yahi design chuna gaya; ise duniya bhar mein bhartiya mudra ki pehchan ke taur par sweekar kiya gaya. Raghuram Rajan, Urjit Patel tatha Amartya Sen arthatantra tatha niti se jude Prasiddh naam hain, isliye unhe is design ka shreya nahi diya ja sakta. Exam point: bhartiya rupaye ka prateek Udaya Kumar Dharmalingam ne design kiya - yahi 2010 mein sweekar kiya gaya tha.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of NNP?
qh: NNP का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: NNP ka poora roop Net National Product hota hai; ise GNP mein se mulyahras (depreciation) ghata kar nikaala jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki desh ki punji har saal ghis jaati hai, isliye poore utpadan (gross) se is ghisavat ko ghataakar shudh (net) utpadan nikalna padta hai; yahi shudh rashtriya utpadan tatha asli rashtriya aay maana jaata hai. Baaki vikalp NNP ke asli akshar nahi hain, isliye inhe sahi chunav nahi kaha ja sakta.. Exam point: NNP ka poora naam Net National Product hai - yahi GNP mein se mulyahras ghata kar nikaala jaata hai.

qe: What is 'Blue Revolution' related to?
qh: 'नीली क्रांति' (Blue Revolution) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Neeli kraanti (blue revolution) machhli utpadan se judi hai; ismein matsyapalan, jal-kheti tatha samudri utpadan ko badhava dekar machhli tatha samudri utpadan ka paidavar badhaya jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki nadi, jheel tatha samudra ke vishal srot ka sahi upyog karke khadyan suraksha tatha niryat dono badhaye ja sakte hain, isliye sarkar ne matsyapalan ki yojanayen chalaayi. Navy tatha sahari pradushan ke vikalp is kraanti ke kshetra se alag hain, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain.. Exam point: neeli kraanti machhli utpadan se judi hai - yahi jal-kheti tatha samudri paidavar badhane ki yojana hai.

qe: What is the 'Currency Symbol' (₹) design based on?
qh: 'रुपया प्रतीक' का डिजाइन किस पर आधारित है?
e: Rupaye prateek ka design Devanagari akshar 'Ra' tatha Roman capital 'R' ko milakar banaya gaya hai, jismein 'R' ki khadi lakir (vertical bar) nahi hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki ismein Bharat ki sanskritik virasat tatha antarrashtriya pehchan dono ka mel hai, tatha do samantar lakiren rupaye ki rashtriya jhande jaisi dhaarna bhi darshati hain. Keval Devanagari ya keval Roman wale vikalp isi mishran ka sahi vivran nahi dete, isliye wo galat vikalp hain.. Exam point: rupaye prateek ka design Devanagari 'Ra' tatha Roman 'R' ka mel hai - yahi 2010 mein laagu kiya gaya tha.

qe: Which sector's output is not included in 'National Income' calculation?
qh: 'राष्ट्रीय आय' की गणना में किस क्षेत्र का आउटपुट शामिल नहीं है?
e: Rashtriya aay ki ganna mein aisa koi kaam shamil nahi hota jiske badle paisa na mila ho ya jo bazaar mein na becha gaya ho; ghar ka bina vet ka kaam isi karan baahar reh jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki rashtriya aay ka aadhaar bazaar ke len-den tatha paidavar ka moolya hota hai, isliye jis kaam ka koi bazaar bhau nahi hota ushe aankdon mein nahi joda jaata; isi karan gharelu aurton ke kaam ka yogdan aankdon mein nahi dikhta. Nirmaan, krishi tatha banking bazaar se jude kaam hain, isliye ve ganna mein shamil hote hain tatha unhe is prashn ke sahi jod nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: rashtriya aay mein bina bhugtan wale gharelu kaam shamil nahi hote - kyunki unka koi bazaar bhau nahi hota.

qe: What is 'Inclusive Growth'?
qh: 'समावेशी विकास' (Inclusive Growth) क्या है?
o: Growth that benefits all sections of society
e: Samaveshi vikas (inclusive growth) wo vikas hai jiska laabh samaaj ke sabhi vargon, khaas kar garib, kamzor tatha vanchit vargon tak pahunche; ismein keval aankdon ki vriddhi nahi balki rojgar, shiksha tatha swasthya ki bhagidari bhi dekhi jaati hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki yadi vrikash ka laabh sirf amir tabke ko mile to garibi tatha asamanta badhti hai, isliye yojanaon ko samaveshi banane par zor diya jaata hai; isi soch ne NITI Aayog ke lakshya tatha SDG ko janm diya. Keval amiron ya IT kshetra ki vriddhi ise samaveshi nahi banati, isliye ye teen baaki chunav galat thehrte hain.. Exam point: samaveshi vikas samaaj ke sabhi vargon tatha vanchit logon ke liye laabhkarak vikas hota hai - yahi satat vikas ka aadhaar hai.

qe: What is 'Capital Market' used for?
qh: 'पूंजी बाजार' (Capital Market) का उपयोग किसके लिए होता है?
e: Poonji baazar (capital market) ka upyog deerghakalik punji jutane ke liye hota hai; ismein share (equity) tatha bond-karz (debt) dono se lambi avadhi ke liye paisa liya-jaata hai. Iska karan yahi hai ki kamni ko karkhane, machine tatha vistar jaise bade kaamon ke liye lamba paisa chahiye hota hai, isliye wo share tatha bond jari karke poonji baazar se jutta leti hai; short-term zarurat money market poora karta hai. Krishi upaj tatha alpakalik dhan ke vikalp poonji baazar ke kaam se alag hain, isliye inhe sahi nahi thahraya ja sakta.. Exam point: poonji baazar lambi avadhi ke dhan (equity tatha debt) ke liye hota hai - isse kamnian lambi avadhi ke liye punji jutati hain.

qe: Which 'Agency' in India gives 'Credit Ratings' to companies?
qh: भारत में कौन सी 'एजेंसी' कंपनियों को 'क्रेडिट रेटिंग' देती है?
e: CRISIL Bharat ki ek pramukh credit rating agency hai, jo kamnion dwara liye gaye karz ko chukane ki unki kshamata ka aanklan karti hai tatha ushe AAA se D tak ke rating deti hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki niveshkar tatha bankon ko ye jaanana hota hai ki kis kamni ka karz kitna surakshit hai, isliye rating se kamni ke karz lene ki lagat tay hoti hai; AAA rating hone par byaj kam lagta hai. SEBI share bazaar ko tatha RBI bankon ko niyantrit karta hai, isliye unhe credit rating dene wali agency nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: credit rating dene wali pramukh bhartiya agency CRISIL hai - yahi kamni ki karz chukane ki kshamata ka aanklan karti hai.

qe: What is 'Financial Inclusion'?
qh: 'वित्तीय समावेशन' क्या है?
o: Providing affordable financial services to all
e: Vitti samaveshan (financial inclusion) ka matlab hai samaaj ke sabhi vargon, khaas kar garib tatha gaon mein rehne wale logon tak sasti tatha aasaan vitti sevaen pahunchana; jaise bank khata, bachat, bima, karz tatha daigital bhugtan. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki jab log bank vyavastha se jud jaate hain to unki bachat surakshit hoti hai tatha sarkari sahayata seedha unke khate mein pahunch sakti hai, isliye PM Jan Dhan Yojana, aadhaar-seeding tatha UPI is disha ke bade kadam hain. Karz na dena tatha garibon ko bank se bahar rakhna is vichaar ke ulta hai, isliye aise chunav galat thehrte hain. Exam point: vitti samaveshan sabhi ko sasti vitti sevaen pahunchane ko kehte hain - isi disha mein PM Jan Dhan Yojana shuru hui.

qe: What is 'Transfer Payment'?
qh: 'हस्तांतरण भुगतान' (Transfer Payment) क्या है?
o: Payment without any exchange of goods/services (e.g. Pension)
e: Hastantaran bhugtan (transfer payment) wo bhugtan hota hai jiske badle koi maal ya seva nahi li jaati; jaise vriddhavastha pension, chhatravritti, bima ki rakam tatha bekar bhatta. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise bhugtan se sarkar aay ka punarvitaran karti hai tatha kamzor vargon ki madad karti hai, par isse desh ka kul utpadan nahi badhta; isliye ise rashtriya aay ki ganna mein 'transfar' ke roop mein alag dikhaya jaata hai. Kaam ke badle diya gaya vet ya share ka hastantaran is se alag hote hain, isliye unhe transfer payment nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: hastantaran bhugtan mein koi maal ya seva nahi milti - pension tatha chhatravritti iske udaaharan hain.

qe: What is the 'Balance of Payments' (BoP) of a country?
qh: किसी देश का 'भुगतान संतुलन' (BoP) क्या है?
o: Systematic record of all economic transactions with the rest of the world
e: Kisi desh ka bhugtan santulan (BoP) uske tatha baaki duniya ke beech hone wale sabhi aarthik len-den ka vyavasthit tatha poora lekha-jokha hota hai; ismein chalu khata, poonji khata tatha vitti khata shamil hote hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki videshi vyapar, nivesh tatha aay ke sabhi sadhan ek hi jagah darj karne se desh ki bahari sthiti ka sahi chitra milta hai, isliye sarkar tatha RBI isi aankde se niti tay karte hain. Keval kar tatha kharch ka antar ya keval niryat ka record iski paribhasha nahi hai, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: BoP desh tatha baaki duniya ke sabhi aarthik len-den ka vyavasthit record hota hai - ismein chalu tatha poonji khata shamil hote hain.

qe: Which account of BoP includes 'Trade in Goods and Services'?
qh: BoP के किस खाते में 'वस्तुओं और सेवाओं का व्यापार' शामिल होता है?
e: BoP ke chalu khate (current account) mein vastuon tatha sevaon ka vyapar, aay tatha hastantaran bhugtan shamil hote hain; ismein dikhne wale vastu vyapar tatha na dikhne wali sevaen dono aati hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki yahi khata desh ki rozmarra ki bahari kamai tatha kharch dikhata hai, isliye jab ismein aayat niryat se zyada ho jaate hain to chalu khata ghata banta hai; remittance tatha software niryat yahan aate hain. Bachat khata ya poonji khata is shreni ke kshetra nahi hain, isliye unhe current account nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: vastuon tatha sevaon ka vyapar BoP ke chalu khate mein shamil hota hai - yahi ghate tatha adhishth ka mukhya karan banta hai.

qe: What does 'Dumping' mean in international economics?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय अर्थशास्त्र में 'डंपिंग' (Dumping) का क्या अर्थ है?
o: Selling goods abroad at a price lower than domestic price
e: Dumping ka matlab hai kisi desh dwara apne maal ko videsh mein uske gharelu bazaar ki keemat se bhi kam par bechna, taaki doosre desh ka bazaar apne kabze mein le liya jaaye. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise saste maal se aayatik desh ke sthaaniy utpadak peeche chale jaate hain, isliye vishva vyapar sangathan ishe anuchit vyapar vyavhar maanta hai tatha aayatik desh antidung (anti-dumping) shulk laga sakta hai. Kachra samundar mein phenkna ya adhik niryat kar is shabda ka sahi arth nahi hota, isliye unhe dumping nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: dumping mein maal videsh mein gharelu keemat se kam par becha jaata hai - iske khilaf anti-dumping shulk lagta hai.

qe: Which organization publishes the 'Human Development Report' (HDR)?
qh: 'मानव विकास रिपोर्ट' (HDR) कौन सी संस्था प्रकाशित करती है?
e: Manav vikas report (HDR) UNDP prakaashit karta hai; ismein manav vikas soochak (HDI), ling asamanta soochak tatha bahu-aaya garibi soochak jaise aankde hote hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki yahi sanstha aay ke saath-saath shiksha, swasthya tatha jeevan-star ko bhi jodkar deshon ki tulna karti hai, isliye HDR vikas ke aankdon ka pramukh sadhan maana jaata hai. WHO swasthya tatha IMF tatha Vishva Bank mudra-arthavyavastha se juda kaam karte hain, isliye unhe HDR ka prakaashak nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: Manav Vikas Report UNDP prakaashit karta hai - ismein HDI jaise soochak shamil hote hain.

qe: What is 'Sustainable Development'?
qh: 'सतत विकास' (Sustainable Development) क्या है?
o: Growth that meets present needs without compromising future needs
e: Satat vikas (sustainable development) wo vikas hai jismein aaj ki zaruratiyan poori ki jaayein par aane wali peedhiyon ki kshamata par samjhauta na kiya jaaye; yani vriksh tatha paryavaran ke beech santulan. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki andhadhundh audyogik vistar se jungle, paani tatha hawa khatam ho rahe the, isliye Brundtland Aayog ki report (1987) ne yahi vichaar duniya ke saamne rakha tatha aaj SDG (satat vikas lakshya) isi par aadhaar hain. Keval audyogik vriddhi ya keval amir vargon ka vikas ise satat nahi banata, isliye aise chunav galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: satat vikas aaj ki zarurat poori karta hai par aane wali peedhi ki kshamata se samjhauta nahi karta - yahi Brundtland report ki dhaarna hai.

qe: What is 'Personal Disposable Income'?
qh: 'व्यक्तिगत प्रयोज्य आय' (Personal Disposable Income) क्या है?
e: Vyaktigat prayojya aay (personal disposable income) wo aay hai jo vyaktiyon ke paas kar tatha anya katauton ke baad kharach tatha bachat ke liye bachti hai; yani vyaktigat aay mein se vyaktigat kar ghatane par yahi milti hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki vyakti ki asli kharid-shakti isi aay se dikhti hai, isliye mahangi tatha khapat ke aankdon ke vishleshan mein yahi aay kaam aati hai; isi aay badhne par bazaar mein maang badhti hai. Kul vet ya GDP ko janasankhya se baantna is aay ki paribhasha nahi hai, isliye aise vikalp galat thehrte hain. Exam point: vyaktigat prayojya aay = vyaktigat aay - vyaktigat kar - yahi logon ke paas kharach karne yogya asli aay hoti hai.

qe: What is a 'Currency Swap' in international trade?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार में 'करेंसी स्वैप' क्या है?
o: Agreement to exchange currencies and interest rate payments
e: Karincy swap ek aisa samjhauta hai jismein do deshon ke kendriya bank ya sansthaen apni-apni mudraen tatha unke byaj ke bhugtan ek tay avadhi ke liye aapas mein badal leti hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki isse bhaag lene wale desh ko videshi mudra sasti tatha aasaani se mil jaati hai, isliye vyapar tatha nivesh mein aane wali mudra ki lagat ghat jaati hai; yahi vaishvik vitti sankat ke samay taralta ka upay banta hai. Mudra chhod dena ya online trading is shabda ka sahi visthaar nahi hai, isliye unhe currency swap nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: currency swap do pushton ke beech mudra tatha byaj badalne ka samjhauta hota hai - isse videshi mudra ki lagat ghat ti hai.

qe: What is 'Monopoly' in a market?
qh: बाजार में 'एकाधिकार' (Monopoly) क्या है?
e: Monopoly (ekadhikar) aisi bazaar halat ka naam hai jahan kisi vastu ka ek hi utpadak tatha bechne wala hota hai tatha uske koi kareebi vikalp nahi hote. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki keval ek hi bechne wala hone ke karan wo keemat khud tay kar sakta hai tatha naye utpadakon ka pravesh rok paata hai; Bharatiya Rail tatha purani sarkari sansthayein iske udaaharan hain. Bahut se bechne wale ya do bechne wale vikalp kisi anya bazaar sanrachna ke he hain, isliye unhe ekadhikar nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: monopoly mein kisi vastu ka keval ek hi bechne wala hota hai - isi karan wahan keemat par ekadhikar bana reh sakta hai.

qe: In which market structure are there 'Few large sellers' dominating the industry?
qh: किस बाजार संरचना में 'कुछ बड़े विक्रेता' उद्योग पर हावी होते हैं?
e: Oligopoly (alpsankhyadhikar) us bazaar sanrachna ka naam hai jismein thode se bade bechne wale poore udyog par haavi rehte hain; inki kriyaon ka asar ek doosre par padta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki thode bechne wale apni keemat tatha utpadan ki niti ke liye ek doosre par nazar rakhte hain, isliye yahan ek doosre par nirbhar rehna dikhta hai; mobile seva pradata tatha car kamnian iske udaaharan hain. Pure pratispardha tatha monopoly ke vikalp is sanrachna se alag hain tatha monopsony ek khareedar wali halat hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: oligopoly mein kuchh bade bechne wale udyog par haavi hote hain - mobile seva tatha auto kamnian iska udaharan hain.

qe: What does the 'Law of Demand' state?
qh: 'मांग का नियम' क्या कहता है?
e: Maang ka niyam batata hai ki anya cheezein saman rehne par vastu ki keemat badhne par uski maang ghat jaati hai tatha keemat girne par maang badh jaati hai; yani keemat tatha maang mein ulta (inverse) sambandh hota hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki mehanga hone par grahak kam kharidte hain tatha uske vikalp par chal dete hain, isliye maang vakra niche ki or dhalta hai; isi karan yahi niyam adhiktar vastuon par laagu hota hai (Giffen vastuen iske apvaad hain). Keemat badhne par maang badhne wala vikalp ise ulta kar deta, isliye use sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: maang ka niyam kehta hai ki keemat badhne par maang ghatti hai - yani dono mein ulta sambandh hota hai.

qe: What are 'Substitute Goods'?
qh: 'स्थानापन्न वस्तुएं' (Substitute Goods) क्या हैं?
o: Used in place of each other
e: Stanapan (substitute goods) vastuen wo hoti hain jo ek doosre ke badle istemal ki ja sakti hain, kyunki ve ek hi zarurat poori karti hain; jaise chai tatha coffee, sarson tel tatha soya tel. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki jab ek vastu mehangi hoti hai to grahak doosri sasti vastu par chal dete hain, isliye ek ki keemat badhne par doosri ki maang badh jaati hai; yahi 'pratispardhi vastuen' ka gun hai. Keval luxury tatha saath-saath istemal hone wali vastuen is shreni se alag hain, isliye unhe substitute nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: stanapan vastuen ek doosre ke vikalp ke roop mein istemal hoti hain - chai tatha coffee iska pramukh udaharan hain.

qe: What are 'Complementary Goods'?
qh: 'पूरक वस्तुएं' (Complementary Goods) क्या हैं?
o: Used in place of each other
Used together to satisfy a want
e: Poorak (complementary goods) vastuen wo hoti hain jinhe ek saath istemal kiya jaata hai, jaise car tatha petrol, pen tatha ink, mobile tatha charger. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise maal ek doosre ke bina bekaar lagte hain, isliye ek ki keemat badhne par doosre ki maang bhi ghat jaati hai; yahi inhe substitute vastuon se alag banata hai. Mel khane wale ya muft vastuon ke vikalp is paribhasha ko nahi dikhate, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: poorak vastuen ek saath istemal hoti hain - car tatha petrol iska sahi udaharan hai.

qe: What is 'Price Elasticity of Demand'?
qh: 'मांग की कीमत लोच' क्या है?
o: Responsiveness of demand to change in price
e: Maang ki keemat loch (price elasticity of demand) ye batati hai ki keemat mein hone wale badlav ke prati maang kitni sanvedansheel (responsive) hai; ise maang mein pratishat badlav tatha keemat mein pratishat badlav ke anupat se nikaala jaata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki kuchh vastuen (namak, dawa) keemat badhne par bhi utni hi kharidi jaati hain jabki luxury maal ki maang turant badal jaati hai, isliye vyapari tatha sarkar dono kar tatha moolya niti ke liye ise dekhte hain. Aapurti ya kar mein badlav is soochak ka vishay nahi hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: maang ki keemat loch keemat badlav ke prati maang ki sanvedansheelata batati hai - ise pratishat badlav ke anupat se nikaala jaata hai.

qe: Which market has 'Free Entry and Exit' and 'Homogeneous Products'?
qh: किस बाजार में 'स्वतंत्र प्रवेश और निकास' और 'एकसमान उत्पाद' होते हैं?
e: Pure pratispardha (perfect competition) us bazaar ko kehte hain jahan bahut se khareedar tatha bechne wale hote hain, utpad ek jaise (homogeneous) hote hain tatha nayi kamni ka pravesh tatha nikaas khula hota hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki is saunchna mein kisi ek bechne wale ka keemat par koi asar nahi hota tatha use bazaar ki keemat hi maanne padti hai, isliye yahi saunchna sabse adhik pratispardha wali maani jaati hai. Bahut kam bechne wale ya ek bechne wala kisi anya saunchna ke hain, isliye unhe pure pratispardha nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: pure pratispardha mein swatantra pravesh-nikaas tatha ek jaise utpad hote hain - bahut se khareedar-beche wale hote hain.

qe: What is 'Utility' in economics?
qh: अर्थशास्त्र में 'उपयोगिता' (Utility) क्या है?
e: Upyogita (utility) kisi vastu ki wo kshamata hai jisse wo vyakti ki zarurat tatha chah ko poori karti hai; yani yahi vastu se milne wali santushti ka paimana hota hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki kisi vastu ki upyogita vyakti, samay tatha jagah ke hisaab se badal jaati hai - jaise chhate ke liye paani ki upyogita baarish mein badh jaati hai, isliye yahi subjective tatha maanasik paimana hota hai. Utpadan ki lagat, kar ki rakam ya vastu ka bhau upyogita nahi hote, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: upyogita vastu ki zarurat poori karne ki kshamata hoti hai - yahi grahak ko milne wali santushti ka paimana hai.

qe: What is 'Marginal Utility'?
qh: 'सीमांत उपयोगिता' क्या है?
o: Additional utility from one extra unit
e: Seemant upyogita (marginal utility) vastu ki ek atirikt ikai istemal karne se kul upyogita mein jitni vriddhi hoti hai, use kehte hain; yani agla glass paani peene se jo santushti badhi, wahi seemant upyogita hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki upbhokta ki nirnay lene mein seemant upyogita hi seema par kaam aati hai, isliye yahi paimana batata hai ki ek atirikt ikai khareedna faydemand hai ya nahi; aam taur par ye ghat ti jaati hai. Kul santushti tatha ausatan upyogita ke vikalp isse alag dhaarnaen hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: seemant upyogita ek atirikt ikai se milne wali atirikt santushti hoti hai - yahi nirnay lene mein ahem paimana hai.

qe: According to the 'Law of Diminishing Marginal Utility', as consumption increases, MU:
qh: 'घटती सीमांत उपयोगिता के नियम' के अनुसार, जैसे-जैसे उपभोग बढ़ता है, सीमांत उपयोगिता:
e: Ghatti seemant upyogita ka niyam batata hai ki jab koi vyakti kisi vastu ki ek ke baad ek ikaiyan istemal karta jaata hai, to har atirikt ikai se milne wali santushti ghat ti jaati hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki zarurat tript hoti jaati hai - pehla glass sharbat bahut bhaata hai tatha paanchvin glass par aakarshan khatam ho jaata hai, isliye yahi niyam bataata hai ki log kisi vastu ki kin sankhya tak kharidte hain. upyogita ka badhna ya do-gana hona is niyam ke ulta hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: ghatti seemant upyogita ke niyam ke anusaar upabhog badhne par har atirikt ikai ki upyogita ghatti hai - yahi 'kitna kharide' wala faisla tay karta hai.

qe: What is 'Consumer Surplus'?
qh: 'उपभोक्ता अधिशेष' (Consumer Surplus) क्या है?
o: Willingness to pay - Actual price paid
e: Upbhokta adhishth (consumer surplus) grahak us vastu ke liye jitna bhugtan karne ko taiyaar tha tatha usne asal mein jitna diya, in dono ka antar hota hai; yani apraapt laabh (saving). Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki grahak ko vastu ka upyog uske diye gaye bhau se zyada keemti lagta hai - jaise ek vyakti 50 rupaye mein samosa kharidne ko taiyaar tha par 30 mein mil gaya, isliye ushe 20 rupaye ka adhishth mila; yahi upbhokta ke kalyaan ka paimana hai. Aay ya bhugtan ke ulta jod is paribhasha se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: upbhokta adhishth bhugtan ke liye taiyari tatha asli bhugtan ka antar hota hai - yahi grahak ko hua laabh batata hai.

qe: What kind of demand do 'Inelastic' goods like Salt have?
qh: नमक जैसी 'बेलोचदार' वस्तुओं की मांग कैसी होती है?
e: Namak tatha dawa jaisi aavashyak vastuon ki maang belochdaar (inelastic) hoti hai, iska matlab hai ki keemat badhne ya ghatne par unki maang mein bahut hi kam badlav aata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise maal ki zarurat sabhi logon ko har roz padti hai tatha unke aasaani se vikalp nahi milte, isliye grahak keemat badhne par bhi kharidna nahi chhodte; isi karan sarkar aise maalon par kar badhakar rajasv aasaani se jutati hai. Keemat se maang ka bahut zyada badalna ya maang ka shunya ho jana isse alag hai, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: namak jaisi aavashyak vastuon ki maang belochdaar hoti hai - keemat badhne par bhi unki maang lagbhag wahi rehti hai.

qe: What is 'Monopsony'?
qh: 'मोनोप्सोनी' (Monopsony) क्या है?
e: Monopsony aisi bazaar halat hoti hai jahan kisi vastu ka ek hi khareedar hota hai; uske saamne bahut se bechne wale khade rehte hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki keval ek khareedar hone se wahi keemat tay karne mein sabse zyada saksham hota hai - jaise ek bade karkhane ke liye gaon ke sabhi dairy kisan doodh bechte hain, isliye unhe uske diye bhau par hi bechna padta hai. Do khareedar ya ek bechne wala is avdharna se alag hai tatha ek bechne wala to monopoly hota hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: monopsony mein kisi vastu ka keval ek hi khareedar hota hai - yahi keemat tay karne mein sabse zyada samarth hota hai.

qe: Which curve shows the various combinations of two goods that give the same satisfaction?
qh: कौन सा वक्र दो वस्तुओं के उन संयोजनों को दिखाता है जो समान संतुष्टि देते हैं?
e: Udaseenata vakra (indifference curve) do vastuon ke aise sabhi sanyojanon (combinations) ko dikhata hai jinse grahak ko barabar santushti milti hai; isliye grahak inmein se kisi bhi sanyojan ke prati udaseen rehta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki in sabhi binduon par kul upyogita saman rehti hai, isliye vakra ka jhukav niche ki or (negatively sloped) hota hai; yahi vakra upbhokta ki pasand tatha aay tatha keemat ke aadhaar par santulan dhoondhne mein kaam aata hai. Maang vakra, aapurti vakra ya Laffer vakra anya vishay dikhate hain, isliye unhe is avdharna ke sahi jod nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: udasinta vakra saman santushti dene wale sanyojan batata hai - grahak iske sabhi binduon par udaseen rehta hai.

qe: What is the 'Veblen Effect'?
qh: 'वेबलेन प्रभाव' (Veblen Effect) क्या है?
o: Demand increases as price increases for luxury goods
e: Veblen effect (prabhav) ke anusaar mehangi tatha luxury vastuon ki maang unki keemat badhne par badh jaati hai, kyunki aise maal kharidna izzat tatha status ka prateek maana jaata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki kuchh grahak doosron ko dikhane ke liye mehanga maal chunte hain, isliye chiiz sasti ho jaane par unke liye uska aakarshan khatam ho jaata hai; heera tatha luxury car iske udaaharan hain. Keemat badhne par maang ghatna to samanya niyam hai tatha maang ka sthir rehna bhi is prabhav se alag hai, isliye aise vikalp galat thehrte hain. Exam point: Veblen prabhav mein mehange maal ki maang keemat badhne par badh jaati hai - yahi status dikhane wali kharid hai.

qe: What is the income effect for 'Normal Goods'?
qh: 'सामान्य वस्तुओं' (Normal Goods) का आय प्रभाव क्या है?
e: Samanya vastuon (normal goods) par aay ka prabhav yahi hota hai ki aay badhne par unki maang bhi badh jaati hai; jaise khane-peene ki achhi cheezen tatha kapde. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aay badhne se grahak ke paas kharidne ki zyada shamta ho jaati hai tatha wo aisi vastuen kharidta hai jinhe wo pehle kam leta tha, isliye 'aay up, maang up' wala seedha sambandh banta hai. Aay badhne par maang ghatne wala vikalp ghatiya vastuon ke liye hota hai tatha koi badlav na hona bhi is niyam se alag hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: samanya vastuon mein aay badhne par maang badhti hai - yahi seedha (positive) aay prabhav kehlata hai.

qe: What is the income effect for 'Inferior Goods'?
qh: 'घटिया वस्तुओं' (Inferior Goods) का आय प्रभाव क्या है?
e: Ghatiya vastuon (inferior goods) par aay ka prabhav ulta hota hai - aay badhne par inki maang ghat jaati hai.
