Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aay badhne par log behtar gunvatta wale tatha mehange vikalp par chal jaate hain; jaise mota anaaj ki jagah gehun, ya gaon ke saste kapdon ki jagah branded kapde, isliye unki maang gir jaati hai. Aay badhne par maang badhne wala ya saman rehne wala vikalp ghatiya vastuon ke sahi gun nahi hain, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: ghatiya vastuon mein aay badhne par maang ghat jaati hai - log behtar vikalp par chal jaate hain.

qe: What market structure is a 'Cartel' associated with?
qh: 'कार्टेल' (Cartel) किससे संबंधित है?
e: Cartel ka sambandh oligopoly se hota hai; cartel us waqt banta hai jab ek hi tarah ke maal banane wali kuchh badi kamnian aapas mein milkar keemat, utpadan tatha bazaar ke baantware ka samjhauta kar leti hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki is samjhauta se ve aapas ki pratispardha ghatakar ek saath monopoly jaisa labh kamati hain, isliye OPEC (tel-utpadak deshon ka sangh) iska sabse mashhoor udaharan hai; par kai deshon mein cartel banaana kanun ke khilaf hota hai. Pure pratispardha ya monopoly wale vikalp is avdharna ke sahi kshetra nahi hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: cartel kai kamnion ke milkar keemat tay karne wale samjhauta ko kehte hain - yahi oligopoly ke udyogon mein banta hai, jaise OPEC.

qe: What is the 'Break-even Point'?
qh: 'ब्रेक-इवन पॉइंट' क्या है?
e: Break-even bindu wo utpadan ka star hota hai jahan kamni ki kul aay (total revenue) tatha kul lagat (total cost) barabar ho jaate hain; is bindu par na labh hota hai na hani. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki iske pehle lagat aay se zyada hoti hai tatha iske baad nuksan se labh shuru ho jaata hai, isliye har vyapari ke liye ye bindu jaanna zaroori hai; yahi uski nirnay lene ki seema hoti hai. Keval hani ya bahut adhik labh wale vikalp ise paribhashit nahi karte, isliye aise chunav galat thehrte hain. Exam point: break-even bindu par kul aay tatha kul lagat barabar hoti hai - yahan na labh hota hai na hani.

qe: What is the 'Invisible Hand' concept by Adam Smith?
qh: एडम स्मिथ का 'इनविजिबल हैंड' (अदृश्य हाथ) सिद्धांत क्या है?
e: Adam Smith ke 'invisible hand' (adrishya haath) siddhant ke anusaar vyakti jab apne svarth ke liye kaam karta hai to bina jaan-boojhkar samaaj ke bhale ke liye bhi kaam kar deta hai; yani bazaar khud ko sambhalta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki keemat ka paddhati maang tatha aapurti ko aisa mel deti hai ki utpadak tatha upbhokta dono ka bhala ho jaata hai, isliye unhe sarkar ke hastyakshep ki zarurat kam padti hai; yahi vichaar laissez-faire niti ka aadhaar hai. Kar lagana tatha sarkari niyantran is siddhant ke ulta padta hai, isliye inhe sahi uttar nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: invisible hand siddhant bazaar ke swayam niyantran ki baat karta hai - vyakti ke svarth se samaaj ka bhala hota hai.

qe: What is 'Fixed Cost'?
qh: 'स्थिर लागत' (Fixed Cost) क्या है?
o: Does not change with output level
e: Sthir lagat (fixed cost) aisa kharach hota hai jo utpadan ke star ke badal ne se nahi badalta; jaise karkhane ka kiraya, machine par lagayi punji, bima tatha sthayi karmchariyon ke vet. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye kharche poore samay chalte rehte hain chahe utpadan ho ya band rahe, isliye utpadan shunya hone par bhi unhe chukana padta hai; isi karan inhe 'overhead' bhi kehte hain. Keval majduri ya utpadan ke saath badalne wali lagat isse alag hai, isliye unhe sthir lagat nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: sthir lagat utpadan ke star ke saath nahi badalti - karkhane ka kiraya iska pramukh udaharan hai.

qe: What is 'Variable Cost'?
qh: 'परिवर्तनीय लागत' (Variable Cost) क्या है?
e: Parivartansheel lagat (variable cost) aisa kharach hota hai jise utpadan ghatane-badhane ke saath ghatana-badhana padta hai; jaise kachcha maal, bijli, majduri tatha parivahan. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki utpadan badhane par zyada kachcha maal tatha zyada majduri lagti hai, isliye ye kharche upar niche hote rehte hain; utpadan band karne par yahi lagat shunya ke kareeb pahunch jaati hai. Kiraya tatha sthair kharche is shreni mein nahi aate, isliye unhe parivartansheel lagat nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: parivartansheel lagat utpadan ke saath badalti hai - kachcha maal tatha bijli iske udaharan hain.

qe: Which market structure has 'Branded Products' that are slightly differentiated?
qh: किस बाजार संरचना में 'ब्रांडेड उत्पाद' होते हैं जो एक दूसरे से थोड़े अलग होते हैं?
e: Ekadhikaratik pratispardha (monopolistic competition) us bazaar sanrachna ko kehte hain jismein bahut se bechne wale apne-alag branded tatha thode bhinn utpad bechte hain; jaise soap, shampoo tatha cold drink ke brands. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki har kamni apne brand ke naam tatha vigyapan se grahak ko apni or kheencti hai, isliye use thodi ekadhikari taaqat mil jaati hai par poori keemat tay karne ki shakti nahi hoti; isi karan yahan vigyapan tatha brand ki badi bhoomika hoti hai. Pure pratispardha mein utpad ek jaise hote hain tatha monopoly tatha oligopoly mein bechne wale kam, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: ekadhikaratik pratispardha mein branded tatha thode bhinn utpad hote hain - soap tatha shampoo ke brand iska udaharan hain.

qe: What is the elasticity value of 'Perfectally Elastic Demand'?
qh: पूर्णतः लोचदार मांग की 'लोच' क्या होती है?
e: Poornat: lochdaar (perfectly elastic) maang ki loch anant (infinite) hoti hai; iska matlab hai ki keemat ke thoda sa bhi badhne par maang shunya ho jaati hai tatha usi ek keemat par grahak jitna chaahein kharidne ko taiyaar rehte hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki bahut hi pratispardha wale bazaar mein ek bechne wala keemat thodisi bhi badhata hai to uske sabhi grahak doosre bechne walon ke paas chale jaate hain, isliye maang rekha kshetij (horizontal) ban jaati hai. Shunya ya ek wali loch isse alag surat hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: poornat: lochdaar maang ki loch anant hoti hai - keemat badhne par is vastu ki maang turant khatam ho jaati hai.

qe: What is 'Duopoly'?
qh: 'डुओपोली' (Duopoly) क्या है?
e: Duopoly (dvipolik bazaar) mein kisi utpad ke keval do bechne wale hote hain; yahi oligopoly ka ek khaas roop hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki keval do bechne wale hone se dono ek doosre ke nashe mein hote hain tatha unmein keemat tatha utpadan ko lekar teevra pratispardha ya samjhauta dono ho sakte hain; jaise purane daur mein Pepsi tatha Coca-Cola jaisi kamnian. Ek khareedar wala vikalp monopsony batata hai tatha bahut se bechne wale pure pratispardha, isliye unhe uchit jod nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: duopoly mein keval do bechne wale hote hain - yahi oligopoly ka khaas roop hai.

qe: What is a 'Price War' characteristic of?
qh: 'मूल्य युद्ध' (Price War) किसकी विशेषता है?
e: Keemat yuddh (price war) oligopoly ki ek khaas pehchaan hai; ismein thode se badi kamnion ke beech ek doosre se kam keemat lagaakar bazaar ka hissa badhane ka daur chalta rehta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki oligopoly mein har kamni doosri ki keemat par nazar rakhti hai, isliye ek keemat ghatate hi baaki bhi ghata deti hain; isse grahakon ko sasta maal milta hai par kamnion ka munafa ghat jaata hai. Pure pratispardha tatha monopoly mein aisi hoyi nahi hoti, isliye unhe keemat yuddh ka karan nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: keemat yuddh oligopoly ki pehchaan hai - ismein thode se bechne wale keemat ghatakar bazaar ka hissa badhate hain.

qe: What is 'Sunk Cost'?
qh: 'निहित लागत' (Sunk Cost) क्या है?
o: Cost already incurred and cannot be recovered
e: Doobee hui lagat (sunk cost) wo kharach hota hai jo pahle hi kharch ho chuka hota hai tatha ab kisi bhi tareeke se wapas nahi aata; jaise kisi purane karkhane ki machine par kiya gaya kharch. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye rakam ab bhavishya ke nirnay ko prabhavit nahi karni chahiye, isliye arthashastra kehta hai ki doobee hui lagat ko dekhkar nivesh ka faisla nahi lena chahiye; yahi soch sahi nirnay lene mein madad karti hai. Rozmarra ka munafa tatha bhavishya ki lagat is se alag baatein hain, isliye unhe sunk cost nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: sunk cost pahle kharch ho chuki tatha wapas na hone wali lagat hoti hai - ise bhavishya ke nirnay mein jodna nahi chahiye.

qe: What is the relationship between Price and Quantity Supplied in the 'Law of Supply'?
qh: कीमत और आपूर्ति की मात्रा के बीच 'आपूर्ति का नियम' क्या संबंध बताता है?
e: Aapurti ka niyam batata hai ki keemat tatha aapurti ki matara mein seedha (direct) sambandh hota hai; yani bhaav chadhne par bechne wale zyada maal bechne ko taiyaar hote hain tatha bhaav girne par kam. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki uchch bhaav par munafa ki sambhavna zyada hoti hai, isliye vyapari zyada maal bazaar mein laate hain; isse alag maang ka niyam ulla rukh dikhata hai. Koi sambandh na hona ya ulla sambandh is niyam ke ulta hai, isliye aise chunav galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: aapurti ka niyam keemat tatha aapurti mein seedha sambandh batata hai - keemat badhne par aapurti badhti hai.

qe: What is 'Market Equilibrium'?
qh: 'बाजार संतुलन' (Market Equilibrium) क्या है?
e: Bazaar santulan (market equilibrium) wo bindu hota hai jahan kisi vastu ki maang tatha aapurti barabar ho jaati hain; is bindu par tay hui keemat par bechne wale tatha kharidne wale dono santusht rehte hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki is keemat par na to mal (maal) bacha reh jaata hai na kami hoti hai, isliye bazaar mein sthirta bani rehti hai; maang zyada hone par keemat badhti hai tatha aapurti zyada hone par girti hai, aur santulan khud ban jaata hai. Maang aapurti se kam ya zyada hone wale vikalp santulan ki paribhasha se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: bazaar santulan par maang tatha aapurti barabar hoti hain - isi bindu par keemat sthir rehti hai.

qe: What is a 'Price Ceiling'?
qh: 'मूल्य सीमा' (Price Ceiling) क्या है?
o: Max legal price set by govt
e: Moolya seema (price ceiling) sarkar dwara tay ki gayi sabse adhik kanuni keemat hoti hai; yani veh bhau jisse upar bechne ki ijazat nahi hoti. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki zaruri cheezon (jaise jeevan-rakshak dawa) par ise santulan keemat se niche rakha jaata hai, taaki aam aadmi ushe kharid sake; par zyada niche rakhne par kami (shortage) tatha kaali keemati bazaar paida ho sakta hai. Bazaar ki keemat ya sarkar dwara tay ki gayi nyuntam keemat is shabda se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: moolya seema sarkar dwara tay ki gayi sabse adhik keemat hoti hai - ise aam upbhokta ko bachane ke liye lagaya jaata hai.

qe: What is a 'Price Floor'?
qh: 'मूल्य तल' (Price Floor) क्या है?
o: Min legal price set by govt
e: Moolya tal (price floor) sarkar dwara tay ki gayi sabse kam kanuni keemat hoti hai; isse kam bhau par maal bechna manaa hota hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki kisano tatha majdooron ko bhau girne se bachane ke liye yahi upay apnaya jaata hai - jaise anaj par nyuntam samarthan moolya tatha majduri par nyuntam vet; par bahut adhik upar rakhne par bajari (surplus) bach jaata hai. Bazaar ki keemat ya samarthan ke upar wali keemat is paribhasha se alag hai, isliye aise vikalp galat thehrte hain. Exam point: moolya tal sarkar dwara tay ki gayi sabse kam keemat hoti hai - MSP iska pramukh udaharan hai.

qe: Which law states that 'Supply creates its own demand'?
qh: किस नियम के अनुसार 'आपूर्ति अपनी मांग स्वयं बनाती है'?
e: Sai ka niyam kehta hai ki 'aapurti apni maang khud paida kar leti hai'; yani utpadan se hi utni aay paida hoti hai jitni ki maal kharidne ke liye zaruri hoti hai, isliye kul maang tatha kul aapurti hamesha barabar rahengi. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki yahi vichaar shastriya (classical) arthashastra ka aadhaar tha tatha iske anusaar bazaar mein atirikt utpadan reh hi nahi sakta; Keynes ne isi niyam ko chunauti di tatha bataya ki maang ki kami se mandi aa sakti hai. Gresham ka niyam mudra se juda hai tatha Keynes ka naam is niyam se nahi juda, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: 'aapurti apni maang khud banaati hai' - yahi J.B. Say ka niyam hai jo shastriya arthashastra ka aadhaar tha.

qe: Which factor of production earns 'Interest'?
qh: उत्पादन का कौन सा कारक 'ब्याज' (Interest) अर्जित करता है?
e: Utpadan ka wo sadhan 'poonji' (capital) hota hai jo byaj (interest) arjit karta hai; iske alawa zameen kirae (rent), shram majduri (wages) tatha udyami labh (profit) paata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki machine, bhawan tatha dhan ke roop mein lagayi gayi punji ka upyog karne ke liye udyami karz leta hai tatha us par byaj deta hai, isliye yahi sadhan byaj ka sahi jod hai. Zameen, shram tatha udyami is sadhan ke vikalarn nahi hain, isliye unhe is prashn ka sahi uttar nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: utpadan ka poonji wala sadhan byaj arjit karta hai - zameen kirae, shram majduri tatha udyami labh paata hai.

qe: What is the 'Production Possibility Frontier' (PPF)?
qh: 'उत्पादन संभावना सीमा' (PPF) क्या है?
o: Graph showing max possible output combinations
e: Utpadan sambhavna seema (PPF) wo curve hota hai jo do vastuon ke aise adhiktam sanyojanon ko dikhata hai jo diye hue sadhanon tatha taknik se paida kiye ja sakte hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki sadhan seemit hone ke karan ek vastu ka utpadan badhane ke liye doosri vastu ka utpadan kam karna padta hai, isliye yahi curve 'lagaat se chunav' (opportunity cost) tatha vikalp ki lagat (opportunity cost) ko darshata hai; ispar bindu curve ke andar ho to sadhan bekaar hain tatha bahar ho to asambhav hai. Kar ki seema ya aapurti curve wale vikalp is avdharna se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: PPF diye gaye sadhanon se do vastuon ke adhiktam sanyojan dikhata hai - yahi lagaat se chunav ka chitra hai.

qe: Who wrote 'The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money'?
qh: 'द जनरल थ्योरी ऑफ एम्प्लॉयमेंट, इंटरेस्ट एंड मनी' किसने लिखी थी?
e: 'The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money' (1936) J.M. Keynes ne likhi thi; isi pustak ne samasti arthashastra ki neev rakhi tatha bataya ki kul maang badhaakar rozgar paida kiya ja sakta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki us daur ki mahan mandi (1929) ne dikhaya ki bazaar apne-aap poora rozgar nahi de paata, isliye sarkar ko kharch badhane ki salah dene wali yeh pustak krantikari maani gayi. Karl Marx ne 'Das Kapital', Marshall ne 'Principles of Economics' tatha Adam Smith ne 'Wealth of Nations' likhi, isliye unhe is pustak ka lekhak nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: 'The General Theory of Employment, Interest and Money' J.M. Keynes ki pustak hai - yahi aadhunik samasti arthashastra ka aadhaar hai.

qe: What are the theoretical units of 'Utility' called?
qh: 'उपयोगिता' को मापने की इकाइयों को क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Upyogita ko maapne ki kalpanik ikai ko 'utils' kaha jaata hai; yani jitni adhik ikaiyan, utni adhik santushti. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki upyogita ek maanasik tatha subjective anubhav hai jise rupaye ya kilo me nahi tola ja sakta, isliye iske liye alag ikai kalp gayi; par vastav mein iski sahi maap sambhav nahi hai, isliye yahi vishleshan ka ek upay maatra hai. Joules tatha grams tatha anya vikalp urja tatha bhaar ki ikaiyan hain, isliye unhe upyogita ki ikai nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: upyogita maapne ki kalpanik ikai ko utils kehte hain - yahi santushti ka subjective paimana hai.

qe: What is 'Consumer Equilibrium'?
qh: 'उपभोक्ता संतुलन' क्या है?
e: Upbhokta santulan ke haal ka matlab hai ki grahak apni di hui aay ko aise kharch kar raha hai jisse use adhiktam kul santushti mil rahi ho; is star par use kharach ka tarika badalne ki zarurat mehsoos nahi hoti. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki grahak har vastu par laga aakhri rupaya barabar santushti de raha hota hai (seemant upyogita tatha keemat ka anupat saman hone par), isliye yahi uske santulan ka bindu hota hai; vigyan-moolya sidhant isi ki vyakhya karta hai. Shunya kharach ya adhiktam bachat wale vikalp is avdharna se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: upbhokta santulan tab hota hai jab di hui aay se adhiktam santushti milti ho - har vastu par laga aakhri rupaya barabar santushti deta hai.

qe: What is the usual slope of a 'Demand Curve'?
qh: 'मांग वक्र' का ढलान आमतौर पर कैसा होता है?
e: Maang vakra ka dhalaan aam taur par neeche ki or (downward sloping) hota hai, kyunki keemat tatha maang mein ulta sambandh hota hai - keemat kam hone par maang badhti hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki keemat girne par ek hi aay se zyada maal kharida ja sakta hai tatha naye grahak bhi jud jaate hain, isliye curve baayin se daayin niche ki or gira hua dikhta hai. horizontal, khada ya upar ki or jhuka vakra is niyam ke ulta hoga, isliye unhe maang vakra ka samanya roop nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: maang vakra niche ki or jhukta hai - yahi keemat tatha maang ke ulta sambandh ko dikhata hai.

qe: What is the usual slope of a 'Supply Curve'?
qh: 'आपूर्ति वक्र' का ढलान आमतौर पर कैसा होता है?
e: Aapurti vakra ka dhalaan aam taur par upar ki or (upward sloping) hota hai, kyunki mehange bhaav milne par bechne wale zyada maal bazaar mein laane ko raazi ho jaate hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki oonche bhaav par karkhane zyada utpadan karke zyada kamai kar sakte hain, isliye aisa vakra baayin se daayin upar ki or utha hua dikhta hai. Niche jhukta ya kshetij vakra isse alag hai, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: aapurti vakra upar ki or jhukta hai - yahi keemat tatha aapurti ke seedhe sambandh ko dikhata hai.

qe: What is a 'Fixed Factor' of production?
qh: उत्पादन का 'स्थिर कारक' (Fixed Factor) क्या है?
e: Utpadan ka sthir karak (fixed factor) wo sadhan hota hai jo chhoti avadhi mein aasaani se badla nahi ja sakta; jaise zameen, karkhane ki building tatha bade yantra. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise sadhanon ko badhane ke liye zameen kharidna ya naya bhawan khada karna padta hai tatha samay lagta hai, isliye alpakal mein ye sthir rehte hain; inhi se sthir lagat paida hoti hai. Majduri tatha kachcha maal aasaani se ghataye-badhaye ja sakte hain, isliye unhe sthir karak nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: sthir karak alpakal mein nahi badalte - zameen tatha bhawan iske udaaharan hain.

qe: What is a 'Variable Factor' of production?
qh: उत्पादन का 'परिवर्तनीय कारक' (Variable Factor) क्या है?
e: Utpadan ka parivartansheel karak (variable factor) wo sadhan hota hai jise alpakal mein bhi ghataya ya badhaya ja sakta hai, taaki utpadan mein badlav kiya ja sake; jaise shram, kachcha maal, bijli tatha indhan. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki inki matra utpadan ke hisaab se turant badal jaati hai, isliye utpadan badhane par inhe zyada lagana padta hai tatha inhi se parivartansheel lagat banti hai. Zameen tatha machine waale vikalp lambe samay ki soch se juda hain, isliye unhe parivartansheel karak nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: parivartansheel karak utpadan ke saath badalte hain - shram tatha kachcha maal iske udaharan hain.

qe: What is 'Fixed Exchange Rate' system also known as?
qh: 'स्थिर विनिमय दर' प्रणाली को और किस नाम से जाना जाता है?
e: Sthir vinimay dar pranali ko 'pegged exchange rate' bhi kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein desh apni mudra ki keemat kisi doosri mudra ya sone ke saath baandh (peg) deta hai tatha use usi star par banaaye rakhta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki isse videshi vyapar tatha nivesh mein anishchitata ghat ti hai, isliye chhote tatha viksansheel desh aksar ise apn aate hain; par ise banaye rakhne ke liye kendriya bank ko reserve kharch karne padte hain. Lochdaar ya float hone wali pranali is se ulta kaam karti hai, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: sthir vinimay dar pranali ko pegged exchange rate kehte hain - ismein kendriya bank mudra ki keemat baandh kar rakhta hai.

qe: What happens to the value of domestic currency in 'Appreciation'?
qh: 'मुद्रा के अधिमूल्यन' (Appreciation) में घरेलू मुद्रा के मूल्य का क्या होता है?
e: Mudra ke adhimoolyan (appreciation) mein gharelu mudra ki keemat videshi mudraon ke muqable badh jaati hai; yani ek rupaye se pehle ke muqable zyada dolar milta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki jab desh mein videshi nivesh tatha niryat badhti hai ya mudra ki maang badhti hai to uski keemat upar chali jaati hai, isliye aayat sasti tatha niryat mehangi ho jaati hai; par sarkar ke liye karz chukana sasta ho jaata hai. Keemat ghatna ya samaan rehna adhimoolyan se alag hai, isliye aise vikalp galat thehrte hain. Exam point: adhimoolyan mein gharelu mudra ki keemat badhti hai - yani mudra videshi mudraon ke muqable mazboot ho jaati hai.

qe: What is a 'Managed Floating' exchange rate system often called?
qh: 'मैनेज्ड फ्लोटिंग' विनिमय दर को अक्सर क्या कहा जाता है?
e: Majed floating vinimay dar ko 'dirty float' bhi kaha jaata hai, kyunki ismein dar bazaar tay karta hai par kendriya bank zarurat padne par karobar karke use apne paksh mein badal deta hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki poora free float chhod dene par mudra bahut upar-niche ho sakti hai, isliye RBI bahut tez girawat ya badhotri rokne ke liye bahar-ghar (intervention) karta hai; Bharat aaj isi vyavastha mein hai. Sthir dar ya clean float wale vikalp is pranali se alag hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: majed floating ko dirty float kehte hain - ismein dar bazaar tay karta hai par kendriya bank beech-beech mein hastyakshep karta hai.

qe: What are 'Remittances' in Balance of Payments?
qh: BoP में 'प्रेषण' (Remittances) क्या हैं?
o: Money sent by migrants to their home country
e: BoP mein preshan (remittances) wo dhan hai jo videsh mein kaam karne wale ya videsh mein rehne wale log apne desh wapas bhejte hain; yani pravasi bharatiyon ki kamai ka wahi hissa jo ghar bheja jaata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki ye rakam chalu khate ke 'aay tatha hastantaran' ke madan mein aa jaati hai, isliye yahi desh ke liye muft videshi mudra ka pramukh srot banta hai; Bharat duniya mein sabse adhik remittance paane wale deshon mein shamil hai. Sarkari rit ya vastuon ka aayat ise ghatan se alag hai, isliye unhe preshan nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: preshan pravasiyon dwara ghar bheji gayi rakam hoti hai - yahi BoP ke chalu khate ka mahatvapurna hissa hai.

qe: What is 'Soft Currency'?
qh: 'सॉफ्ट करेंसी' (Soft Currency) क्या है?
o: Currency expected to fluctuate or depreciate easily
e: Soft currency wo mudra hoti hai jiske moolya mein girawat tatha utaaran-chadhaav ki sambhavna zyada hoti hai; aam taur par viksansheel deshon ki mudraen is shreni mein aati hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki aise deshon ki arthavyavastha tatha videshi mudra ke bhandar kam majboot hote hain, isliye antarrashtriya vyapar mein vyapari ushe rakhna pasand nahi karte; iske ulta dolar tatha euro jaisi hard currency vishwasniya maani jaati hai. Sona ya nakad rakhna is shabda ke sahi arth nahi hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: soft currency wo hoti hai jiske moolya mein girawat tatha utaaran-chadhaav ki sambhavna zyada ho - yahi viksansheel deshon ki mudra hoti hai.

qe: What is 'Convertibility' of currency?
qh: मुद्रा की 'परिवर्तनीयता' क्या है?
o: Ease of exchanging domestic currency for foreign currency
e: Mudra ki parivartaniyata (convertibility) ka matlab hai gharelu mudra ko videshi mudraon mein aasaani se badalne ki suvidha; ise do khate ke hisaab se dekha jaata hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki vyapar tatha nivesh ke liye ye suvidha zaroori hai, isliye Bharat mein chalu khate par poori parivartaniyata hai par poonji khate par seemit, taaki tez girawat tatha speculation se bacha ja sake. Noton ko badalna ya shunya kar wala vikalp is avdharna se alag hai, isliye use sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: parivartaniyata gharelu mudra ko videshi mudra mein badalne ki suvidha hai - Bharat mein chalu khate par poori parivartaniyata hai.

qe: What is a 'Trade Barrier'?
qh: 'व्यापार बाधा' (Trade Barrier) क्या है?
o: Govt restrictions on international trade (Tariffs, Quotas)
e: Vyapar badha (trade barrier) wo sarkari rok tatha shart hoti hai jo antarrashtriya vyapar ko seemit karti hai; jaise aayat shulk (tariff), kouta tatha licence wali vyavastha. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki inke zariye sarkar gharelu utpadakon ko videshi pratispardha se bachaati hai, isliye yahi sansadhan sanrakshan ka upay maana jaata hai; par bahut adhik rok se upbhokta ko mehanga maal milta hai. Bhaasha ka antar ya samudri toofan tatha tatal ke vikalp manav-dwara lagaye gaye niyam nahi hain, isliye unhe trade barrier nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: vyapar badha sarkar ki lagayi gayi rok hoti hai - jaise aayat shulk tatha kouta.

qe: Which organization publishes the 'World Trade Report'?
qh: 'विश्व व्यापार रिपोर्ट' कौन प्रकाशित करता है?
e: Vishva Vyapar Report WTO prakaashit karta hai; ismein duniya bhar ke vyapar ke rukh, tariff tatha kar tatha vyapar niti ke vishyon ka vishleshan hota hai. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki WTO hi antarrashtriya vyapar ke niyam banata tatha unka palan karata hai, isliye uski report vyapar niti tay karne wale sarkaron tatha niveshkaron ke liye ahem hoti hai. Vishva Bank tatha IMF ki apni-apni report hoti hai jo vikas tatha mudra se juda aankde deti hain, isliye is report ke prakaashak ke roop mein inhe nahi chuna ja sakta. Exam point: Vishva Vyapar Report WTO prakaashit karta hai - yahi vaishvik vyapar ke rukh ka vishleshan deti hai.

qe: What is the definition of a 'Micro' enterprise under the 2020 MSME norms?
qh: निवेश के आधार पर 'सूक्ष्म' (Micro) उद्यम की नई परिभाषा क्या है?
o: Investment up to 1 Crore and turnover up to 5 Crore
e: Nayi MSME paribhasha (2020) ke anusaar sukshm (micro) udyam wo hai jismein nivesh 1 crore rupaye tak tatha turn over (karkardagi) 5 crore rupaye tak ho; iske alawa laghu (small) tatha madhyam (medium) shreniyaan bhi tay ki gayi hain. Iske peeche ki vajah yahi hoti hai ki purani paribhasha keval nivesh par aadhaarit thi tatha usme kai alag-alag seemayein thi, isliye nayi paribhasha mein turn over ko bhi joda gaya tatha vinirman tatha seva udyogon ke liye alag seemayein rakhi gayi; isse chhote udyogon ko karz tatha riyayat ka laabh milta hai. 5 ya 10 crore ke keval nivesh wale vikalp nayi paribhasha ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: nayi MSME paribhasha mein sukshm udyam 1 crore tak nivesh tatha 5 crore tak turn over wala hota hai - isi se karz tatha riyayat ke laabh milte hain.

qe: What is the 'Full Form' of MSME?
qh: MSME का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
e: MSME ka poora roop Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises hai; yani sukshm, laghu tatha madhyam udyam. Iski zarurat isliye padi ki ek hi chhata ke neeche teen alag shreniyaan rakhi jaayein, jinki seemayein nivesh tatha turn over ke aadhaar par 2020 mein dobara tay hui tatha Udyam portal par ek hi panjikaran shuru hua; yahi kshetra desh ke GDP ka lagbhag 30 pratishat tatha niryat ka 45 pratishat deta hai. Micro Scale Main Enterprise tatha Medium and Small Mini Enterprises jaise naam kalpanik hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: MSME ka poora roop Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises hai - kheti ke baad yahi kshetra sabse zyada rozgar deta hai.

qe: Which scheme was launched to provide 'LPG Connections' to BPL households?
qh: BPL परिवारों को 'एलपीजी कनेक्शन' प्रदान करने के लिए कौन सी योजना शुरू की गई थी?
e: BPL parivaron ki mahilaon ko dhuein wala chulha chhodkar saaf gas dene ke liye PM Ujjwala Yojana shuru ki gayi thi; is yojana mein deposit ke bina LPG connection, pehla refill tatha chulha muft milta hai. Iski zarurat isliye padi ki bandh kamre ki lakdi tatha uple se hone wala pradushan auraton ke phephron tatha aankhon ko nuksan pahunchata tha; gas ke connection se unka samay tatha mehnat bhi bachta hai tatha lakdi ka dabaav jungle par kam padta hai. PM Awas Yojana pukka ghar dene ke liye tatha PM Jan Dhan Yojana bank khate kholne ke liye hai, isliye ye teeno galat chunav hain. Exam point: BPL parivaron ko LPG connection dene ke liye PM Ujjwala Yojana chalayi gayi - iska 2016 mein udghatan hua tha.

qe: What is a 'Special Economic Zone' (SEZ) primarily meant for?
qh: 'विशेष आर्थिक क्षेत्र' (SEZ) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या है?
e: Vishesh aarthik shetra (SEZ) banaane ka mukhya uddeshya niryat badhana tatha videshi nivesh laana hai; in kshetron mein udyogon ko kar chhoot, sasti bijli tatha ek-khidki manzoori jaisi suvidhaen di jaati hain. Iski zarurat isliye padi ki niryatkar utpad mahenga padta tha tatha seekh li gayi baat ye thi ki vishesh suvidhaon se nivesh tatha rozgar dono badhte hain; SEZ Adhiniyam 2005 se unhe kanuni roop mila. Jansankhya ghatana ya kheti badhana in kshetron ka uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: SEZ ka uddeshya niryat tatha videshi nivesh badhana hai - iske liye kar chhoot tatha aasaan niyam milte hain.

qe: What is a 'Debenture' in financial markets?
qh: वित्तीय बाजार में 'डिबेंचर' (Debenture) क्या है?
o: A debt instrument used by companies to borrow long-term funds
e: Debenture woh karz patra hota hai jise kamni lambi avadhi ke liye dhan jutane ke liye jaari karti hai; iske dhaarak ko der se pehle tay byaj milta hai tatha kamni ke munafe mein hissa dene ka haq nahi milta. Baat ye hai ki is dhan ka kamni par karz ban jata hai, isliye bandhkar (winding up) ke waqt pehle debenture dhaarakon ko hi bhugtan kiya jaata hai; kuchh debenture sampatti ke bojh (mortgage) ke saath bhi nikale jaate hain. Kamni se tohfa ya munafe ka hissa is patre ka sahi visthaar nahi hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp galat hain. Exam point: debenture kamni dwara jaari kiya gaya lambi avadhi ka karz patra hota hai - is par byaj milta hai par swami-tva ka haq nahi.

qe: Which committee is renowned for defining the methodology of 'Poverty Line' in India?
qh: भारत में 'गरीबी' के मापन से कौन सी समिति संबंधित है?
e: Bharat mein garibi ki rekha tay karne ka kaam Suresh Tendulkar Samiti ne kiya tha tatha baad mein C. Rangarajan Samiti ne ise sameeksha (review) kiya; isse pahle Lakdawala tatha Alagh Samitiyan bhi yahi kaam kar chuki thi. Baat ye hai ki garibi ka aankda kharch tatha khaane ki kaloriyon par nirbhar karta hai, isliye samiti jab bhi khapat ki tokri badalti hai to garib logon ki sankhya bhi badal jaati hai; yahi aankda sarkari yojanaon ka aadhaar banta hai. Malhotra Samiti ne beema kshetra ki tatha Narasimham Samiti ne banking sudhaar ki sifarishen di thi, isliye wo is prashn se juda nahi hain. Exam point: garibi ke maapan se Suresh Tendulkar Samiti judi hai - iske baad Rangarajan Samiti bani.

qe: Where is the 'Secretariat' of ASEAN located?
qh: ASEAN का 'मुख्यालय' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: ASEAN ka mukhyalay Jakarta (Indonesia) mein hai; is sangh ki sthapna 1967 mein Bangkok ke dekhlar (declaration) se hui thi tatha aaj ismein das desh shamil hain. Iska karan yahi hai ki yahi purvi Asia ke sabse bade kshetriya gathbandhan ka nyaayik tatha prabandhan kendra hai, isliye videsh mantralay tatha vyanjan (summit) ke samay dhyan isi jagah rehta hai; Bharat iska sadasya nahi hai par pura baatcheet bhaagi hai. Manila mein Asian Development Bank, Bangkok mein iski sthapna hui thi tatha Singapore vishva ka vittiya kendra hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: ASEAN ka mukhyalay Jakarta hai - iska janm 1967 mein Bangkok dekhlar se hua tha.

qe: What is a 'Bonus Issue' of shares?
qh: शेयरों का 'बोनस इश्यू' क्या है?
o: Free shares given to existing shareholders from accumulated reserves
e: Bonus ishu ka matlab hai kamni ke sanchit munafe (reserves) se maujooda shareholders ko bina koi paisa liye atirikt share dena; jaise 1:1 bonus par har ek share ke badle ek muft share. Iski zarurat isliye padti hai ki muft shares milne se share ki bazaar mein keemat ghat kar aam niveshak ki pahunch mein aa jaati hai tatha shareholders ke haath mein kamai aaye bina unki hissedari badh jaati hai; kamni ki cash tatha sampatti par koi asar nahi padta. Buy-back mein kamni apne share wapas kharidti hai tatha sasta bhau ya kamai ka vikalp is shabda se juda nahi hai, isliye wo teeno galat hain. Exam point: bonus ishu mein sanchit munafe se shareholders ko muft shares milte hain - ismein kamni se koi nakad nahi jaata.

qe: What does the 'Poverty Gap Index' measure?
qh: 'गरीबी अंतराल' सूचकांक क्या है?
o: Intensity or depth of poverty by measuring shortfall below the poverty line
e: Garibi antaral (poverty gap) soochak ye batata hai ki garib log garibi rekha se kitna neeche hain; yani yahi garibi ki gahrai (depth) tatha teevrata ka aankda hota hai tatha rekha tak pahunchane ke liye kitni kamai ki kami hai, uska ausat pratishat dikhata hai. Iski zarurat isliye padi ki keval garib logon ki ginti (head count) se ye pata nahi chalta ki wo rekha ke bilkul paas hain ya bahut neeche, isliye niti banane ke liye ye antar dekha jaata hai. Dhanik rajyons ka antar, jansankhya ka antar ya koi bhi kalpanik soochak iski paribhasha nahi hai. Exam point: garibi antaral soochak garibi ki teevrata tatha gahrai maapta hai - yahi rekha se niche ki kami ka ausat pratishat hota hai.

qe: What is the primary export target of the 'Foreign Trade Policy' (FTP) 2023?
qh: 'विदेश व्यापार नीति' (FTP) 2023 का प्राथमिक उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Reach $2 trillion exports of goods and services by 2030
e: Videsh vyapar niti (FTP) 2023 ka mukhya lakhya 2030 tak vastuon tatha sevaon ke niryat ko 2 trillion dolar tak pahunchana hai; is niti mein jilaon ko niryat ka kendra banane, e-commerce niryat tatha sasti credit jaisi baatein shamil hain. Baat ye hai ki niryat badhne se rozgar tatha videshi mudra dono milte hain, isliye sarkar pehli baar is niti ko khuli avadhi ke liye layi tatha pehle wale dastavez ki tarah date khatam hone par band nahi hogi. Niryat ghatane ya kar badhane wala vikalp is niti ke ulta hai hai, jabki 'None of these' wala vikalp bina kisi aadhaar ke rakha gaya hai, isliye use sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: FTP 2023 ka lakhya 2030 tak 2 trillion dolar ka niryat hai - isi se jila niryat kendra tatha e-commerce niryat ko badhava milta hai.

qe: What is the 'RoDTEP' scheme related to?
qh: 'RoDTEP' योजना किससे संबंधित है?
o: Remission of duties and taxes on exported products
e: RoDTEP ka matlab hai niryat kiye gaye utpadon par pade kar tatha shulkon ki wapasi (Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products); iske tehat niryat mein lagi chhupi hui lagaatein jaise indhan, bijli tatha frait par diya gaya kar wapas milta hai. Baat ye hai ki niryat ko vishva bazaar mein mukabla-yogya banane ke liye un par koi gharelu kar nahi hona chahiye, isliye yahi yojana MEIS ki jagah layi gayi tatha ise WTO ke niyamon ke hisaab se dhaala gaya. Kheti ki subsidy ya banking rit wale vikalp is yojana se bilkul alag hain, isliye wo sahi nahi hain. Exam point: RoDTEP niryat par pade anvarjit (unrefunded) kar tatha shulk wapas dene wali yojana hai - yahi videshi vyapar ko mukabla-yogya banati hai.

qe: What is a 'Letter of Credit' (LC) in international trade?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार में 'लेटर ऑफ क्रेडिट' (LC) क्या है?
o: A guarantee letter by an issuing bank assuring payment to the seller
e: Letter of credit (LC) aayatik desh ke bank ka woh likhit vachan hota hai jismein wo niryatkar ko bharosa dilata hai ki tay dastavez saunpne par usaka bhugtan ho jaayega; ismein bank hi bhugtan ki guarantee leta hai. Baat ye hai ki videshi vyapar mein dono paksh ek doosre ko nahi jaante, isliye bharose ki ye vyavastha jokhim kam karti hai tatha niryatkar bina dar ke maal bhej deta hai. Kar ka bil, seema shulk ka praman patra ya khokhli guarantee is shabda ke sahi matlab nahi hain, isliye unhe sahi nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: letter of credit mein jari karne wala bank niryatkar ko bhugtan ka bharosa deta hai - yahi antarrashtriya vyapar mein jokhim ghatata hai.

qe: What is the 'ASPIRE' scheme of the Ministry of MSME intended for?
qh: 'ASPIRE' योजना किससे संबंधित है?
o: Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry & Entrepreneurship
e: ASPIRE ka matlab hai navaachaar, gaon-udyog tatha udyamita ko badhava (Promotion of Innovation, Rural Industry and Entrepreneurship); iske tehat gaon mein aajeevika business incubators tatha agri-udyamita ke kendr khole jaate hain. Baat ye hai ki gaon ke yuvaon ko prashikshan tatha machine ke saath bazaar ki jankari milte hi wo apna kaam shuru kar paate hain, isliye yahi yojana kheti ke atirikt utpadan tatha rozgar paida karti hai. Raksha (defence) procurement ya antariksh yatra se juda kaam is yojana ka vishay nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ASPIRE yojana navaachaar tatha gaon ke udyamon ko badhava dene se judi hai - yahi gaon mein aajeevika ke kendr kholne mein madad karti hai.

qe: What is 'Mercosur' in international trade?
qh: अंतर्राष्ट्रीय व्यापार के संदर्भ में 'मर्कोसुर' (Mercosur) क्या है?
o: A South American trade bloc and customs union
e: Mercosur dakshin Amerike ka sabse bada vyapar samuh tatha seema-shulk sangathan hai jismein Brazil, Argentina, Uruguay tatha Paraguay jaisa desh shamil hain; iski sthapna 1991 mein Asuncion samjhauta se hui. Baat ye hai ki is samuh ke sadasya desh aapas mein sasta vyapar karte hain tatha bahar wale deshon ke liye ek hi seema-shulk lagate hain, isliye Bharat ne iske saath tarjihi vyapar samjhauta kiya hai taaki gud, basi kapdon tatha dawaon ko aasaan rasta mile. Seema kar, daigital mudra ya 'None of these' is avdharna se alag hain, isliye wo teeno sahi nahi hain. Exam point: Mercosur dakshin Amerike ka vyapar samuh tatha seema-shulk sangathan hai - Bharat ka iske saath tarjihi vyapar samjhauta hai.

qe: Which body regulates the 'Insurance' industry in India?
qh: भारत में 'बीमा' क्षेत्र को कौन विनियमित करता है?
e: Beema kshetra ko IRDAI niyamit karta hai, jo Beema Viniyamak tatha Vikas Pradhikaran (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India) ke naam se 1999 mein bana tatha uska mukhyalay Hyderabad mein hai. Baat ye hai ki Malhotra Samiti ki sifarishen aane ke baad niji beema kamniyon ko bhi anumati mili, isliye niyamon ka paalan tatha policy dhaarakon ke hit ki raksha ke liye ek alag viniyamak chahiye tha; yahi prem ikattha karne, claim tatha company band hone par policy dhaarakon ki suraksha dekhta hai. LIC khud beema kamni hai, RBI bankon tatha SEBI share bazaar ko dekhta hai, isliye wo nodak nahi hain. Exam point: beema kshetra ka viniyamak IRDAI hai - yahi policy dhaarakon ke hiton tatha prem ke niyamon ki raksha karta hai.

qe: What is an 'Annuity' in pension schemes?
qh: पेंशन योजनाओं के संदर्भ में 'एन्युइटी' (Annuity) क्या है?
o: A financial product that pays out regular periodic income in retirement
e: Annuity woh vitti utpad hai jismein ek badi rakam (corpus) jama karne par vyakti ko sevanivritti ke baad nishchit antaral par lagatar aay milti rehti hai; yani jeevan bhar ke liye nishchit pension jaisa prabandh. Baat ye hai ki budhape mein aay ka koi anya srot nahi hota, isliye jama rakam ko ek saath kharch karne ke bajaye beema kamni ke paas dekar usse mahimawise ya salana rakam li jaati hai; NPS mein bhi kam se kam 40 pratishat dhan se annuity kharidni padti hai. Ek muth rakam (lump sum) ya karz chukane wala bharosa is shabda ka matlab nahi hota, isliye ye galat hain. Exam point: annuity sevanivritti ke baad nishchit samay par lagatar aay dene wala vitti utpad hai - NPS mein kam se kam 40 pratishat dhan isi par lagta hai.

qe: Which statutory authority oversees the 'National Pension System' (NPS) in India?
qh: भारत में 'राष्ट्रीय पेंशन प्रणाली' (NPS) को कौन नियंत्रित करता है?
e: Rashtriya pension pranali (NPS) ko PFRDA niyamit karta hai; yahi Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority hai jo 2003 mein bana tatha 2013 mein ushe adhiniyam se kanuni shakti mili. Baat ye hai ki bharat mein achhi tarah se viniyamit tatha khuli pension pranali ki kami thi, isliye sarkari karmachariyon ko NPS mein jodne ke baad sabhi nagrikon ke liye bhi ise khola gaya; ismein nivesh ka faisla karmachari khud karta hai tatha 60 varsh ki umar par 40 pratishat dhan se annuity kharidna anivarya hota hai. EPFO sansthagit kshetra ke bhavishya nidhi ko dekhta hai tatha RBI tatha SEBI anya bazaar, isliye wo viniyamak nahi thehrte. Exam point: NPS ka viniyamak PFRDA hai - yahi pension fund tatha NPS ke nivesh par nigrani rakhta hai.

qe: What does the 'PM-KUSUM' scheme aim to achieve?
qh: PM-KUSUM योजना का 'पूर्ण रूप' क्या है?
o: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
e: PM-KUSUM ka poora roop Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan hai; is yojana mein kisaan banjar (barren) zameen par saur plant lagakar tatha saur pump se sinchai karke kamai kar sakta hai. Baat ye hai ki diesel pump mehanga tatha pradushan failane wala hota hai, isliye use badalkar saur urja par le jaane se kharch tatha paryavaran dono ka bhala hota hai; ismein feeder ke solarization par bhi dhyan diya jaata hai. Pradhan Mantri Krishi Unnati Scheme ya 'All' jaise vikalp is yojana ke sahi naam nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: PM-KUSUM ka poora roop Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan hai - yahi saur pump tatha saur plants se kisaanon ki aay badhati hai.

qe: What is 'Reinsurance' in the insurance industry?
qh: 'पुनर्बीमा' (Reinsurance) क्या है?
o: Insurance purchased by an insurer from another company to manage risk
e: Punarbima (reinsurance) woh vyavastha hai jismein beema kamni khud apna jokhim doosri beema kamni ke saath baant leti hai; yani beema kamni ka beema. Baat ye hai ki bhookamp, bijli tufan ya bade haadse mein lakhon laabhartiyon ke claim ek saath aane par ek kamni ka dhan khatam ho sakta hai, isliye duniya bhar mein GIC Re jaisi punarbima kamni is kaam ke liye bani hui hai; ismein jokhim ka kuchh hissa doosri kamni ko saune ke badle ushe prem ka hissa diya jaata hai. Grahak ka dugna beema ya prem ki wapasi is shabda se alag hai, isliye wo teeno vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: punarbima beema kamni dwara liya gaya beema hota hai - yahi ushe bade claims se hone wale nuksan se bachaata hai.

qe: Whom is the 'Atal Pension Yojana' (APY) primarily tailored for?
qh: 'अटल पेंशन योजना' (APY) मुख्य रूप से किसके लिए है?
e: Atal Pension Yojana mukhya roop se asangathit kshetra ke karmachariyon ke liye hai jo bina kisi pension ke budhape ki taraf badh rahe hain; 18 se 40 varsh ke log ismein judakar 60 varsh ki umar ke baad 1 hazaar se 5 hazaar rupaye tak ki mahine ki pension pa sakte hain. Baat ye hai ki is varg ki bachat itni nahi hoti ki wo khud bada pension fund bana sake, isliye sarkar unke yogdan ka bharosa deti hai tatha pranali ko PFRDA chalata hai. Sarkari karmachari already NPS mein hote hain tatha corporate directors ke liye alag pravadhan hote hain, isliye wo vikalp is yojana ka sahi lakshit varg nahi hain. Exam point: APY asangathit kshetra ke karmachariyon ke liye bani hai - ismein budhape par nishchit mahine ki pension milti hai.

qe: What is 'Surrender Value' in life insurance policies?
qh: जीवन बीमा पॉलिसी में 'सरेंडर वैल्यू' (Surrender Value) क्या है?
o: The sum paid by the insurer to a policyholder who terminates the policy before maturity
e: Jeevan beema policy mein surrender value woh rakam hoti hai jo kamni policy dhaarak ko us samay deti hai jab wo maturity se pehle hi policy band kar deta hai; yahi uski jama hui bachat ka nakad roop hoti hai. Baat ye hai ki pehle ke saalon mein prem ka bada hissa kharch tatha risk cover mein chala jaata hai, isliye shuruaati saalon mein surrender value kam hoti hai tatha 3 saal ke baad hi aam taur par milti hai; ULIP mein yahi fund ki value ke roop mein hoti hai. Maut par milne wali rakam ya diye gaye kul prem se ye alag hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: surrender value premature band ki gayi policy par milne wali nakad rakam hoti hai - yeh samay ke saath badhti jaati hai.

qe: What does an 'Actuary' do in the insurance profession?
qh: बीमा क्षेत्र में 'एक्चुअरी' (Actuary) कौन होता है?
o: A mathematician who evaluates risk, uncertainty, and calculates premiums
e: Actuary woh ganit visheshagya hota hai jo beema kamni ke liye death ya bimari jaise jokhim ki sambhavna, kharch ka hisaab tatha prem ka aanklan karta hai; yani wo jaanta hai ki kis aayu tatha lifestyle wale logon ke claim kitne honge. Baat ye hai ki beema kamni ko apne dayitva (liability) ka poora aankda lagana padta hai tatha bhavishya mein claim bharne layak paisa alag rakhna padta hai, isliye IRDAI ne yahi niyam banaya ki har beema kamni ke paas ek niyukt actuary ho; bima mein 'bhaagya' ki jagah aankde kaam karte hain. Sales agent ya daftar ka likhneya in gambhir ganitiy kaam se alag hote hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: actuary woh ganit visheshagya hota hai jo risk tatha prem ka aanklan karta hai - IRDAI har kamni ke liye niyukt actuary anivarya karta hai.

qe: What does the 'Claim Settlement Ratio' (CSR) represent?
qh: 'क्लेम सेटलमेंट रेशियो' (CSR) क्या है?
o: The percentage of total claims received that an insurer settles and pays out
e: Claim settlement ratio (CSR) ye batata hai ki beema kamni ko praapt hue kul claim mein se kitne claim wo chuka paayi; yani bharose ka anupat. Baat ye hai ki claim karne wale parivar ke liye yahi sabse bada bharosa hai, isliye prem lene se pehle grahak yahi anupat dekhta hai; IRDAI har saal iski suchi jaari karta hai tatha 90 pratishat se upar ka anupat achha mana jaata hai. Prem par lagne wala kar ya kamni ka munafa is shabda ka visthaar nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: claim settlement ratio kul claim ka wo pratishat hota hai jo beema kamni chuka deti hai - upar wala anupat kamni ki bharosemandi dikhata hai.

qe: Which organization is the largest public sector 'Life Insurer' in India?
qh: भारत में सबसे बड़ी 'जीवन बीमा' कंपनी कौन सी है?
e: Bharat ki sabse badi jeevan beema kamni LIC hai, jiski sthapna 1956 mein beema kshetra ke rashtriyakaran ke baad hui; us samay 200 se adhik niji kamniyan ek sanstha mein mila di gayi thi. Baat ye hai ki LIC ke paas desh bhar mein lakhon agents, karkhane tatha sarkari bharosa hai, isliye aaj niji kamniyon ki pratispardha ke baad bhi yahi sabse zyada prem ikattha karti hai; iske paas sabse bada beema fund hone ke karan yahi badi bade vikas kaamo mein nivesh karti hai. SBI Life, HDFC Life tatha ICICI Pru niji kamniyan hain jinki hissedari kam hai, isliye wo sahi chunav nahi thehrte. Exam point: bharat ki sabse badi jeevan beema kamni LIC hai - yahi 1956 mein 245 kamniyon ko milakar banayi gayi thi.

qe: What does mandatory 'Third-Party Insurance' in motor vehicles cover?
qh: मोटर वाहनों में 'थर्ड-पार्टी बीमा' क्या है?
o: Legal liability for damage, injury, or death caused to a third party
e: Kisi bhi motor vehicle ke liye third-party beema wo kanuni dayitva hai jismein dusre vyakti ke shareer, uski jaan ya uski sampatti ko pahunchne wale nuksan ka bhugtan kamni karti hai; yahi beema bechne se pehle anivarya hai. Baat ye hai ki saadki hadse mein prabhavit parivar ko kal ka intezaam chahiye hota hai, isliye Motor Vehicles Adhiniyam ne ise anivarya banaya tatha iske bina gaadi sadak par nahi utar sakti; galti aapki ho ya nahi, teesre paksh ka nuksan bharna padta hai. Apni hi gaadi ki chot ya chori bharne wala vikalp uske badle mein aata hai, isliye inhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: third-party beema teesre paksh ko pahunche nuksan ki kanuni bharpai karta hai - ise har motor vehicle ke liye anivarya kiya gaya hai.

qe: What is the annual health coverage under 'Ayushman Bharat' (PM-JAY) per family?
qh: 'आयुष्मान भारत' (PM-JAY) के तहत प्रति परिवार कितना बीमा कवर मिलता है?
e: Aayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) ke tehat pratyek patra parivar ko saalana paanch lakh rupaye tak ka beema cover milta hai; ismein doosre tatha teesre star ke aspatal ke Ilaj ka kharch cashless roop mein chukaya jaata hai. Baat ye hai ki sadharan parivar ko bade aspatal ka kharch bharkar garibi ki taraf dhakel deta tha, isliye yahi yojana 2018 mein shuru hui tatha ismein parivar ki umar tatha size ki koi seema nahi rakhi gayi; 70 varsh se adhik umar ke logon ke liye ab yahi yojana kholi gayi hai. Ek lakh ya das lakh wale vikalp is yojana ki tay rakam nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) mein har parivar ko saalana 5 lakh ka cover milta hai - ismein aspatal ka cashless ilaj hota hai.

qe: What is a 'Unit Linked Insurance Plan' (ULIP)?
qh: 'यूनिट लिंक्ड इंश्योरेंस प्लान' (ULIP) क्या है?
o: An integrated product offering both insurance coverage and market-linked investment
e: ULIP ka matlab hai unit linked insurance plan, yani ek hi utpad mein jeevan beema tatha bazaar se jude nivesh dono shamil hote hain; prem ka ek hissa risk cover leta hai tatha baaki hissa equity ya debt fund mein nivesh ho jaata hai. Baat ye hai ki aam grahak ko bina alag-alag utpad kharide hi dono suvidhaen mil jaati hain tatha uska paisa bazaar ke upar-niche ke hisaab se badhta-ghat ta hai; bazaar achha rehne par uski fund value badh jaati hai tatha 5 saal ka lock-in lagta hai. Keval jeevan beema ya kar ka jurmana is shabda ka visthaar nahi hai, isliye inhe galat hi maana jaayega. Exam point: ULIP mein jeevan beema tatha bazaar ke aadhaar par nivesh dono shamil hote hain - ismein fund value bazaar ke rukh par badalti hai.

qe: What is 'Frictional Unemployment'?
qh: 'घर्षण बेरोजगारी' (Frictional Unemployment) क्या है?
o: Temporary unemployment while transitioning between jobs
e: Gharshan berozgari (frictional unemployment) woh asaadharn roop se thodi avadhi ki berozgari hoti hai jo nayi naukri ki talash ke dauran paida hoti hai; jaise college se nikla yuva ya naukri badalne wala vyakti kuchh samay ke liye bina kaam rehta hai. Iski zarurat isliye samajhni chahiye ki yahi har jeevit arthavyavastha mein payi jaati hai, isliye yahi jaan-boojhkar paida ki jaati hai taaki shramik behtar jagah pahunch sake; yahi 'gharshan' ya dhoondo ke naam se jaani jaati hai. Aatomation se paida hone wali berozgari bare-rang (structural) hoti hai tatha sthayi berozgari ka vikalp bhi is se alag hai, isliye wo dono galat hain. Exam point: gharshan berozgari naukri badalne ke beech ki thodi avadhi ki berozgari hoti hai - yahi jeevit arthavyavastha mein swabhavik maani jaati hai.

qe: Who is heralded as the 'Father of the Green Revolution' in India?
qh: भारत में 'हरित क्रांति' के जनक कौन हैं?
e: Bharat mein hari kranti ke janak M.S. Swaminathan hain, jinhe 'kheti ka krantikari' kaha jaata hai; unhone adhik paidavar dene wali boni (semi dwarf) tatha kharif ki variety ke beejon ko desh bhar mein pahunchaya. Baat ye hai ki borlaug ne vishva star par achhi fasal ki variety banayi thi, par ushe bharat ki mitti tatha mausam ke hisaab se dhaala tatha kisaanon tak pahunchaya Swaminathan ne hi kiya, isliye 60 aur 70 ke dashak mein desh anaaj ki kami se bahar nikal aaya. Varghese Kurien shweta kranti (doodh) ke janak maane jaate hain tatha Norman Borlaug vishva star ki hasti hain, isliye wo is prashn ke sahi uttar nahi hain. Exam point: bharat mein hari kranti ke janak M.S. Swaminathan hai - yahi adhik paidavar wali gehun ki variety laye the.

qe: What is 'External Commercial Borrowing' (ECB)?
qh: 'बाहरी वाणिज्यिक उधारी' (ECB) क्या है?
o: Loans raised by eligible resident Indian entities from non-resident commercial lenders
e: Bahari vanijyik udhari (ECB) ka matlab hai bharat ke rahne wale patra vyakti ya kamniyon dwara videshi vanijyik srot se karz lena; ismein videshi bank ka karz, aapoortikar ka credit tatha videshi bank ka karz shamil hote hain. Baat ye hai ki gharelu bank se lena sasta par seemit hota hai, isliye ya to videsh mein saste byaj par dhan jutaya jaata hai tatha badi pariyojna tay karne ke liye yahi rasta chuna jaata hai; par videshi mudra mein karz lene se bhugtan santulan par dabav aata hai. Gharelu bank ka karz ya IMF se milne wali sahayata is shabda ke sahi visthaar nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ECB videshi vanijyik srot se liya gaya karz hota hai - ise FEMA tatha RBI ke niyamon ke tehat uthaya jaata hai.

qe: What is the 'Debt-to-GDP Ratio' of a nation?
qh: 'ऋण-से-जीडीपी अनुपात' क्या है?
o: Total accumulated sovereign debt divided by national nominal GDP
e: Karz se jee.di.pi anupat (debt to GDP ratio) wo anupat hai jismein sarkar ka kul sanchit karz upar rakha jaata hai tatha neeche us desh ka naam-matra (nominal) jee.di.pi; ise pratishat mein dikhaya jaata hai. Baat ye hai ki anupat se ye pata chalta hai ki desh ki aay ke mukable karz kitna bhari hai tatha ushe chukane ki kshamata kitni hai, isliye rating kamniyan tatha niveshkar isi aankde ko dekhte hain; anupat badhne par byaj ka bhugtan bhi bhaari ho jaata hai. Kar ya jee.di.pi ka anupat tatha aayat-niryat ka anupat is shabda se alag hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: karz se jee.di.pi anupat desh ke kul karz tatha naam-matra jee.di.pi ka anupat hota hai - yahi karz ke bojh ko dikhata hai.

qe: What characterizes a 'Counter-Cyclical' Fiscal Policy?
qh: 'काउंटर-साइक्लिक' राजकोषीय नीति क्या है?
o: Increasing spending and cutting taxes during recessions, and cooling spending during booms
e: Pratichakriya (counter-cyclical) rajakiya niti ka matlab hai mandi ke samay sarkari kharch badhana tatha kar ghatana, aur tezi ke samay kharch kam karna tatha kar badhana; yani bazaar ke rukh ke ulta chalna. Baat ye hai ki mandi mein demand ghat jaati hai, isliye sarkar kharch badhakar rozgar tatha aay ko sahara deti hai; yahi Keynes ki soch hai tatha pandemik ke samay bharat ne isi ke aadhaar par kharch badhaya tha. Mandi mein kar ghatana tatha tezi mein kharch badhana isse ulta hai tatha bajar santulan wala vikalp arthat sthirta chahne wala hai, isliye wo dono galat hain. Exam point: pratichakriya rajakiya niti mandi mein kharch badhati tatha tezi mein ghatati hai - yahi sankat ke samay aay ko sahara deti hai.

qe: What is the primary function of the 'Base Erosion and Profit Shifting' (BEPS) framework?
qh: 'बेस इरोजन एंड प्रॉफिट शिफ्टिंग' (BEPS) क्या है?
o: Multilateral tax framework to stop multinationals from shifting profits to tax havens
e: BEPS (base erosion and profit shifting) OECD tatha G20 ka woh bahupakshi kar dhaancha hai jiska lakshya yah rokna hai ki bahurastriya kamniyan apne munafe ko kam kar wale deshon ya tax haven mein badal kar kar bachayein. Baat ye hai ki kamniyan rojgar kahi paida karti hain tatha munafa doosre desh mein kamaati hain, isliye khokhli kar vyavastha se bharat jaise desh ke haath malik tha; isi ke tehat digitay kar par do stambh (pillar) wala samadhan taya gaya tatha bharat ne samta kar (equalisation levy) lagaya. Mitti ka katav ya seema shulk ghatana is dhaanche ka hissa nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: BEPS bahurastriya kamniyon ke munafe ko veeran (tax haven) mein jane se rokne wala kar dhaancha hai - yahi OECD tatha G20 ki pahal hai.

qe: What is a 'Sunset Clause' in legislation?
qh: सरकारी योजना या टैक्स कानून में 'सनसेट क्लॉज' (Sunset Clause) क्या है?
o: A statutory provision causing an act or provision to automatically expire after a specified date
e: Sunset clause wo kanuni pravadhan hota hai jiske tehat koi kanun, chhoot ya yojana ek tay tareekh ke baad apne aap samaapt ho jaati hai; aage badhane ke liye sansad ya sarkar ko use dobara manzoori deni padti hai. Baat ye hai ki isse purani tatha bekaar chhooten hamesha ke liye na chalti rahein tatha samay-samay par unki sameeksha hoti hai; udaharan ke taur par kai kar chhooton tatha yojanaon mein yahi shart lagi hoti hai. Raat mein kaam karne wala kanun ya luxury hotel par lagne wala upkar is shabda ka sahi arth nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: sunset clause se koi vyavastha tay tareekh par apne aap khatam ho jaati hai - yahi samay-samay par uski sameeksha karati hai.

qe: What does a 'Twin Deficit' mean in macroeconomic analysis?
qh: किसी अर्थव्यवस्था में 'ट्विन डेफिसिट' (Twin Deficit) क्या है?
o: Simultaneous existence of a high Fiscal Deficit and a high Current Account Deficit
e: Twin deficit ka matlab hai ek hi samay mein do ghate ek saath hone - ek taraf sarkar ka rajakiya ghata (fiscal deficit) bahut ho tatha doosri taraf desh ka chalu khata ghata (current account deficit) bhi uncha ho. Baat ye hai ki sarkar adhik kharch karke aay se zyada karz leti hai tatha aise karz se aayat badh jaati hai, isliye bahari karz tatha ghata dono ek saath badhte hain; bharat 1990-91 ke sankat ke waqt yahi sthiti mein tha. Jansankhya ka uncha hona ya do saal ki mandi is shabda ki sahi vyakhya nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: twin deficit rajakiya ghata tatha chalu khata ghata ke saath-saath unche hone ki sthiti hai - yahi desh ko bahari karz par nirbhar banati hai.

qe: What is a 'Sovereign Gold Bond' (SGB) issued by the RBI?
qh: RBI द्वारा जारी 'सॉवरेन गोल्ड बॉन्ड' (SGB) क्या है?
o: Government securities denominated in grams of gold as substitutes for physical gold
e: Sovereign gold bond (SGB) RBI dwara jaari woh sarkari prathibhutiyan hoti hain jo sone ke gramon mein likhi jaati hain; inhe kharid kar log bina saal bhar ghar mein sona rakhe sone mein nivesh kar sakte hain. Baat ye hai ki ismein sone ka bazaar bhau tatha usme 2.5 pratishat salana byaj bhi milta hai, isliye bhautik sone ki tijaori tatha chori ka jokhim bacha jaata hai; mudra avadhi poore hone par bhugtan ke waqt sona aapke naam par hota hai. Bhautik gehna ya khanan ki kamni ke share is shabda ka matlab nahi hota, isliye aise vikalp galat ho jaate hain. Exam point: SGB sarkar ki wo prathibhuti hai jo sone ke gramon mein hoti hai - ismein 2.5 pratishat salana byaj tatha sone ke bhau ka laabh dono milte hain.

qe: What is the 'Automatic Exchange of Information' (AEOI) framework?
qh: 'सूचनाओं का स्वचालित विनिमय' (AEOI) क्या है?
o: Global intergovernmental standard for exchanging foreign resident financial account details to curb tax evasion
e: Soochnaon ka svachalit vinimay (AEOI) ek vaishvik antarsarkari manak hai jismein desh apne rahne walon ke videshi khate ki jankari apne aap doosre desh ki kar sanstha ko bhej deta hai; ismein videshi kshetra tatha rappata (reporting) ke niyam tay hain. Baat ye hai ki pehle khokhli khate khol kar kar bachana aasaan tha, isliye ab ban kon ya sanstha ki jankari bina maange hi pahunch jaati hai tatha bharat bhi 100 se adhik deshon se yahi jankari paata hai. Internet se jankari baantna ya bank clearing ki raftar is avdharna se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: AEOI videshi khate ki jankari apne aap badalne wali vaishvik pranali hai - yahi videsh mein jama kaale dhan ko pakadne mein madad karti hai.

qe: What does the 'Incremental Capital-Output Ratio' (ICOR) indicate?
qh: 'वृद्धिशील पूंजी-उत्पाद अनुपात' (ICOR) क्या है?
o: The amount of additional capital investment needed to generate one unit of additional output
e: Input capital output ratio (ICOR) ye batata hai ki utpadan ki ek atirikt ikai paida karne ke liye kitni nayi punji (nivesh) lagti hai; ise kul nivesh tatha utpadan mein hui vriddhi ke anupat se nikaala jaata hai. Baat ye hai ki kam ICOR ka matlab hai kam nivesh se zyada utpadan, yani punji ki utpaadkta achhi hai, isliye yahi soochak sarkar tatha niveshkaron ko batata hai ki punji kitni kushalta (efficiency) se lag rahi hai. Munafa-hani ka anupat ya kul nivesh ka anupat is shabda ka arth nahi hota, isliye unhe sahi chunav nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: ICOR batata hai ki ek ikai atirikt utpadan ke liye kitni nayi punji chahiye - kam ICOR achhi utpaadkta dikhata hai.

qe: What are 'Industrial Corridors' like the DMIC planned for?
qh: दिल्ली-मुंबई औद्योगिक कॉरिडोर (DMIC) जैसे 'औद्योगिक गलियारों' का उद्देश्य क्या है?
o: Developing high-speed multi-modal logistics and manufacturing hubs along transport spines
e: Audyogik galyaron (industrial corridors) ka uddeshya hai ki railway tatha sadak jaise bahu-mode raston ke kinare vishv-star ke vinnirman tatha logistics hub khade kiye jaayein; DMIC iska sabse bada udaharan hai. Baat ye hai ki dedicated freight corridor tatha sadak ka jaal sasta tatha tez hai, isliye uske sahare khadi hui factory tatha bandargah desh ke niryat ko badhate hain tatha naye shahar bhi baste hain. Aawasiya park banaana ya vyapar rokna is avdharna ke bilkul ulta hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: audyogik galyaron ka uddeshya bahu-mode logistics tatha vinnirman ke kendr khada karna hai - DMIC iska pramukh udaharan hai.

qe: What legal protection does a 'Geographical Indication' (GI) tag provide?
qh: 'भौगोलिक संकेत' (GI) टैग किसी उत्पाद को क्या लाभ प्रदान करता है?
o: Intellectual property protection certifying that a product originates from a specific geography with unique quality
e: Bhaugolik sanket (GI) tag ek baidhik sampatti ka sandarbh hai jo batata hai ki koi utpad kisi khaas bhugol se hi aata hai tatha uski gunvatta us kshetra ki visheshta se judi hai; jaise Darjeeling chai ya Banarasi saree. Baat ye hai ki ise bina manzoori koi doosra utpadak copy nahi kar sakta, isliye us kshetra ke puraane tatha chhote utpadakon ki kamai tatha pehchaan bachi rehti hai; yahi kisaanon tatha karigaron ke liye adhik aay ka rasta hai. Kisi bhi kamni ko copy karne ki chhoot ya jhooti mehangi keemat is tag ka uddeshya nahi hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: GI tag baidhik sampatti ka sandarbh hai jo kisi utpad ko us kshetra se jodta hai - yahi uski vishesh gunvatta ki raksha karta hai.

qe: What does the term 'Negative Grant' mean in highway infrastructure concession agreements?
qh: बुनियादी ढांचा अनुबंधों में 'नेगेटिव ग्रांट' (Negative Grant) शब्द का क्या अर्थ है?
o: An upfront premium payment offered by a private bidder to the government for rights to execute a viable project
e: Buniyaadi dhanche ke anubandhon mein negative grant ka matlab hai ki niji boli wala project ke adhikar paane ke liye sarkar ko aage se ek rakam (upfront premium) deta hai; ye tab hota hai jab project itna laabhkari lage ki boli lene wale hi milen. Baat ye hai ki jab toll se hone wali aay bahut adhik lage, to kamniyan project ke adhikar ke liye sarkar ko paisa dene ko tayyar ho jaati hain, isliye yeh bahut achhi sthiti ka chinh maana jaata hai. Rajya dwara diya jurmana ya project ka ghata is shabda se alag hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: negative grant project paane ke liye niji boli wale dwara sarkar ko di jaane wali aage ki rakam hoti hai - yahi project ke laabhkari hone ka chinh hai.

qe: Under the 'Build, Operate, Transfer' (BOT) PPP model, when does the asset transfer back to the government?
qh: किस PPP मॉडल में एक निजी खिलाड़ी सरकार को वापस सौंपने से पहले एक विशिष्ट अवधि के लिए परियोजना का निर्माण और संचालन करता है?
e: BOT (build operate transfer) model mein niji khiladi pariyojna ka nirmaan karta hai tatha kuchh varsh khud chala kar uski aay uthaata hai, phir niyamit avadhi ke baad use sarkar ko saunp deta hai. Baat ye hai ki is vyavastha mein sarkar ko shuruaat mein bada kharch nahi karna padta tatha niji khiladi ke paas kaam tez tatha gunvatta se poora karne ka dabaav rehta hai; highway tatha bandargah aksar isi model se bante hain. HAM mein sarkar kuchh rakam aage deti hai tatha EPC mein kaam ke lie poora bhugtan hota hai, jabki Swiss challenge ek boli ki vidhi hai, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: BOT model mein niji khiladi banaata, chalaata tatha niyamit avadhi ke baad sarkar ko saunp deta hai - highway tatha bandargah isi se bante hain.

qe: What is the 'Swiss Challenge' method in public procurement?
qh: 'स्विस चैलेंज' मॉडल निम्नलिखित में से किससे संबंधित है?
o: A bidding process where an original unsolicited project proposal is opened to counter-bidding by other parties
e: Swiss challenge ek aisi boli pranali hai jismein pehle kisi vyakti ya kamni ka apne-aap ka prastav aata hai; sarkar us prastav ko khula kar doosre boli walaon ko aamantrit karti hai ki wo usi kaam ko usse behtar shart par karne ka prastav dein. Baat ye hai ki isse jhoothe ek-adhikar se bacha jaata hai tatha khazane ko behtar mol-bhaav milta hai, isliye jise achha prastav liya jaata hai, use poori prakriya se guzarna padta hai; mool prastavak ko badlaav ka mauka bhi diya jaata hai. Ski mukaabla ya swiss bank ka raaz is shabda se juda vishay hi nahi hai, isliye ye teeno galat hain. Exam point: swiss challenge mein mool prastav ko khula boli ke liye rakh diya jaata hai - isse behtar shart par kaam milne se sarkar ko laabh hota hai.

qe: Under the 'Hybrid Annuity Model' (HAM) for highway construction, what share of project cost is committed by NHAI during construction?
qh: राजमार्गों के लिए 'हाइब्रिड एन्युइटी मॉडल' (HAM) के तहत, निर्माण चरण के दौरान सरकार द्वारा परियोजना लागत का कितना प्रतिशत प्रदान किया जाता है?
e: Highway ke liye hybrid annuity model (HAM) mein sarkar nirmaan ke dauran pariyojana ki laagat ka 40 pratishat hissa bhugtan karti hai tatha shesh 60 pratishat niji khiladi lagata hai; baad mein sarkar use nishchit varshon tak annuity deti rehti hai. Baat ye hai ki poori rakam boli wale par chhodne se ya poori rakam sarkar dene se dono taraf jokhim badh jaata tha, isliye 40-60 ka batwara jokhim tatha kharch ko santulit karta hai; ismein toll ikattha karne ka kaam NHAI karta hai. 100, 10 ya 20 pratishat wale vikalp is model ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: HAM mein nirmaan ke dauran pariyojana lagat ka 40 pratishat sarkar deti hai - shesh 60 pratishat niji khiladi lagata hai.

qe: Which wireless communication technology powers automated toll deductions through 'FASTag'?
qh: बैंक खाते से सीधे टोल भुगतान सक्षम करने के लिए 'FASTag' द्वारा किस तकनीक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
e: FASTag mein radio frequency identification (RFID) taknik ka upyog hota hai; gaadi ke shish (windscreen) par laga tag padhne wale yantra se radio tarangein le-kar toll kamre ke system se jud jaata hai. Baat ye hai ki ismein gaadi ko rokna nahi padta, isliye toll plaza ki lambi kataar tatha samay ki barbadi dono khatam ho jaati hain; tag mein pehle se jama rakam se kataut hoti hai tatha baar-baar nakad dene ki zarurat nahi padti. Keval GPS, bluetooth ya infrared wale vikalp is vyavastha ke sahi taknik nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: FASTag mein RFID taknik lagti hai - isse bina rok toll kateja jaata hai tatha plaza par kataar ghat ti hai.

qe: What does 'AT&C Loss' signify in power sector distribution?
qh: भारत में बिजली क्षेत्र के संदर्भ में 'AT&C लॉस' का क्या अर्थ है?
e: Bharat mein bijli kshetra ke sandarbh mein AT&C loss ka matlab hai aggregate technical and commercial loss, yani takniki tatha vanijyik nuksan ka jod; ismein sancharan (transmission) ke dauran bijli ki churi tatha meter tatha bill bhugtan ki kami shamil hoti hai. Baat ye hai ki ye nuksan 15 pratishat se kam hota hai to vitran kamniyan majboot hoti hain, isliye sabhi rajyon ko yahi aankda ghatane ka lakhya diya jaata hai; bijli chori tatha kam meter reading iske bade karan hain. Actual Total and Cost Loss ya Annual Transmission Cost Loss jaise kalpanik naam is aankde ke sahi visthaar nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: AT&C loss takniki tatha vanijyik dono nuksan ka jod hota hai - ismein chori tatha bill na bhugtan bhi shamil hote hain.

qe: National Waterway 1 (NW-1) traverses which stretch on the Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly river system?
qh: राष्ट्रीय जलमार्ग 1 (NW-1) निम्नलिखित में से किन शहरों को जोड़ता है?
e: Rashtriya jal marg 1 (NW-1) Prayagraj (Allahabad) se Haldia tak faila hua hai tatha yahi Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly jal marg kahlata hai; iski lambai lagbhag 1620 kilometre hai. Baat ye hai ki Ganga ka yahi hissa sabse adhik aabadi tatha udyogon wala kshetra hai, isliye sasta tatha paryavaran-hitaishi jal parivahan shuru karne ke liye ise pehla jal marg banaya gaya; iske tehat Varanasi, Patna tatha Kolkata ke bandargah judte hain. Sadiya-Dhubri (NW-2), Kollam-Kottapuram (NW-3) tatha Kakinada-Puducherry (NW-4) anya jal marg hain, isliye ye sahi uttar nahi thehrte. Exam point: NW-1 Prayagraj se Haldia tak hai - yahi Ganga jal marg kehlata hai tatha sabse lamba hai.

qe: On which river is National Waterway 2 (NW-2) situated?
qh: राष्ट्रीय जलमार्ग 2 (NW-2) किस नदी प्रणाली पर विकसित किया गया है?
e: Rashtriya jal marg 2 (NW-2) Brahmaputra nadi pranali par viksit kiya gaya hai tatha yahi Sadiya se Dhubri tak lagbhag 891 kilometre lamba hai; ye poora hissa Assam rajy mein aata hai. Baat ye hai ki Brahmaputra ka bahav tatha gehrai bade jahaazon tatha samp (ship) ke liye upyukt hai, isliye North East ki kheti tatha unke utpadon ko bandargah tak pahunchane ka sasta rasta yahi banta hai; isse kshetra mein vyapar tatha rozgar badhte hain. Ganga, Godavari tatha Krishna par anya jal marg hain, isliye wo vikalp sahi nahi hain. Exam point: NW-2 Brahmaputra nadi par Sadiya se Dhubri tak faila hai - yahi North East ka pramukh jal marg hai.

qe: Who coined the phrase 'Hindu Rate of Growth' describing India's historic 3.5% growth between the 1950s and 1980s?
qh: 'हिंदू विकास दर', जो अतीत में भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था के निम्न विकास चक्र के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला शब्द था, लगभग कितनी थी?
e: Hindu vikas dar ka istemal bharat ki arthavyavastha ke sust tatha sthir vikas chakra ke liye kiya jaata tha, jo lagbhag 3.5 pratishat (3 se 4 pratishat) ke aas-paas rehta tha; is shabda ka istemal arthashastri Raj Krishna ne kiya tha. Baat ye hai ki 1991 ke udarikaran se pehle dar itna hi rah jaata tha tatha aabadi badhne se aam aadmi ki aay mein khaas badlav nahi hota tha; aarthik sudhar ke baad dar badh kar 7-8 pratishat tak pahunche. 10-12 pratishat ya 1-2 pratishat wale vikalp is shabda ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: Hindu vikas dar lagbhag 3.5 pratishat thi - yahi 1991 se pehle ke sust vikas ko darshata hai.

qe: Under the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA), which enforcement agency investigates serious foreign exchange contraventions?
qh: आधुनिक ढांचे के तहत विदेशी मुद्रा कानूनों के आपराधिक उल्लंघन की जांच कौन सा निकाय करता है?
e: Videshi mudra kanunon ke gambhir ullanghan tatha dhanshodhan (money laundering) ki jaanch Enforcement Directorate (ED) karta hai, jo arth mantralay ke adheen kaam karti hai; iske paas FEMA tatha PMLA ke tehat sampatti jupt karne ki shakti bhi hai. Baat ye hai ki bharat mein aise kes manaf khaas roop se bahar bhejne tatha kaale dhan ko safed karne ke aarop aate hain, isliye is tarah ke apradhiyon ki jaanch tatha unki sampatti par rokt lagane ke liye yahi sanstha bani. SEBI share bazaar tatha RBI bankon ko dekhta hai tatha Planning Commission hi samaapt ho chuka hai, isliye wo sahi uttar nahi thehrte. Exam point: videshi mudra kanunon ke ullanghan ki jaanch ED karti hai - yahi pravaah tatha dhanshodhan ke kes bhi dekhti hai.

qe: Under the National Food Security Act (NFSA), 2013, what is the monthly subsidized grain entitlement per person under priority households?
qh: राष्ट्रीय खाद्य सुरक्षा अधिनियम के तहत, प्रति व्यक्ति प्रति माह खाद्यान्न की पात्रता कितनी है?
e: Rashtriya khady suraksha adhiniyam 2013 ke tehat pratyek praathmikta (priority) parivar ke vyakti ko prati mahine 5 kilogram anaaj milta hai tatha antyodaya (antyodaya) parivar ko prati mahine 35 kilogram anaaj milta hai; gehun tatha chawal ke daam bhi bahut kam liye jaate hain. Baat ye hai ki jis parivar ke paas poora mahine ka kharch bhugtan layak aay nahi hoti, ushe khady suraksha ka adhikaar dene ke liye yahi adhiniyam bana, isliye iska daayra shehri tatha grameen dono kshetron tak failaya gaya. 2 ya 10 kilogram wale vikalp is adhiniyam ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: khady suraksha adhiniyam ke tehat pratyek vyakti ko prati mahine 5 kilogram anaaj milta hai - antyodaya parivar ko 35 kilogram milta hai.

qe: The 'Pink Revolution' in Indian agribusiness is linked to which sector?
qh: 'पिंक रिवॉल्यूशन' (Pink Revolution) मुख्य रूप से किस क्षेत्र के आधुनिकीकरण पर केंद्रित है?
o: Meat and Poultry processing / Onion / Pharmaceuticals
e: Pink revolution mukhya roop se maans tatha poultry (poultry) ke prasanskaran tatha pyaaz jaise kshetron ke adhunikikaran par kendra hai; iska naam isliye pada kyunki yahi kaam maans tatha pyaaz jaise laal rang se juda hai. Baat ye hai ki khady prasanskaran udyog gaon ke pashupalakon ko behtar daam dilaata hai tatha pashuon ke apashisht (waste) ka sahi upyog hota hai, isliye sarkar ne ise badhava diya; isse pashupalan aay tatha rozgar ka bada srot banta hai. Phool tatha tel ya cotton wale vikalp anya krantiyon se jude hain, isliye wo galat chunav hain. Exam point: pink revolution maans tatha poultry prasanskaran se judi hai - yahi pyaaz tatha jhinga kshetra ke adhunikikaran ko bhi dikhata hai.

qe: What was the 'Yellow Revolution' in Indian agriculture launched to boost?
qh: भारत में 'पीली क्रांति' (Yellow Revolution) का मुख्य उद्देश्य क्या था?
e: Peeli kranti (yellow revolution) ka mukhya lakshya khane wale tilahan (khane wale tel) jaise sarson, surajmukhi tatha soybean ke utpadan mein atmanirbhar banna tha; iske liye Oilseeds Technology Mission chalaya gaya. Baat ye hai ki ek samay bharat apni zarurat ka tel bade paimane par bahar se laata tha, isliye unnat beej tatha technique se paidavar badhakar import kam karne ka lakshya rakha gaya; isse kheti tatha vanaspati udyog dono ko bal mila. Dal, honey ya solar cell wale vikalp is kranti ke sahi vishay nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: peeli kranti khane wale tilahan ke utpadan ke liye chalaayi gayi - isse bharat khane wale tel mein atmanirbhar hua.

qe: The 'Silver Fiber Revolution' is associated with which crop in India?
qh: 'सिल्वर फाइबर क्रांति' किस फसल के उत्पादन से संबंधित है?
e: Silver fibre revolution ka sambandh kapas (cotton) ke utpadan se hai; ise silver isliye kaha jaata hai kyunki khula kapas tatha uski raai chandni jaisi safed dikhti hai. Baat ye hai ki bharat duniya ka sabse bada kapas utpadak tatha niryatak desh hai, isliye kapas ki achhi variety tatha paidavar seedha kisaanon ki aay se juda hai; resham tatha jute ke liye alag rang ke naam diye jaate hain, jaise resham ke liye golden tatha jute ke liye golden fibre. Resham, jute ya chandi ki khanan is avdharna se bilkul juda nahi hai, isliye inhe sahi nahi kaha ja sakta. Exam point: silver fibre kranti kapas ke utpadan se judi hai - ise safed rang ke karan yahi naam mila hai.

qe: What was the operational timeline of the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) before the SDGs?
qh: वर्ष 2000 से 2015 तक लागू विकास लक्ष्यों को क्या कहा जाता था?
e: 2000 se 2015 tak chalne wale vikas lakshyon ko millennium development goals (MDG) kaha jaata tha; ismein garibi tatha (bhookh) kam karna, shiksha, swasthya tatha mahila sashaktikaran jaise 8 lakshya shamil the. Baat ye hai ki vishva star par ek saajhi suchi banane se sabhi deshon ka vikas ek hi paimane par naapa jaane laga, isliye yahi kaam aage badhakar 2015 mein 17 satat vikas lakshya (SDG) banae gaye. Agenda 21 parivesh se juda dastavez hai tatha Global Growth Goals kalpanik naam hai, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: 2000 se 2015 tak ke vikas lakshya MDG kehlaate the - yahi 8 lakshyon wali vaishvik suchi thi.

qe: How many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) form the UN Agenda 2030?
qh: 2015 में वैश्विक स्तर पर कितने सतत विकास लक्ष्य (SDG) और लक्ष्य (targets) अपनाए गए थे?
e: 2015 mein vaishvik star par 17 satat vikas lakshya (SDG) tatha unse jude 169 lakshya (targets) apnae gaye the; inhe 2030 tak poora karne ka lakshya rakha gaya tatha yahi 2030 agenda kehlata hai. Baat ye hai ki SDG mein garibi, bhookh, shiksha, pani tatha jalvayu jaise sabhi vishay shamil hain tatha har desh apni sthiti ke hisaab se ise lagu karta hai, isliye 17 goals tatha 169 targets ka anupat yaad rakhna chahiye. 10 goals, 8 goals ya 21 goals wale vikalp is agenda ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: 2015 mein 17 SDG tatha 169 targets apnae gaye - yahi 2030 agenda ka aadhaar hai.

qe: The 'International Solar Alliance' (ISA) was jointly initiated by India and which country at COP21 in Paris?
qh: 'अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सौर गठबंधन' (ISA) को 2015 में भारत और किस अन्य देश द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से लॉन्च किया गया था?
e: Antarrashtriya saur gathbandhan (ISA) ki shuruaat 2015 mein bharat tatha France ne milkar ki thi; iski ghoshna Paris jalvayu sammelan ke samay hui thi tatha iska sachivalay Gurugram mein hai. Baat ye hai ki dhoop wale deshon ko saur urja ke upyog ke liye saajhi taknik tatha dhan chahiye tha, isliye yahi gathbandhan un deshon ka manch bana; iska lakshya aise deshon mein 1 terawatt saur urja lagana hai. America, Japan ya Germany wale vikalp is gathbandhan ke sahyogi desh nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: ISA bharat tatha France ne 2015 mein milkar shuru kiya - iska sachivalay Gurugram mein hai.

qe: Which Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) targets 'Zero Hunger'?
qh: कौन सा SDG विशेष रूप से 'शून्य भूख' (Zero Hunger) पर केंद्रित है?
e: Satat vikas lakshya 2 (SDG 2) vishesh roop se shunya bhookh (zero hunger) par kendra hai; iska lakshya bhookh khatam karna, khady suraksha pahunchana tatha poshan sudharna hai. Baat ye hai ki bhookh tatha kuposhan se bachon ka vikas ruk jaata hai tatha desh ki aay par bhi bojh padta hai, isliye yahi lakshya kheti tatha khady pranali se juda hua sabse ahem sona hai. SDG 1 garibi, SDG 3 swasthya tatha SDG 6 saaf pani se juda hai, isliye inhe sahi uttar nahi maana ja sakta. Exam point: SDG 2 shunya bhookh par kendra hai - iska lakshya bhookh khatam karke khady suraksha dena hai.

qe: Which Nobel laureate pioneered modern microcredit and the Grameen Bank model?
qh: 'माइक्रोफाइनेंस' और स्वयं सहायता समूह (SHG) की अवधारणा का प्रतिपादन किस नोबेल पुरस्कार विजेता द्वारा किया गया था?
e: Microfinance tatha swayn sahayata samuh (SHG) ki avdharna ko Muhammad Yunus ne aage badhaya tatha unhe 2006 ka Nobel Shanti Puraskar mila; unhone Bangladesh mein Grameen Bank ki shuruaat karke bina girvi (collateral) garib mahilaon ko chhote karz diye. Baat ye hai ki garib logon ke paas girvi rakhne layak sampatti nahi hoti, isliye samuh ki jimmedari tatha pichhli bhugtan ke aadhaar par karz dene se bank ka jokhim bhi kam hota hai tatha mahilaen khud kaam shuru kar paati hain; bharat mein bhi SHG bank linkage ke zariye yahi tarika chalta hai. Abhijit Banerjee tatha Amartya Sen ka kaam arthashastra ke anya kshetron mein hai, isliye wo sahi chunav nahi hain. Exam point: microfinance tatha SHG ki avdharna Muhammad Yunus ne di - yahi garib mahilaon ko bina girvi chhote karz dene ka tarika hai.

qe: Which land reform initiative in post-independence India was led by Acharya Vinoba Bhave?
qh: विनोबा भावे के नेतृत्व में किस आंदोलन ने स्वैच्छिक भूमि दान को प्रोत्साहित किया?
e: Vinoba Bhave ke netritva mein bhoodan tatha gramdan andolan chala, jismein bade zamindaron ne apni zameen swachchha se bhumiheen kisaanon ko daan ki; iski shuruaat 1951 mein Pochampally (Telangana) se hui thi. Baat ye hai ki samvidhan tatha kanun se zameen baantne ki koshishon ke saath-saath samajik chetna tatha prem se bhi zameen baanti gayi, isliye yahi andolan bharat ke bhu-sudhar ki soch ka hissa bana; ismein lakhon ekar zameen daan mein mili. Chipko andolan jungle bachane ke liye tatha Operation Barga tatha Tebhaga kisaanon ke hisse ke liye chale the, isliye wo vikalp is andolan se alag hain. Exam point: bhoodan tatha gramdan andolan Vinoba Bhave ke netritva mein chala - iski shuruaat 1951 mein Pochampally se hui.

qe: What was the purpose of enacting land ceiling legislation across Indian states?
qh: सीलिंग कानूनों के माध्यम से अधिग्रहित 'अतिरिक्त भूमि' को किसे पुनर्वितरित किया जाता है?
o: Landless laborers and marginal agricultural workers
e: Adhiktam seema (ceiling) kanunon ke tehat vyakti ya parivar ke paas rah sakne wali kheti ki zameen ki adhiktam seema tay ki gayi; is seema se jo atirikt zameen nikli, use bhumiheen mazdooron tatha seemant kisaanon ko baant diya gaya. Baat ye hai ki swatantrata ke samay kuchh hi parivaron ke paas bahut zameen thi tatha bahut log bagair zameen ke kheti nahi kar paate the, isliye adhiktam seema tatha punarvitaran se samanta laane ki koshish hui; yahi sudhar aaj bhi kshetriya asamanta ghatane ki soch ka hissa hai. Videshi kamniyon, ameer zamindaron ya daftarshahi ko zameen baantna is adhiniyam ka uddeshya nahi tha, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: ceiling kanunon ki atirikt zameen bhumiheen mazdooron tatha seemant kisaanon ko baanti gayi - yahi bhu-sudhar ka mukhya upay tha.

qe: What is the primary function of the 'National Company Law Tribunal' (NCLT) in corporate insolvency?
qh: भारत में कंपनियों के पुनरुद्धार और बंद होने से संबंधित मामलों को संभालने के लिए किस न्यायिक निकाय की स्थापना की गई थी?
o: Adjudicating authority for corporate insolvency resolution and company winding-up under IBC
e: Kamniyon ke punaruddhar tatha bandh hone se jude mamlon ki sunvai ke liye NCLT (National Company Law Tribunal) ki sthapna ki gayi; yahi corporate insolvency resolution process (IBC) ke tehat unke mamlon ka nyayik nirnay karta hai tatha nirdesh deta hai ki kamni ka dhan kaise wasool kiya jaaye. Baat ye hai ki pehle aise mamle salon tak khinchte the tatha bankon ka paisa phansa rehta tha, isliye ek vishesh nyayik adhikaran (tribunal) banane se tay samay mein faisla hone laga; iske upar appeal NCLAT mein jaati hai. Rajya ke lekhon ki jaanch, kar dar tay karna ya criminal arbitration is nyayik nikay ke kaam nahi hain, isliye wo vikalp galat hain. Exam point: kamni punarudhaar tatha bandh (winding up) ke mamle NCLT dekhta hai - yahi IBC ke tehat nyayik nirnay deta hai.

qe: Under the Companies Act, 2013, what percentage of average net profits must eligible firms allocate to CSR?
qh: कंपनी अधिनियम के अनुसार, पात्र कंपनियों के लिए CSR (कॉर्पोरेट सोशल रिस्पॉन्सिबिलिटी) की अनिवार्य आवश्यकता क्या है?
o: 2% of average net profits of the preceding three financial years
e: Kamni adhiniyam ke tehat patra kamniyon ko pichhle teen varsh ke ausatan shudh munafe ka kam se kam 2 pratishat CSR par kharch karna padta hai; ye niyam section 135 mein likha hai tatha aise kharch ko samajik kaam ke liye lagana hota hai. Baat ye hai ki sarkar chahti hai ki munafa kamane wali kamniyan shiksha, swasthya tatha paryavaran jaisi zimmedari bhi nibhayein, isliye yahi kharch anivarya kiya gaya; kharch na karne par karan batana padta hai. 5, 10 ya 1 pratishat wale vikalp is niyam ke sahi aankde nahi hain, isliye wo galat hain. Exam point: CSR ke tehat patra kamniyon ko pichhle teen varsh ke ausatan munafe ka 2 pratishat kharch karna hota hai - yahi section 135 ka hukm hai.
